	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Reviewed)]
	internal class AddReactionCommand : Command
	{
		private string myName;

		private string myType;

		private string myBasis;

		private string myPhase;

		private string myEqType;

		private ICollection mySynList;

		private ICollection myCoeffList;

		private ICollection myEqConstList;

		private ICollection myExponentList;

		private IDatabank myDatabank;

		private IReaction myReaction;

		private ArrayList mySymmetricEqConsts;

		private string mySymmetricEqConstBasis;

		public AddReactionCommand(IDatabank dbank, string reactnName, string reactnType, ICollection synArrList, ICollection coeffsArrList, ICollection exponentArrList, ICollection eqConstsArrList, string reactnBasis, string reactnPhase, string reactnEqType, ArrayList SymmetricEqConsts, string symmetricEqConstBasis)
		{
			myDatabank = dbank;
			myName = reactnName;
			myType = reactnType;
			myBasis = reactnBasis;
			mySynList = synArrList;
			myCoeffList = coeffsArrList;
			myEqConstList = eqConstsArrList;
			myPhase = reactnPhase;
			myEqType = reactnEqType;
			myExponentList = exponentArrList;
			mySymmetricEqConsts = SymmetricEqConsts;
			mySymmetricEqConstBasis = symmetricEqConstBasis;
		}

		protected AddReactionCommand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			myDatabank = (IDatabank)info.GetValue("reactionDatabank", typeof(IDatabank));
			myName = info.GetString("reactionName");
			myType = info.GetString("reactionType");
			myBasis = info.GetString("reactionBasis");
			mySynList = (ICollection)info.GetValue("synonymsList", typeof(ICollection));
			myCoeffList = (ICollection)info.GetValue("coeffsList", typeof(ICollection));
			myExponentList = (ICollection)info.GetValue("exponentList", typeof(ICollection));
			myEqConstList = (ICollection)info.GetValue("eqConstantsList", typeof(ICollection));
			myPhase = info.GetString("reactionPhase");
			myEqType = info.GetString("reactionEqType");
			mySymmetricEqConsts = (ArrayList)info.GetValue("SymmetricEqConsts", typeof(ArrayList));
			mySymmetricEqConstBasis = info.GetString("SymmetricEqConstBasis");
		}

		public override void GetAuditMessage(out string Message)
		{
			Message = $"Added a reaction with name '{myName}'";
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			base.Database.ReactionDao.AddReaction(myDatabank, myName, myType, myBasis, mySynList, myCoeffList, myExponentList, myEqConstList, myPhase, myEqType, mySymmetricEqConsts, mySymmetricEqConstBasis, out myReaction);
			return true;
		}

		public void GetResult(out IReaction reaction)
		{
			reaction = myReaction;
		}

		public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("reactionDatabank", myDatabank);
			info.AddValue("reactionName", myName);
			info.AddValue("reactionType", myType);
			info.AddValue("reactionBasis", myBasis);
			info.AddValue("synonymsList", mySynList);
			info.AddValue("coeffsList", myCoeffList);
			info.AddValue("exponentList", myExponentList);
			info.AddValue("eqConstantsList", myEqConstList);
			info.AddValue("reactionPhase", myPhase);
			info.AddValue("reactionEqType", myEqType);
			info.AddValue("SymmetricEqConsts", mySymmetricEqConsts);
			info.AddValue("SymmetricEqConstBasis", mySymmetricEqConstBasis);
		}
	}

	public class ApedApplication

		private static ArrayList LocalDBArguments;

		public static void SetupLocalDBArguments()
		{
			if (LocalDBArguments == null)
			{
				LocalDBArguments = new ArrayList();
				LocalDBArguments.Add("info " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
				LocalDBArguments.Add("start " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
				LocalDBArguments.Add("stop " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
				LocalDBArguments.Add("delete " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
				LocalDBArguments.Add("create " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
				LocalDBArguments.Add("share " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
			}
		}

		public static bool ValidateCleanInput(string cmdtext)
		{
			bool result = false;
			string[] array = cmdtext.Split((string[]?)null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array.Length <= 2)
			{
				return result;
			}
			string item = array[2];
			if (GlobalControl.CleanTable.Contains(item))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool ValidateSQLInput(string cmdtext)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public static void SetAPSysNames(string dbProvider)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < GlobalControl.ASPEN_SYSTEM_DATABASE_NAMES.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!(dbProvider.ToLowerInvariant() == "postgres") || i != 0)
				{
					string text = GlobalControl.ASPEN_SYSTEM_DATABASE_NAMES[i];
					if (i > 0)
					{
						text += "150";
					}
					arrayList.Add(text);
				}
			}
			GlobalControl.APSysNames = arrayList;
		}

		public static void SetupDefault(string dbProvider)
		{
			GlobalControl.bSetup = true;
			SetAPSysNames(dbProvider);
			GlobalControl.bIsWindows = Environment.OSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT;
			GlobalControl.currentUser = Environment.UserName;
			GlobalControl.machineName = Environment.MachineName;
			if (GlobalControl.bIsWindows && dbProvider.ToLowerInvariant() == "postgres")
			{
				DeleteVirtualConfigFile("C:\\ProgramData\\AspenTech\\APED V15.0", "pgDatabases.dat");
			}
			else
			{
				DeleteVirtualConfigFile("C:\\ProgramData\\AspenTech\\APED V15.0", "config.aem");
			}
			if (dbProvider.ToLowerInvariant() == "postgres")
			{
				int num = Convert.ToInt32(GlobalControl.pgPorts[0]);
				for (int i = 1; i <= 10; i++)
				{
					string item = (num + i).ToString();
					GlobalControl.pgPorts.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GlobalControl.pgConfigFilePath))
			{
				GlobalControl.pgConfigFilePath = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData) + "\\AspenTech\\APED V15.0\\pgPort.dat";
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GlobalControl.ipAddress))
			{
				return;
			}
			IPHostEntry hostEntry = Dns.GetHostEntry(Dns.GetHostName());
			_ = hostEntry.AddressList;
			IPAddress[] addressList = hostEntry.AddressList;
			foreach (IPAddress iPAddress in addressList)
			{
				if (iPAddress.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork)
				{
					GlobalControl.ipAddress = iPAddress.ToString();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void SetupSQLLocalDB()
		{
			string text = "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft SQL Server\\160\\Tools\\Binn\\";
			string path = text + "SqlLocalDB.exe";
			if (!File.Exists(path))
			{
				text = "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft SQL Server\\150\\Tools\\Binn\\";
				path = text + "SqlLocalDB.exe";
			}
			if (File.Exists(path))
			{
				GlobalControl.localDBServer = true;
				GlobalControl.localDBToolsPath = text;
				GlobalControl.localDBSQLCMDPath = "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft SQL Server\\Client SDK\\ODBC\\170\\Tools\\Binn\\";
				SetupLocalDBArguments();
			}
		}

		public static string GetRemoteServiceNameWithIPAddress(string serverName)
		{
			string[] array = serverName.Split(new char[1] { '\\' });
			string iPAddressOfServer = GetIPAddressOfServer(array[0]);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(iPAddressOfServer))
			{
				return serverName;
			}
			return iPAddressOfServer + "\\" + array[1].ToString().ToUpperInvariant();
		}

		public static string GetIPAddressOfServer(string hostName)
		{
			return Dns.GetHostEntry(hostName).AddressList[0].ToString();
		}

		public static void CheckSQLInstance()
		{
			string text = GlobalControl.sqlInstance;
			if (text.Contains("\\"))
			{
				text = text.Split(new char[1] { '\\' })[0];
			}
			if (!SQLInstanceAsIPAddress(text) && text.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo(GlobalControl.machineName.ToUpperInvariant()) != 0 && text.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo(".") != 0 && text.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo("LOCALHOST") != 0)
			{
				GlobalControl.bRemoteSQL = true;
			}
		}

		public static bool SQLInstanceAsIPAddress(string sqlInstance)
		{
			if (sqlInstance.CompareTo(GlobalControl.ipAddress) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (sqlInstance.Split(new char[1] { '.' }).Length == 4)
			{
				GlobalControl.bRemoteSQL = true;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void GetConfigurationFilePath(out string ConfigurationFilePath)
		{
			if (!GlobalControl.bSetup)
			{
				SetupDefault("mssql");
			}
			if (!GlobalControl.bIsWindows)
			{
				ConfigurationFilePath = "config.aem";
				if (!File.Exists(ConfigurationFilePath))
				{
					ConfigurationFilePath = "";
				}
				return;
			}
			ConfigurationFilePath = "C:\\ProgramData\\AspenTech\\APED V15.0\\config.aem";
			if (File.Exists(ConfigurationFilePath))
			{
				return;
			}
			ConfigurationFilePath = "C:\\ProgramData\\AspenTech\\APED V15.0\\" + GlobalControl.currentUser + "\\config.aem";
			if (!File.Exists(ConfigurationFilePath))
			{
				ConfigurationFilePath = "";
				return;
			}
			SetupSQLLocalDB();
			if (!GlobalControl.localDBServer)
			{
				ConfigurationFilePath = "";
			}
			else
			{
				SetInstanceForCurrentUser();
			}
		}

		public static void SetInstanceForCurrentUser()
		{
			string text = ExecuteSQLLocalDBCommand("info " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || text.Contains("doesn't exist"))
			{
				CreateCurrentInstance();
				return;
			}
			string[] array = Regex.Split(text, "\r\r\n");
			if (array.Length < 8)
			{
				CreateCurrentInstance();
				return;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GlobalControl.InstanceVersion))
			{
				GlobalControl.InstanceVersion = array[1].ToString().Split((string[]?)null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)[1].ToString().Split(new char[1] { '.' })[0].ToString();
			}
			if (array[7].Contains("pipe") && array[7].Contains("tsql") && array[7].Contains("query"))
			{
				int num = array[7].IndexOf(":");
				GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname = array[7].Substring(num + 2, array[7].Length - (num + 2));
				return;
			}
			text = ExecuteSQLLocalDBCommand("start " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
			Thread.Sleep(1000);
			text = ExecuteSQLLocalDBCommand("info " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
			array = Regex.Split(text, "\r\r\n");
			if (array.Length >= 8 && array[7].Contains("pipe") && array[7].Contains("tsql") && array[7].Contains("query"))
			{
				int num2 = array[7].IndexOf(":");
				GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname = array[7].Substring(num2 + 2, array[7].Length - (num2 + 2));
			}
		}

		public static void CreateCurrentInstance()
		{
			string value = ExecuteSQLLocalDBCommand("create " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			value = ExecuteSQLLocalDBCommand("start " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
			Thread.Sleep(1000);
			value = ExecuteSQLLocalDBCommand("info " + GlobalControl.currentInstance);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array = Regex.Split(value, "\r\r\n");
			if (array.Length >= 8 && array[7].Contains("pipe") && array[7].Contains("tsql") && array[7].Contains("query"))
			{
				int num = array[7].IndexOf(":");
				GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname = array[7].Substring(num + 2, array[7].Length - (num + 2));
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GlobalControl.InstanceVersion))
				{
					GlobalControl.InstanceVersion = array[1].ToString().Split((string[]?)null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)[1].ToString().Split(new char[1] { '.' })[0].ToString();
				}
			}
		}

		public static string ExecuteSQLLocalDBCommand(string arguments)
		{
			string result = "Invalid Input";
			if (!LocalDBArguments.Contains(arguments))
			{
				return result;
			}
			string fileName = GlobalControl.localDBToolsPath + "SQLLocalDB.exe";
			_ = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				Process process = new Process();
				process.StartInfo.UseShellExecute = false;
				process.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = true;
				process.StartInfo.CreateNoWindow = true;
				process.StartInfo.FileName = fileName;
				process.StartInfo.Arguments = arguments;
				process.Start();
				result = process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();
				process.WaitForExit();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				_ = ex.Message;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static string BuildConnectionString(string dbProvider, string dataSource, string port, string dbName, string userName, string userView)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSource) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbName) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(userName) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(userView))
			{
				if (dbProvider.ToLowerInvariant() != "postgres")
				{
					return "SQL Server is not properly configured.";
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(port))
				{
					return "PostgeSQL Server is not properly configured.";
				}
			}
			if (dbProvider.ToLowerInvariant() == "postgres")
			{
				return "Host=" + dataSource + ";Port=" + port + ";Database=" + dbName + ";Username=" + userName + ";Password=" + userView + ";Pooling=false;";
			}
			return "Pooling=False;Data Source=" + dataSource + ";Initial Catalog='" + dbName + "';User ID=" + userName + ";Password=" + userView + ";";
		}

		}

		public static ArrayList ParsePostgresSQLpgDatabasesDat(out string port)
		{
			port = string.Empty;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			string path = "C:\\ProgramData\\AspenTech\\APED V15.0\\pgDatabases.dat";
			if (!File.Exists(path))
			{
				UpdateErrorReports("pgDatabases.dat not found in C:\\ProgramData\\AspenTech\\APED V15.0\\pgDatabases.dat");
				return arrayList;
			}
			string[] array = File.ReadAllLines(path);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i].ToLowerInvariant().StartsWith("port"))
				{
					string[] array2 = array[i].Split(new char[1] { ':' });
					port = array2[1];
				}
				else if (array[i].ToLowerInvariant().Contains("port:"))
				{
					int num = array[i].LastIndexOf(":");
					string text = array[i].Substring(0, num - 4);
					arrayList.Add(text);
					string[] array3 = array[i].Substring(num - 4, array[i].Length - text.Length).Split(new char[1] { ':' });
					port = array3[1];
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[i]))
				{
					arrayList.Add(array[i]);
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(port))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GlobalControl.inputPort))
				{
					port = GlobalControl.inputPort;
					GlobalControl.outputPort = port;
				}
				else
				{
					path = GlobalControl.pgConfigFilePath;
					if (File.Exists(path))
					{
						string[] array4 = File.ReadAllLines(path);
						for (int j = 0; j < array4.Length; j++)
						{
							if (array4[j].ToLowerInvariant().StartsWith("port"))
							{
								string[] array5 = array4[j].Split(new char[1] { ':' });
								port = array5[1];
								GlobalControl.outputPort = port;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count > 0)
			{
				GlobalControl.listOfDatabases = arrayList;
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		public static string UpdateErrorReports(string sError)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			string fileName = "C:\\ProgramData\\AspenTech\\APED V15.0\\pgDatabases.log";
			try
			{
				StreamWriter streamWriter = new FileInfo(fileName).AppendText();
				streamWriter.WriteLine(sError);
				streamWriter.Flush();
				streamWriter.Close();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				result = ex.Message;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static void DeleteVirtualConfigFile(string configurationFilePath, string configFile)
		{
			_ = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				int num = Path.GetFullPath(configurationFilePath).LastIndexOf("ProgramData");
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					string text = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData) + "\\VirtualStore\\" + Path.GetFullPath(configurationFilePath).Substring(num) + "\\" + configFile;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && File.Exists(text))
					{
						CanTheFileBeDeleted(text);
					}
					text = Path.GetDirectoryName(text) + "\\" + GlobalControl.currentUser;
					text = Path.Combine(text, configFile);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && File.Exists(text))
					{
						CanTheFileBeDeleted(text);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				_ = ex.Message;
			}
		}

		public static string CanTheFileBeDeleted(string file)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				File.Delete(file);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				text = ex.Message;
				UpdateErrorReports(text);
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static bool CheckConnectionToPostgreSQL(bool debug, string pgHost, ref string pgPort, out string user, out string password, out string message)
		{
			//IL_00c1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0165: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0153: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0159: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00a8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ae: Expected O, but got Unknown
			user = string.Empty;
			password = string.Empty;
			message = string.Empty;
			bool result = false;
			NpgsqlConnection val = null;
			string text = string.Empty;
			string dbProvider = "postgres";
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pgPort))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < GlobalControl.pgPorts.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pgPort))
					{
						break;
					}
					pgPort = GlobalControl.pgPorts[i];
					for (int j = 0; j < GlobalControl.UserList.Count; j++)
					{
						user = GlobalControl.UserList[j];
						password = GlobalControl.PWList[j];
						_ = string.Empty;
						try
						{
							text = ((!(user == "apeduser2")) ? "postgres" : "apeduser2");
							val = new NpgsqlConnection(BuildConnectionString(dbProvider, pgHost, pgPort, text, user, password));
							((DbConnection)(object)val).Open();
							result = true;
							GlobalControl.outputPort = pgPort;
						}
						catch (NpgsqlException ex)
						{
							NpgsqlException ex2 = ex;
							message = ((Exception)(object)ex2).Message;
							continue;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < GlobalControl.UserList.Count; k++)
				{
					user = GlobalControl.UserList[k];
					password = GlobalControl.PWList[k];
					_ = string.Empty;
					try
					{
						text = ((!(user == "apeduser2")) ? "postgres" : "apeduser2");
						val = new NpgsqlConnection(BuildConnectionString(dbProvider, pgHost, pgPort, text, user, password));
						((DbConnection)(object)val).Open();
						result = true;
					}
					catch (NpgsqlException ex3)
					{
						NpgsqlException ex4 = ex3;
						message = ((Exception)(object)ex4).Message;
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			((DbConnection)(object)val)?.Close();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pgPort))
			{
				GlobalControl.listOfDefaults.Add(pgPort);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(user))
			{
				GlobalControl.listOfDefaults.Add(user);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
			{
				GlobalControl.listOfDefaults.Add(password);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				GlobalControl.listOfDefaults.Add(text);
			}
			return result;
		}

		{
			return GlobalControl.listOfDefaults;
		}

		public static ArrayList GetListOfDatabases()
		{
			return GlobalControl.listOfDatabases;
		}

		public static bool pgPortForCurrentUser()
		{
			return GlobalControl.bpgPort;
		}

	internal class AssociationManager : IDatabaseObjectAssocationManager
	{
		private Database myDatabase;

		public IDatabase Database => myDatabase;

		public AssociationManager(Database database)
		{
			myDatabase = database;
		}

		public void AssociateObjects(IDatabaseObjectMoniker Object1, IDatabaseObjectMoniker Object2)
		{
			if (Object1 == null || Object2 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Object cannot be empty");
			}
			if (Object1.Database != myDatabase)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database that contains Object1 must be the same as the database that contains the associations", "Object1");
			}
			if (Object1.Database != Object2.Database)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database that contains Object1 must be the same as the database that contains Object2");
			}
			AssociateObjectsCommand command = new AssociateObjectsCommand(Object1, Object2);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error associating the objects", inner);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAssociation(IDatabaseObjectMoniker Object1, IDatabaseObjectMoniker Object2)
		{
			if (Object1 == null || Object2 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Object cannot be empty");
			}
			if (Object1.Database != myDatabase)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database that contains Object1 must be the same as the database that contains the associations", "Object1");
			}
			if (Object1.Database != Object2.Database)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database that contains Object1 must be the same as the database that contains Object2");
			}
			RemoveAssociationCommand command = new RemoveAssociationCommand(Object1, Object2);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error removing the association between the objects", inner);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAllAssociations(IDatabaseObjectMoniker Object1)
		{
			if (Object1 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Object cannot be empty");
			}
			if (Object1.Database != myDatabase)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database that contains Object1 must be the same as the database that contains the associations", "Object1");
			}
			RemoveAllAssociationsCommand command = new RemoveAllAssociationsCommand(Object1);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error removing the associations for the object", inner);
			}
		}

		public void DeleteAssociation(IDatabaseObjectMoniker Object1, IDatabaseObjectMoniker Object2)
		{
			if (Object1 == null || Object2 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Object cannot be empty");
			}
			if (Object1.Database != myDatabase)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database that contains Object1 must be the same as the database that contains the associations", "Object1");
			}
			if (Object1.Database != Object2.Database)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database that contains Object1 must be the same as the database that contains Object2");
			}
			DeleteAssociationCommand command = new DeleteAssociationCommand(Object1, Object2);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error permanently deleting the association between the objects", inner);
			}
		}

		public void DeleteAllAssociations(IDatabaseObjectMoniker Object1)
		{
			if (Object1 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Object cannot be empty");
			}
			if (Object1.Database != myDatabase)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database that contains Object1 must be the same as the database that contains the associations", "Object1");
			}
			DeleteAllAssociationsCommand command = new DeleteAllAssociationsCommand(Object1);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error permanently deleting the associations for the object", inner);
			}
		}

		public void FindAssociatedObjects(IDatabaseObjectMoniker Object1, DatabaseObjectType AssociatedObjectsType, out IDatabaseObjectMoniker[] AssociatedObjects)
		{
			AssociatedObjects = null;
			if (Object1 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Object cannot be empty");
			}
			if (Object1.Database != myDatabase)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database that contains Object1 must be the same as the database that contains the associations", "Object1");
			}
			FindAssociatedObjectsCommand findAssociatedObjectsCommand = new FindAssociatedObjectsCommand(Object1, AssociatedObjectsType);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, findAssociatedObjectsCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				findAssociatedObjectsCommand.GetResult(out AssociatedObjects);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while finding the objects associated with the given object", inner);
			}
		}
	}

				{
					throw;

				}

		}

		{

			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred writing the audit log entry to the database", inner);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AuditLogEntry : IAuditLogEntry
	{
		private string myCategory;

		private string myUserName;

		private string myMessage;

		private DateTime myUtcTimeGenerated;

		private Database myDatabase;

		public IDatabase Database => myDatabase;

		public string Category => myCategory;

		public DateTime UtcTimeGenerated => myUtcTimeGenerated;

		public string UserName => myUserName;

		public string Message => myMessage;

		private AuditLogEntry(Database database)
		{
			myDatabase = database;
		}

		public AuditLogEntry(Database database, DataRow row)
			: this(database)
		{
			initialize(row);
		}

		public AuditLogEntry(Database database, DateTime utcTimeGenerated, string message, string userName, string category)
			: this(database)
		{
			initialize(utcTimeGenerated, message, userName, category);
		}

		private void initialize(DataRow row)
		{
			myUtcTimeGenerated = Convert.ToDateTime(row["aeUtcDate"]);
			myMessage = (string)row["aeMessage"];
			myUserName = (string)row["aeUserName"];
			object obj = row["aeCategory"];
			if (obj != null)
			{
				myCategory = (string)obj;
			}
		}

		private void initialize(DateTime utcTimeGenerated, string message, string userName, string category)
		{
			myUtcTimeGenerated = utcTimeGenerated;
			myMessage = message;
			myUserName = userName;
			myCategory = category;
		}
	}

			throw new NotImplementedException();

			return new AuditLogEntryEnumerator(this);
		}

		private void initialize()
		{
			DataSet allEntries = myDatabase.AuditLogDao.GetAllEntries(myDatabase.DBProvider);
			if (allEntries != null && allEntries.Tables.Count > 0)

	internal class AuditLogEntryEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private AuditLogEntryCollection myAuditLogEntryCollection;

		private int myIndex;

		public object Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (myIndex < 0 || myIndex >= myAuditLogEntryCollection.Count)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("The enumerator index is invalid");
				}
				return myAuditLogEntryCollection[myIndex];
			}
		}

		public AuditLogEntryEnumerator(AuditLogEntryCollection auditLogEntryCollection)
		{
			myAuditLogEntryCollection = auditLogEntryCollection;
			Reset();
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			myIndex++;
			if (myIndex >= myAuditLogEntryCollection.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			myIndex = -1;
		}
	}
	internal class Change : IChange
	{
		private Command myCommand;

		private ChangeController myChangeController;

		private DatabaseAccessRole myRequiredPermission;

		private int myPendingChangeId;

		private ChangeState myState;

		private IAuditLogEntry mySubmittedAuditLogEntry;

		private IAuditLogEntry myApprovedAuditLogEntry;

		private bool myResult;

		public ChangeState State => myState;

		public bool Result => myResult;

		public string Category
		{
			get
			{
				string text = "Unsubmitted";
				if (mySubmittedAuditLogEntry != null)
				{
					text = mySubmittedAuditLogEntry.Category;
				}
				if (myApprovedAuditLogEntry != null)
				{
					text = text + "/" + myApprovedAuditLogEntry.Category;
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		public DateTime UtcTimeSubmitted
		{
			get
			{
				if (myState == ChangeState.Unsubmitted)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("The change has not been submitted");
				}
				return mySubmittedAuditLogEntry.UtcTimeGenerated;
			}
		}

		public DateTime UtcTimeApproved
		{
			get
			{
				if (myState != ChangeState.Approved)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("The change has not been approved");
				}
				return myApprovedAuditLogEntry.UtcTimeGenerated;
			}
		}

		public string SubmitterName
		{
			get
			{
				if (myState == ChangeState.Unsubmitted)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("The change has not been submitted");
				}
				return mySubmittedAuditLogEntry.UserName;
			}
		}

		public string ApproverName
		{
			get
			{
				if (myState != ChangeState.Approved)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("The change has not been approved");
				}
				return myApprovedAuditLogEntry.UserName;
			}
		}

		public string Message
		{
			get
			{
				if (myState == ChangeState.Unsubmitted)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("The change has not been submitted");
				}
				return mySubmittedAuditLogEntry.Message;
			}
		}

		internal Command Command => myCommand;

		internal DatabaseAccessRole RequiredPermission => myRequiredPermission;

		internal int PendingChangeId
		{
			get
			{
				return myPendingChangeId;
			}
			set
			{
				myPendingChangeId = value;
			}
		}

		public Change(Database database, Command command, DatabaseAccessRole permission)
		{
			myCommand = command;
			myCommand.Database = database;
			myRequiredPermission = permission;
			myState = ChangeState.Unsubmitted;
			myChangeController = ChangeControllerFactory.CreateController(this);
		}

		public Change(Database database, string commandData, int pendingChangeId, int submittedAuditLogEntryId)
		{
			myCommand = Command.Deserialize(commandData, database);
			myPendingChangeId = pendingChangeId;
			mySubmittedAuditLogEntry = database.AuditLogDao.GetEntry(submittedAuditLogEntryId);
			myState = ChangeState.Submitted;
			myRequiredPermission = DatabaseAccessRole.None;
			myChangeController = new ReviewedChangeController(this);
		}

		public Change(Database database, string commandData, int pendingChangeId, int submittedAuditLogEntryId, int approvedAuditLogEntryId)
			: this(database, commandData, pendingChangeId, submittedAuditLogEntryId)
		{
			myApprovedAuditLogEntry = database.AuditLogDao.GetEntry(approvedAuditLogEntryId);
			myState = ChangeState.Approved;
		}

		internal void SetState(ChangeState state)
		{
			myState = state;
		}

		internal void SetResult(bool result)
		{
			myResult = result;
		}

		public static bool ApproveLast(Database database)
		{
			if (!getLastChange(database, out var commandData, out var pendingChangeId, out var auditLogEntryId))
			{
				return true;
			}
			Change change = new Change(database, commandData, pendingChangeId, auditLogEntryId);
			change.Approve();
			return change.Result;
		}

		public static void RejectLast(Database database)
		{
			if (getLastChange(database, out var commandData, out var pendingChangeId, out var auditLogEntryId))
			{
				new Change(database, commandData, pendingChangeId, auditLogEntryId).Reject();
			}
		}

		public void Approve()
		{
			if (myState == ChangeState.Unsubmitted)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The change has not been submitted");
			}
			if (myState != ChangeState.Submitted)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The change has already been reviewed");
			}
			myChangeController.ApproveChange();
		}

		public void Reject()
		{
			if (myState == ChangeState.Unsubmitted)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The change has not been submitted");
			}
			if (myState != ChangeState.Submitted)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The change has already been reviewed");
			}
			myChangeController.RejectChange();
		}

		internal void Submit()
		{
			myChangeController.SubmitChange();
		}

		private static bool getLastChange(Database database, out string commandData, out int pendingChangeId, out int auditLogEntryId)
		{
			return database.ChangeDao.GetLastChange(out commandData, out pendingChangeId, out auditLogEntryId);
		}
	}

	internal class PendingChangeCollection : ChangeCollection, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		public object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= base.Count)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				if (base.RowCollection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				DataRow dataRow = base.RowCollection[index];
				int pendingChangeId = Convert.ToInt32(dataRow[0]);
				int submittedAuditLogEntryId = Convert.ToInt32(dataRow[1]);
				string commandData = Convert.ToString(dataRow[2]);
				return new Change(base.Database, commandData, pendingChangeId, submittedAuditLogEntryId);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public PendingChangeCollection(Database database)
			: base(database)
		{
			initialize();
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ChangeEnumerator(this);
		}

		private void initialize()
		{
			DataSet allPendingChanges = base.Database.ChangeDao.GetAllPendingChanges(base.Database.DBProvider);
			if (allPendingChanges != null && allPendingChanges.Tables.Count > 0)
			{
				base.RowCollection = allPendingChanges.Tables[0].Rows;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ApprovedChangeCollection : ChangeCollection, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		public object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= base.Count)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				if (base.RowCollection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				DataRow dataRow = base.RowCollection[index];
				int pendingChangeId = Convert.ToInt32(dataRow[0]);
				int submittedAuditLogEntryId = Convert.ToInt32(dataRow[1]);
				int approvedAuditLogEntryId = Convert.ToInt32(dataRow[2]);
				string commandData = Convert.ToString(dataRow[3]);
				return new Change(base.Database, commandData, pendingChangeId, submittedAuditLogEntryId, approvedAuditLogEntryId);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public ApprovedChangeCollection(Database database)
			: base(database)
		{
			initialize();
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ChangeEnumerator(this);
		}

		private void initialize()
		{
			DataSet allApprovedChanges = base.Database.ChangeDao.GetAllApprovedChanges(base.Database.DBProvider);
			if (allApprovedChanges != null && allApprovedChanges.Tables.Count > 0)
			{
				base.RowCollection = allApprovedChanges.Tables[0].Rows;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ChangeEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private IList myChangeCollection;

		private int myIndex;

		public object Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (myIndex < 0 || myIndex >= myChangeCollection.Count)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("The enumerator index is invalid");
				}
				return myChangeCollection[myIndex];
			}
		}

		public ChangeEnumerator(IList changeCollection)
		{
			myChangeCollection = changeCollection;
			Reset();
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			myIndex++;
			if (myIndex >= myChangeCollection.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			myIndex = -1;
		}
	}
	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Immediate)]

	internal class ChangeControllerFactory
	{
		public enum ControllerType
		{
			Immediate,
			Reviewed
		}

		public static ChangeController CreateController(Change change)
		{
			if (change.Command.Database.ChangeControlManager.IsChangeControlEnabled)
			{
				if (((CommandExecutionModelAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(change.Command.GetType(), typeof(CommandExecutionModelAttribute))).ExecutionModel == CommandExecutionModelType.Reviewed)
				{
					return new ReviewedChangeController(change);
				}
				return new ImmediateChangeController(change);
			}
			return new LocalChangeController(change);
		}
	}
	internal class ChangeControlManagerFactory
	{
		public static ChangeControlManagerBase CreateChangeControlManager(Database database)
		{
			if (database.IsChangeControlEnabled)
			{
				return new ChangeControlManagerImpl(database);
			}
			return new ChangeControlManagerBase(database);
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public delegate void ChangeEventHandlerDelegate(IChange change);
	[InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIDispatch)]
	public interface IChangeControlManagerEvents
	{
		void ChangeSubmitted(IChange change);
	}
	public interface IChangeControlManager
	{
		IDatabase Database { get; }

		bool IsChangeControlEnabled { get; }

		IList PendingChanges { get; }

		IList ApprovedChanges { get; }

		event ChangeEventHandlerDelegate ChangeSubmitted;

		void ApproveAll();

		bool ApproveLast();

		void RejectAll();

		void RejectLast();
	}
	public enum ChangeState
	{
		Unsubmitted,
		Submitted,
		Approved,
		Rejected
	}
	public interface IChange
	{
		ChangeState State { get; }

		bool Result { get; }

		string Category { get; }

		DateTime UtcTimeSubmitted { get; }

		DateTime UtcTimeApproved { get; }

		string SubmitterName { get; }

		string ApproverName { get; }

		string Message { get; }

		void Approve();

		void Reject();
	}
	internal abstract class ChangeController
	{
		public virtual void SubmitChange()
		{
		}

		public virtual void ApproveChange()
		{
		}

		public virtual void RejectChange()
		{
		}
	}
	internal class LocalChangeController : ChangeController
	{
		private Change myChange;

		public LocalChangeController(Change change)
		{
			myChange = change;
		}

		public override void SubmitChange()
		{
			base.SubmitChange();
			bool result = myChange.Command.Execute();
			myChange.SetResult(result);
			myChange.SetState(ChangeState.Approved);
		}
	}
	internal class ImmediateChangeController : ChangeController
	{
		private Change myChange;

		public ImmediateChangeController(Change change)
		{
			myChange = change;
		}

		public override void SubmitChange()
		{
			base.SubmitChange();
			Command command = myChange.Command;
			new DatabasePermission(myChange.RequiredPermission, command.Database).Demand();
			bool result = command.Execute();
			myChange.SetResult(result);
			myChange.SetState(ChangeState.Approved);
			command.GetAuditMessage(out var Message);
			if (Message != null)
			{
				command.Database.AuditLogDao.WriteEntry("Approved", Message);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ReviewedChangeController : ChangeController
	{
		private Change myChange;

		public ReviewedChangeController(Change change)
		{
			myChange = change;
		}

		public override void SubmitChange()
		{
			base.SubmitChange();
			Command command = myChange.Command;
			Database database = command.Database;
			new DatabasePermission(myChange.RequiredPermission, database).Demand();
			command.GetAuditMessage(out var Message);
			int auditLogEntryId = database.AuditLogDao.WriteEntry("Submitted", Message);
			int pendingChangeId = persistChange(auditLogEntryId);
			myChange.PendingChangeId = pendingChangeId;
			myChange.SetState(ChangeState.Submitted);
			database.GetChangeControlManager(out var changeControlManager);
			changeControlManager.OnChangeSubmitted(myChange);
		}

		public override void ApproveChange()
		{
			base.ApproveChange();
			Command command = myChange.Command;
			new DatabasePermission(DatabaseAccessRole.Reviewer, command.Database).Demand();
			bool result = command.Execute();
			myChange.SetResult(result);
			myChange.SetState(ChangeState.Approved);
			command.GetAuditMessage(out var Message);
			int approvedAuditLogEntryId = command.Database.AuditLogDao.WriteEntry("Approved", Message);
			preserveApprovedChange(approvedAuditLogEntryId);
			deletePendingChange();
		}

		public override void RejectChange()
		{
			base.RejectChange();
			Command command = myChange.Command;
			new DatabasePermission(DatabaseAccessRole.Reviewer, command.Database).Demand();
			deletePendingChange();
			myChange.SetState(ChangeState.Rejected);
			try
			{
				command.Database.AuditLogDao.WriteEntry("Rejected", command.ToString());
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private int persistChange(int auditLogEntryId)
		{
			Command command = myChange.Command;
			string changeData = Command.Serialize(command);
			return command.Database.ChangeDao.PersistPendingChange(changeData, auditLogEntryId);
		}

		private void deletePendingChange()
		{
			myChange.Command.Database.ChangeDao.DeletePendingChange(myChange.PendingChangeId);
		}

		private void preserveApprovedChange(int approvedAuditLogEntryId)
		{
			myChange.Command.Database.ChangeDao.ApproveChange(myChange.PendingChangeId, approvedAuditLogEntryId);
		}
	}
	[ComSourceInterfaces(typeof(IChangeControlManagerEvents))]
	internal class ChangeControlManagerBase : IChangeControlManager
	{
		protected Database myDatabase;

		public IDatabase Database => myDatabase;

		public bool IsChangeControlEnabled => myDatabase.IsChangeControlEnabled;

		public virtual IList PendingChanges => new PendingChangeCollection(myDatabase);

		public virtual IList ApprovedChanges => new ApprovedChangeCollection(myDatabase);

		public event ChangeEventHandlerDelegate ChangeSubmitted;

		public ChangeControlManagerBase(Database database)
		{
			myDatabase = database;
		}

		internal void OnChangeSubmitted(IChange change)
		{
			if (this.ChangeSubmitted != null)
			{
				this.ChangeSubmitted(change);
			}
		}

		public virtual void ApproveAll()
		{
		}

		public virtual bool ApproveLast()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void RejectAll()
		{
		}

		public virtual void RejectLast()
		{
		}
	}
	internal class ChangeControlManagerImpl : ChangeControlManagerBase
	{
		public override IList PendingChanges
		{
			get
			{
				GetPendingChangesCommand getPendingChangesCommand = new GetPendingChangesCommand();
				Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getPendingChangesCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
				try
				{
					change.Submit();
					getPendingChangesCommand.GetResult(out var changes);
					return changes;
				}
				catch (GatewayException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				catch (Exception inner)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving the collection of pending changes", inner);
				}
			}
		}

		public override IList ApprovedChanges
		{
			get
			{
				GetApprovedChangesCommand getApprovedChangesCommand = new GetApprovedChangesCommand();
				Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getApprovedChangesCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
				try
				{
					change.Submit();
					getApprovedChangesCommand.GetResult(out var changes);
					return changes;
				}
				catch (GatewayException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				catch (Exception inner)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving the collection of approved changes", inner);
				}
			}
		}

		public ChangeControlManagerImpl(Database database)
			: base(database)
		{
		}

		public override void ApproveAll()
		{
			foreach (IChange pendingChange in PendingChanges)
			{
				pendingChange.Approve();
			}
		}

		public override bool ApproveLast()
		{
			try
			{
				return Change.ApproveLast(myDatabase);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred approving the most recent pending change", inner);
			}
		}

		public override void RejectAll()
		{
			IList pendingChanges = PendingChanges;
			for (int num = pendingChanges.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				((IChange)pendingChanges[num]).Reject();
			}
		}

		public override void RejectLast()
		{
			try
			{
				Change.RejectLast(myDatabase);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred rejecting the most recent pending change", inner);
			}
		}
	}

			myCompoundId = compoundId;
			myCompoundIdType = compoundIdType;
			myPropertyName = propertyName;
			myCitation = citObj;
		}

		protected AddCitationCommand_DeleteLater(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			myDatabank = (IDatabank)info.GetValue("databank", typeof(IDatabank));
			myCompoundId = info.GetString("compoundId");
			myCompoundIdType = info.GetString("compoundIdType");
			myPropertyName = info.GetString("propertyName");
			myCitation = (PropertyCitationsObject)info.GetValue("citObj", typeof(PropertyCitationsObject));
		}

		public override void GetAuditMessage(out string Message)
		{
			Message = null;
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			base.Database.CitationsDao.AddCitation(myDatabank, myCompoundId, myCompoundIdType, myPropertyName, myCitation);
			return true;
		}

		public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("databank", myDatabank);
			info.AddValue("compoundId", myCompoundId);
			info.AddValue("compoundIdType", myCompoundIdType);
			info.AddValue("propertyName", myPropertyName);
			info.AddValue("citObj", myCitation);
		}
	}

	internal abstract class Command
	{
		[NonSerialized]
		private Database myDatabase;

		public Database Database
		{
			get
			{
				return myDatabase;
			}
			set
			{
				myDatabase = value;
			}
		}

		protected Command()
		{
		}

		protected Command(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			myDatabase = (Database)context.Context;
		}

		public abstract bool Execute();

		public virtual void GetAuditMessage(out string Message)
		{
			Message = null;
		}

		public static string Serialize(Command command)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static Command Deserialize(string data, Database database)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal enum CommandExecutionModelType
	{
		Immediate,
		Reviewed
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class, Inherited = false)]
	internal class CommandExecutionModelAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private CommandExecutionModelType myExecutionModel;

		public CommandExecutionModelType ExecutionModel
		{
			get
			{
				return myExecutionModel;
			}
			set
			{
				myExecutionModel = value;
			}
		}

		public CommandExecutionModelAttribute(CommandExecutionModelType executionModel)
		{
			myExecutionModel = executionModel;
		}
	}
	public class CompoundCollection : IDictionary, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private IDictionary myCompounds;

		private IDictionary myCompoundNames;

		private IDictionary myCompoundAliases;

		public bool IsReadOnly => true;

		public object this[object key]
		{
			get
			{
				return myCompounds[key];
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("The collection is read only");
			}
		}

		public ICollection Values => myCompounds.Values;

		public ICollection Keys => myCompounds.Keys;

		public bool IsFixedSize => true;

		public bool IsSynchronized => myCompounds.IsSynchronized;

		public int Count => myCompounds.Count;

		public object SyncRoot => myCompounds.SyncRoot;

		public CompoundCollection(IDictionary compounds, IDictionary compoundNames, IDictionary compoundAliases)
		{
			myCompounds = compounds;
			myCompoundNames = compoundNames;
			myCompoundAliases = compoundAliases;
		}

		public bool ContainsName(string compoundName)
		{
			return IndexOfCompoundWithName(compoundName) != null;
		}

		public bool ContainsAlias(string compoundAlias)
		{
			return IndexOfCompoundWithAlias(compoundAlias) != null;
		}

		public object IndexOfCompoundWithName(string compoundName)
		{
			if (compoundName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("compoundName");
			}
			return myCompoundNames[compoundName];
		}

		public object IndexOfCompoundWithAlias(string compoundAlias)
		{
			if (compoundAlias == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("compoundAlias");
			}
			return myCompoundAliases[compoundAlias];
		}

		public IDictionaryEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return myCompounds.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Remove(object key)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("The collection is read only");
		}

		public bool Contains(object key)
		{
			return myCompounds.Contains(key);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("The collection is read only");
		}

		public void Add(object key, object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("The collection is read only");
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("The collection is read only");
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return myCompounds.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

	internal class SetWorkingCompoundsCommand : Command
	{
		private ICollection myWorkingCompounds;

		public SetWorkingCompoundsCommand(ICollection workingCompounds)
		{
			myWorkingCompounds = workingCompounds;
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			ICompoundDao compoundDao = base.Database.CompoundDao;
			Array array = Array.CreateInstance(typeof(ICompound), myWorkingCompounds.Count);
			SortedList sortedList = new SortedList();
			myWorkingCompounds.CopyTo(array, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				try
				{
					sortedList.Add(((ICompound)array.GetValue(i)).Id, (ICompound)array.GetValue(i));
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			compoundDao.WorkingCompounds = sortedList;
			return true;
		}
	}

		public CompoundObject(int id, string comp1Name, string comp2Name, string comp3Name, string comp4Name, IIdentifier identifier, CompoundType compoundType, InteractionType interactionType, bool isReverse)

			myComp2Name = comp2Name;
			myComp3Name = comp3Name;
			myComp4Name = comp4Name;
			myIdentifier = identifier;
			myCompoundType = compoundType;

			: base(CompoundIndex.ToString(), Database)
		{
		}

		internal static IDatabaseObject ResolveMoniker(IDatabaseObjectMoniker moniker)
		{
			return new CompoundObject(moniker.Database, Convert.ToInt32(moniker.Identity));
		}

		public void GetCompoundIdentifier(string CompoundIdType, out string CompoundId)
		{
			ICompoundManager compoundManager;
			if (!(base.Database is ISupportsCompounds) || (compoundManager = (base.Database as ISupportsCompounds).CompoundManager) == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("The database does not support compounds");
			}
			compoundManager.GetIdentifier("CompoundIndex", out var identifier);
			compoundManager.GetCompound(CompoundIndex, identifier, out var compound);
			compoundManager.GetIdentifier(CompoundIdType, out identifier);
			compoundManager.GetIdentifierValue(compound, identifier, out var identifierValue);
			string[] array = new string[identifierValue.ValueList.Count];
			identifierValue.ValueList.CopyTo(array, 0);
			CompoundId = array[0];
		}

		void IDatabaseObject.GetMoniker(out IDatabaseObjectMoniker Moniker)
		{
			Moniker = new DatabaseObjectMoniker(((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).Database, ((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).ObjectType, ((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).Identity, ResolveMoniker);
		}
	}
	public enum CompoundType
	{
		Unknown = -1,
		Compound,
		UnifacGroup,
		ElectrolytePair
	}
	internal interface IAssociationsDao
	{
		bool AssociateObjects(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1, IDatabaseObjectMoniker object2);

		bool RemoveAssociation(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1, IDatabaseObjectMoniker object2);

		bool RemoveAllAssociations(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1);

		bool DeleteAssociation(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1, IDatabaseObjectMoniker object2);

		bool DeleteAllAssociations(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1);

		bool FindAssociatedObjects(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1, DatabaseObjectType associatedObjectsType, out IDatabaseObjectMoniker[] associatedObjects);
	}
	internal abstract class AssociationsDao : IAssociationsDao
	{
		protected abstract Database Database { get; }

		public bool AssociateObjects(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1, IDatabaseObjectMoniker object2)
		{
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (getAssociationIndex(dbCommand, object1.Identity, object1.ObjectType, object2.Identity, object2.ObjectType, out var _))
				{
					return false;
				}
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				addAssociation(dbCommand, object1.Identity, object1.ObjectType, object2.Identity, object2.ObjectType);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool RemoveAssociation(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1, IDatabaseObjectMoniker object2)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (!getAssociationIndex(dbCommand, object1.Identity, object1.ObjectType, object2.Identity, object2.ObjectType, out var associationIndex))
				{
					return false;
				}
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO removed_Associations SELECT * FROM Associations WHERE assocId={associationIndex}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				deleteAssociation(dbCommand, associationIndex);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool RemoveAllAssociations(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = string.Format("INSERT INTO removed_Associations SELECT * FROM Associations WHERE UPPER(assocObject1Id)='{0}' AND assocObject1Type={1} OR UPPER(assocObject2Id)='{0}' AND assocObject2Type={1}", object1.Identity.ToUpperInvariant(), object1.ObjectType);
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				deleteAllAssociations(dbCommand, object1.Identity, object1.ObjectType);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool DeleteAssociation(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1, IDatabaseObjectMoniker object2)
		{
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (!getAssociationIndex(dbCommand, object1.Identity, object1.ObjectType, object2.Identity, object2.ObjectType, out var associationIndex))
				{
					return false;
				}
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				deleteAssociation(dbCommand, associationIndex);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)

				}

		public bool DeleteAllAssociations(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1)
		{
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();

				throw;

			finally

				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)

				}
			}
		}

		public bool FindAssociatedObjects(IDatabaseObjectMoniker object1, DatabaseObjectType associatedObjectsType, out IDatabaseObjectMoniker[] associatedObjects)
		{
			associatedObjects = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
				ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
				findAssociations(dbCommand, object1.Identity, object1.ObjectType, associatedObjectsType, arrayList, arrayList2);
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					string identity = (string)arrayList[i];
					DatabaseObjectType objectType = (DatabaseObjectType)arrayList2[i];
					arrayList3.Add(DatabaseObjectMonikerFactory.CreateMoniker(Database, objectType, identity));
				}
				associatedObjects = (IDatabaseObjectMoniker[])arrayList3.ToArray(typeof(IDatabaseObjectMoniker));
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool getAssociationIndex(IDbCommand command, string object1Identity, DatabaseObjectType object1Type, string object2Identity, DatabaseObjectType object2Type, out int associationIndex)
		{
			associationIndex = 0;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			string commandText = $"SELECT assocId FROM Associations WHERE UPPER(assocObject1Id)='{object1Identity.ToUpperInvariant()}' AND assocObject1Type={(int)object1Type} AND UPPER(assocObject2Id)='{object2Identity.ToUpperInvariant()}' AND assocObject2Type={(int)object2Type}";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			dataReader = command.ExecuteReader();
			try
			{
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					associationIndex = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				dataReader.Close();
			}
		}

		private int getNextAssociationIndex(IDbCommand command)
		{
			int result = 1;
			command.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM NextAssociationId";
			object obj = command.ExecuteScalar();
			if (obj != DBNull.Value)
			{
				result = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void findAssociations(IDbCommand command, string object1Id, DatabaseObjectType object1Type, DatabaseObjectType object2Type, ArrayList object2Ids, ArrayList object2Types)
		{
			object2Ids.Clear();
			object2Types.Clear();
			string commandText = ((object2Type != DatabaseObjectType.Unknown) ? $"SELECT assocObject2Id, assocObject2Type FROM AssociationsSymmetric WHERE UPPER(assocObject1Id)='{object1Id.ToUpperInvariant()}' AND assocObject1Type={(int)object1Type} AND assocObject2Type={(int)object2Type}" : $"SELECT assocObject2Id, assocObject2Type FROM AssociationsSymmetric WHERE UPPER(assocObject1Id)='{object1Id.ToUpperInvariant()}' AND assocObject1Type={(int)object1Type}");
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			dataReader = command.ExecuteReader();
			try
			{
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					string value = Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					DatabaseObjectType databaseObjectType = (DatabaseObjectType)Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(1));
					object2Ids.Add(value);
					object2Types.Add(databaseObjectType);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dataReader.Close();
			}
		}

		private int addAssociation(IDbCommand command, string object1Identity, DatabaseObjectType object1Type, string object2Identity, DatabaseObjectType object2Type)
		{
			int nextAssociationIndex = getNextAssociationIndex(command);
			string commandText = $"INSERT INTO Associations(assocId, assocObject1Id, assocObject1Type, assocObject2Id, assocObject2Type) VALUES ({nextAssociationIndex}, '{object1Identity}', {(int)object1Type}, '{object2Identity}', {(int)object2Type})";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			return nextAssociationIndex;
		}

		private void deleteAssociation(IDbCommand command, int associationIndex)
		{
			string commandText = $"DELETE FROM Associations WHERE assocId = {associationIndex}";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		private void deleteAllAssociations(IDbCommand command, string object1Identity, DatabaseObjectType object1Type)
		{
			string.Format("DELETE FROM Associations WHERE UPPER(assocObject1Id)='{0}' AND assocObject1Type={1} OR UPPER(assocObject2Id)='{0}' AND assocObject2Type={1}", object1Identity.ToUpperInvariant(), (int)object1Type);
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}
	}
	internal interface IAuditLogDao
	{

		AuditLogEntry GetEntry(int entryIndex);

	internal abstract class AuditLogDao : IAuditLogDao
	{
		public const string alCategoryUnsubmitted = "Unsubmitted";

		public const string alCategoryChange = "Changed";

		public const string alCategoryAdd = "Added";

		public const string alCategoryRemove = "Deleted";

		public const string alCategoryDelete = "Permanently deleted";

		public const string alCategoryApprove = "Approved";

		public const string alCategoryReject = "Rejected";

		public const string alCategorySubmit = "Submitted";

		protected abstract Database Database { get; }

		public int WriteEntry(string category, string message)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				int num = 1;
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM NextAuditEventId";
				object obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != DBNull.Value)
				{
					num = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
				}
				IIdentity identity = Thread.CurrentPrincipal.Identity;
				string text = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss");
				string commandText;
				if (message != null && message != "")
				{
					string text2 = "'" + message.Replace("'", "''") + "'";
					commandText = $"INSERT INTO AuditEvents(aeId,aeUtcDate,aeMessage,aeUserName,aeCategory) VALUES ({num},'{text}',{text2},'{identity.Name}','{category}')";
				}
				else
				{
					commandText = string.Format("INSERT INTO AuditEvents(aeId,aeUtcDate,aeMessage,aeUserName,aeCategory) VALUES ({0},'{1}',{2},'{3}','{4}')", num, text, "NULL", identity.Name, category);
				}
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				return num;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public AuditLogEntry GetEntry(int entryIndex)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = $"SELECT aeUtcDate, aeMessage, aeUserName, aeCategory FROM AuditEvents WHERE aeId={entryIndex}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					string text = null;
					string text2 = null;
					string category = null;
					DateTime dateTime = dataReader.GetDateTime(0);
					text = dataReader.GetString(1);
					text2 = dataReader.GetString(2);
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(3))
					{
						category = dataReader.GetString(3);
					}
					return new AuditLogEntry(Database, dateTime, text, text2, category);
				}
				return null;
			}
			finally
			{
				dataReader.Close();
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract DataSet GetAllEntries(string dbprovider);
	}

		public void ApproveChange(int pendingChangeId, int approvedAuditLogEntryId)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = string.Format("INSERT INTO ApprovedChanges(acId, acSubmittedAuditLogEntryId, acApprovedAuditLogEntryId, acCommandData) SELECT pcId, pcAuditLogEntryId, {1}, pcCommandData FROM PendingChanges WHERE pcId={0}", pendingChangeId, approvedAuditLogEntryId);
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetLastChange(out string commandData, out int pendingChangeId, out int auditLogEntryId)
		{
			commandData = null;
			pendingChangeId = 0;
			auditLogEntryId = 0;
			bool result = false;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
			dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT pcId,pcAuditLogEntryId,pcCommandData FROM PendingChanges ORDER BY pcId DESC";
			dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
			try
			{
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					pendingChangeId = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					auditLogEntryId = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(1));
					commandData = dataReader.GetString(2);
					result = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public abstract DataSet GetAllPendingChanges(string dbprovider);

		public abstract DataSet GetAllApprovedChanges(string dbprovider);
	}

		public void AddNote(Databank databank, string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string propertyName, NotesObject noteObj)
		{
			string[] array = new string[1];
			Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundIdentifier(compoundId, compoundIdType, "CompoundIndex", out var identValue);
			identValue.ValueList.CopyTo(array, 0);
			int compId = Convert.ToInt32(array[0]);
			Database.PropertyValueDao.GetDatabankPropertyValueId(databank, compId, propertyName, out var dbcpId);
			m_previousCompId = compoundId;
			if (dbcpId > 0 && noteObj != null)
			{
				add_Note(dbcpId, noteObj.Note);
			}
		}

		private bool add_Note(int dbcId, string Note)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareAddNoteCommand("INSERT INTO Notes(dbcpnId, dbcpnNote) VALUES (@dbcpnId, @dbcpnote)", connection);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = dbcId;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = Note;
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetNote(Databank databank, string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string propertyName, out NotesObject noteObj)
		{
			noteObj = null;
			string[] array = new string[1];
			Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundIdentifier(compoundId, compoundIdType, "CompoundIndex", out var identValue);
			identValue.ValueList.CopyTo(array, 0);
			int compId = Convert.ToInt32(array[0]);
			Database.PropertyValueDao.GetDatabankPropertyValueId(databank, compId, propertyName, out var dbcpId);
			m_previousCompId = compoundId;
			if (dbcpId > 0)
			{
				get_Note(dbcpId, out noteObj);
			}
		}

		private bool get_Note(int dbcId, out NotesObject noteObj)
		{
			noteObj = null;
			bool flag = false;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = $"SELECT dbcpnNote FROM Notes WHERE dbcpnId = {dbcId}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				if (!dataReader.Read())
				{
					return false;
				}
				noteObj = new NotesObject("", dataReader.GetString(0));
				dataReader.Close();
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetDataInfo(Databank databank, string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string propertyName, out PropertyDataInfoObject errObj)
		{
			errObj = null;
			string[] array = new string[1];
			Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundIdentifier(compoundId, compoundIdType, "CompoundIndex", out var identValue);
			identValue.ValueList.CopyTo(array, 0);

			m_previousCompId = compoundId;
			if (dbcpId > 0)
			{
				get_DataInfo(dbcpId, out errObj);
			}
		}

		private bool get_DataInfo(int dbcId, out PropertyDataInfoObject errObj)
		{
			errObj = null;
			bool flag = false;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			string error = "";
			string errorSource = "";
			string dataType = "";
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = $"SELECT dbcpeErrorValue, dbcpeErrorSource, dbcpeDataType FROM DataInfo WHERE dbcpeId = {dbcId}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				if (!dataReader.Read())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(0))
				{
					error = dataReader.GetString(0);
				}
				if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(1))
				{
					errorSource = dataReader.GetString(1);
				}
				if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(2))
				{
					dataType = dataReader.GetString(2);
				}
				errObj = new PropertyDataInfoObject("", error, errorSource, dataType);
				if (errObj == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}
