		public bool AddCitation(string name, string title, string pages, string journal, string date, string book, string volume, string publisher, string notes, string authors, out ICitation citation)
		{
			citation = null;
			bool flag = false;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			int citId = 1;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!GetCitationId(name, out citId))
				{
					IDbCommand dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
					dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM NextCitationId";
					object obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
					if (obj != DBNull.Value)
					{
						citId = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
					}
					IDbCommand dbCommand2 = PrepareAddCitationCommand("INSERT INTO active_Citations(citId, citAuthors, citTitle, citJournal, citVolume, citPages, citPublisher, citDate, citNotes, citBook, citName) VALUES (@cit_Id, @cit_Authors, @cit_Title, @cit_Journal, @cit_Volume, @cit_Pages, @cit_Publisher, @cit_Date, @cit_Notes, @cit_Book, @cit_Name)", connection);
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = citId;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = authors;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = title;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter).Value = journal;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[4] as IDataParameter).Value = volume;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[5] as IDataParameter).Value = pages;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[6] as IDataParameter).Value = publisher;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[7] as IDataParameter).Value = date;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[8] as IDataParameter).Value = notes;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[9] as IDataParameter).Value = book;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[10] as IDataParameter).Value = name;
					dbTransaction = (dbCommand2.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
					dbCommand2.ExecuteNonQuery();
					dbTransaction.Commit();
					citation = new PropertyCitationsObject(citId, name, title, pages, journal, date, book, volume, publisher, notes, authors);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddCitation(IDatabank databank, string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string propertyName, PropertyCitationsObject citObj)
		{
			string[] array = new string[1];
			Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundIdentifier(compoundId, compoundIdType, "CompoundIndex", out var identValue);
			if (identValue != null)
			{
				identValue.ValueList.CopyTo(array, 0);
				int compId = Convert.ToInt32(array[0]);
				Database.PropertyValueDao.GetDatabankPropertyValueId(databank, compId, propertyName, out var dbcpId);
				m_previousCompId = compoundId;
				if (dbcpId > 0 && citObj != null)
				{
					add_Citation(dbcpId, citObj);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool add_Citation(int dbcId, PropertyCitationsObject citObj)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			int citId = 1;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			ArrayList citObjArr = new ArrayList();
			get_Citation(dbcId, out citObjArr);
			for (int i = 0; i < citObjArr.Count; i++)
			{
				if (((PropertyCitationsObject)citObjArr[i]).Name == citObj.Name)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (GetCitationId(citObj.Name, out citId))
			{
				try
				{
					IDbCommand dbCommand2 = PrepareAddAssociationCommand("INSERT INTO active_DbcpCitations(dbcpcId, dbcpcCitId) VALUES(@dbc_Id, @cit_Id)", connection);
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = dbcId;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = citId;
					dbTransaction = (dbCommand2.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
					dbCommand2.ExecuteNonQuery();
					dbTransaction.Commit();
					return true;
				}
				catch
				{
					dbTransaction?.Rollback();
					throw;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM NextCitationId";
				object obj2 = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj2 != DBNull.Value)
				{
					citId = Convert.ToInt32(obj2);
				}
				dbCommand = PrepareAddCitationCommand("INSERT INTO active_Citations(citId, citAuthors, citTitle, citJournal, citVolume, citPages, citPublisher, citDate, citNotes, citBook, citName) VALUES (@cit_Id, @cit_Authors, @cit_Title, @cit_Journal, @cit_Volume, @cit_Pages, @cit_Publisher, @cit_Date, @cit_Notes, @cit_Book, @cit_Name)", connection);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = citId;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Authors;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Title;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Journal;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[4] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Volume;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[5] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Pages;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[6] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Publisher;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[7] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Date;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[8] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Notes;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[9] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Book;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[10] as IDataParameter).Value = citObj.Name;
				IDbCommand dbCommand3 = PrepareAddAssociationCommand("INSERT INTO active_DbcpCitations(dbcpcId, dbcpcCitId) VALUES(@dbc_Id, @cit_Id)", connection);
				(dbCommand3.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = dbcId;
				(dbCommand3.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = citId;
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbCommand3.Transaction = dbTransaction;
				dbCommand3.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetCitation(string name, out ICitation citation)
		{
			citation = null;
			bool flag = false;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = $"SELECT * from active_Citations WHERE citName = '{name}'";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				if (!dataReader.Read())
				{
					return false;
				}
				int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
				string authors = dataReader.GetString(1);
				string title = dataReader.GetString(2);
				string journal = dataReader.GetString(3);
				string volume = dataReader.GetString(4);
				string pages = dataReader.GetString(5);
				string publisher = dataReader.GetString(6);
				string date = dataReader.GetString(7);
				string notes = dataReader.GetString(8);
				string book = dataReader.GetString(9);
				string name2 = dataReader.GetString(10);
				citation = new PropertyCitationsObject(@int, name2, title, pages, journal, date, book, volume, publisher, notes, authors);
				dataReader.Close();
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetCitation(IDatabank databank, string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string propertyName, out ArrayList citationLst)
		{
			citationLst = null;
			Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundIndex(compoundId, compoundIdType, out var compoundIndex);
			Database.PropertyValueDao.GetDatabankPropertyValueId(databank, compoundIndex, propertyName, out var dbcpId);
			if (dbcpId > 0)
			{
				ArrayList citObjArr = new ArrayList();
				get_Citation(dbcpId, out citObjArr);
				if (citObjArr.Count > 0)
				{
					citationLst = citObjArr;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool get_Citation(int dbcId, out ArrayList citObjArr)
		{
			bool result = false;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			PropertyCitationsObject propertyCitationsObject = null;
			citObjArr = null;
			bool flag = false;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareGetCitationDbankCompPropId("SELECT * from Citations WHERE dbcId = @dbcpid", connection);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = dbcId;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					result = true;
					int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(1);
					string authors = dataReader.GetString(3);
					string title = dataReader.GetString(4);
					string journal = dataReader.GetString(5);
					string volume = dataReader.GetString(6);
					string pages = dataReader.GetString(7);
					string publisher = dataReader.GetString(8);
					string date = dataReader.GetString(9);
					string notes = dataReader.GetString(10);
					string book = dataReader.GetString(11);
					string name = dataReader.GetString(2);
					propertyCitationsObject = new PropertyCitationsObject(@int, name, title, pages, journal, date, book, volume, publisher, notes, authors);
					arrayList.Add(propertyCitationsObject);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				citObjArr = arrayList;
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool GetCitationId(string citName, out int citId)
		{
			citId = 1;
			bool flag = false;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = $"SELECT citId from active_Citations WHERE citName = '{citName}'";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				object obj = null;
				obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				citId = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool RemoveCitation(ICitation citation)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (!GetCitation(citation.Name, out var _))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The Citation does not exist");
				}
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO removed_Citations SELECT * FROM active_Citations WHERE citId = {citation.CitationId}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				deleteCitation(dbCommand, citation.CitationId);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private void deleteCitationAssociation(IDbCommand c, int dbcId)
		{
			string commandText = $"DELETE FROM active_DbcpCitations WHERE dbcpcId={dbcId}";
			c.CommandText = commandText;
			c.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		public void DeleteCitationAssociation(Databank databank, string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string propertyName)
		{
			string[] array = new string[1];
			Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundIdentifier(compoundId, compoundIdType, "CompoundIndex", out var identValue);
			identValue.ValueList.CopyTo(array, 0);
			int compId = Convert.ToInt32(array[0]);
			Database.PropertyValueDao.GetDatabankPropertyValueId(databank, compId, propertyName, out var dbcpId);
			m_previousCompId = compoundId;
			if (dbcpId > 0)
			{
				delete_CitationAssociation(dbcpId);
			}
		}

		public void DeleteCitation(string citName)
		{
			if (citName == null || citName == "")
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!GetCitationId(citName, out var citId))
			{
				throw new GatewayException("The Citation does not exist");
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = $"DELETE FROM active_DbcpCitations WHERE dbcpcCitId = {citId}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				commandText = $"DELETE FROM active_Citations WHERE citId = {citId}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private void deleteCitation(IDbCommand c, int citId)
		{
			string commandText = $"DELETE FROM active_Citations WHERE citId={citId}";
			c.CommandText = commandText;
			c.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		public bool UpdateCitation(ref ICitation citation, string name, string title, string pages, string journal, string date, string book, string volume, string publisher, string notes, string authors)
		{
			if (citation == null)
			{
				AddCitation(name, title, pages, journal, date, book, volume, publisher, notes, authors, out citation);
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (GetCitation(citation.Name, out var _))
				{
					IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareUpdateCitationCommand("UPDATE active_Citations SET citAuthors = @cit_Authors, citTitle = @cit_Title , citJournal = @cit_Journal, citVolume = @cit_Volume, citPages = @cit_Pages, citPublisher = @cit_Publisher, citDate = @cit_Date, citNotes = @cit_Notes, citBook = @cit_Book, citName = @cit_Name WHERE citId = @cit_Id", connection);
					(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = citation.CitationId;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = authors;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = title;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter).Value = journal;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[4] as IDataParameter).Value = volume;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[5] as IDataParameter).Value = pages;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[6] as IDataParameter).Value = publisher;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[7] as IDataParameter).Value = date;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[8] as IDataParameter).Value = notes;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[9] as IDataParameter).Value = book;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[10] as IDataParameter).Value = name;
					dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					dbTransaction.Commit();
					citation = new PropertyCitationsObject(citation.CitationId, name, title, pages, journal, date, book, volume, publisher, notes, authors);
					return true;
				}
				throw new GatewayException("The Citation does not exist with this name. First Add this citation and then try to update it.");
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private void update_Citation(int dbcId, PropertyCitationsObject newCitObj)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			int citId = 1;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			ArrayList citObjArr = new ArrayList();
			if (!get_Citation(dbcId, out citObjArr))
			{
				throw new GatewayException("The Citation does not exist for this databank compound Id. First Add this citation and then update it.");
			}
			if (GetCitationId(newCitObj.Name, out citId))
			{
				try
				{
					IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareUpdateCitationCommand("UPDATE active_Citations SET citAuthors = @cit_Authors, citTitle = @cit_Title , citJournal = @cit_Journal, citVolume = @cit_Volume, citPages = @cit_Pages, citPublisher = @cit_Publisher, citDate = @cit_Date, citNotes = @cit_Notes, citBook = @cit_Book, citName = @cit_Name WHERE citId = @cit_Id", connection);
					(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = citId;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Authors;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Title;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Journal;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[4] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Volume;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[5] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Pages;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[6] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Publisher;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[7] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Date;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[8] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Notes;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[9] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Book;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[10] as IDataParameter).Value = newCitObj.Name;
					dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					dbTransaction.Commit();
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					dbTransaction?.Rollback();
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					dbTransaction?.Dispose();
					if (flag)
					{
						connection.Close();
					}
				}
			}
			throw new GatewayException("The Citation does not exist with this name in active_Citations. First Add this citation and then try to update it.");
		}

		public void GetAllCitations(out SortedList citationList)
		{
			citationList = new SortedList();
			bool flag = false;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = $"SELECT * from active_Citations";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
					string authors = dataReader.GetString(1);
					string title = dataReader.GetString(2);
					string journal = dataReader.GetString(3);
					string volume = dataReader.GetString(4);
					string pages = dataReader.GetString(5);
					string publisher = dataReader.GetString(6);
					string date = dataReader.GetString(7);
					string notes = dataReader.GetString(8);
					string book = dataReader.GetString(9);
					string text = dataReader.GetString(10);
					ICitation value = new PropertyCitationsObject(@int, text, title, pages, journal, date, book, volume, publisher, notes, authors);
					citationList.Add(text, value);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private IDbCommand PrepareGetCompoundForMMCommand(IDbConnection dbc)
		{
			if (m_cmdGetCompoundForMM == null || m_cmdGetCompoundForMM.Connection != dbc)
			{
				m_cmdGetCompoundForMM = dbc.CreateCommand();
				m_cmdGetCompoundForMM.CommandText = "SELECT compoundId from CompoundsIdentifiers WHERE identifierValue = @id";
				IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = m_cmdGetCompoundForMM.CreateParameter();
				dbDataParameter.ParameterName = "@id";
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.String;
				dbDataParameter.Size = 256;
				m_cmdGetCompoundForMM.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
				m_cmdGetCompoundForMM.Prepare();
			}
			return m_cmdGetCompoundForMM;
		}

		private IDbCommand PrepareGetAllCompoundIdentifierValuesForMM(IDbConnection dbc)
		{
			if (m_cmdGetCompoundIdentifierValuesForMM == null || m_cmdGetCompoundIdentifierValuesForMM.Connection != dbc)
			{
				m_cmdGetCompoundIdentifierValuesForMM = dbc.CreateCommand();
				m_cmdGetCompoundIdentifierValuesForMM.CommandText = SELECT_COMPOUND_IDENTIFIERS_FOR_MM_SQL;
				IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = m_cmdGetCompoundIdentifierValuesForMM.CreateParameter();

		public void AddBaseCompound(IDbCommand c, int compoundId)
		{
			c.CommandText = $"INSERT INTO Compounds(compId) VALUES ({compoundId})";
			c.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		public void ValidateIdentifierValues(ICompound compound, ArrayList identValueList)
		{
			if (identValueList == null || identValueList.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("Identifier Value must be specified.");
			}
			string text = "(";
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			for (int i = 0; i < identValueList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (hashtable.Contains(identValueList[i]))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Duplicate identifier values are not allowed.");
				}
				hashtable.Add(identValueList[i], identValueList[i]);
				string text2 = ((string)identValueList[i]).Replace("'", "''");
				text = ((i != identValueList.Count - 1) ? (text + "'" + text2 + "',") : (text + "'" + text2 + "'"));
			}
			text += ")";
			string commandText = "SELECT compoundId FROM CompoundsIdentifiers WHERE identifierValue IN  " + text + " AND IdentifierIndex IN (2,3,4)";
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				if (compound == null)
				{
					if (dataReader.Read())
					{
						throw new GatewayException($"Another Compound already exists in the database with same identifier value {identValueList[0]}.");
					}
					return;
				}
				Hashtable hashtable2 = new Hashtable();
				int num = 0;
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
					if (!hashtable2.ContainsValue(@int))
					{
						hashtable2.Add(num, @int);
					}
					num++;
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				if (hashtable2.Count > 1)
				{
					throw new GatewayException($"\nSpecified identifier value {identValueList[0]} for Compound with {compound.Identifier.Name} = {compound.Compound1Name} conflict with other already existing compound in the database.");
				}
				if (hashtable2.Count != 1 || (int)hashtable2[0] == compound.Id)
				{
					return;
				}
				GetIdentifier("CompoundIndex", out var identifier);
				if (identifier != null)
				{
					GetCompound(((int)hashtable2[0]).ToString(), identifier, out var compound2);
					if (compound2 != null)
					{
						throw new GatewayException($"\nAnother Compound with {compound2.Identifier.Name} = {compound2.Compound1Name} already exists in the database with same identifier value : {identValueList[0]}");
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddCompound(IDbCommand c, string id, IIdentifier identifier, out ICompound compound)
		{
			try
			{
				int nextCompoundIndex = GetNextCompoundIndex(c);
				AddBaseCompound(c, nextCompoundIndex);
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO CompoundIdentifiers(ciCompoundId,ciIdentifierId,ciValue) VALUES ({nextCompoundIndex},{1},'{nextCompoundIndex.ToString()}')";
				c.CommandText = commandText;
				c.ExecuteNonQuery();
				if (identifier.Id != 1)
				{
					commandText = $"INSERT INTO CompoundIdentifiers(ciCompoundId,ciIdentifierId,ciValue) VALUES ({nextCompoundIndex},{identifier.Id},'{id}')";
					c.CommandText = commandText;
					c.ExecuteNonQuery();
				}
				compound = new CompoundObject(nextCompoundIndex, id, null, null, null, identifier, CompoundType.Compound, InteractionType.Unary, isReverse: false);
				m_IsCompoundsListCached = false;
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
		}

		public void AddCompound(string id, IIdentifier identifier, out ICompound compound)
		{
			compound = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				GetIdentifier(identifier.Name, out var identifier2);
				if (identifier2 == null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The specified identifier does not exist in database.");
				}
				GetCompound(id, identifier, out var compound2);
				if (compound2 != null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("A compound by this name already exists in database.");
				}
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				arrayList.Add(id);
				ValidateIdentifierValues(null, arrayList);
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				int nextCompoundIndex = GetNextCompoundIndex(dbCommand);
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				AddBaseCompound(dbCommand, nextCompoundIndex);
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO CompoundIdentifiers(ciCompoundId,ciIdentifierId,ciValue) VALUES ({nextCompoundIndex},{1},'{nextCompoundIndex.ToString()}')";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				if (identifier.Id != 1)
				{
					commandText = $"INSERT INTO CompoundIdentifiers(ciCompoundId,ciIdentifierId,ciValue) VALUES ({nextCompoundIndex},{identifier.Id},'{id}')";
					dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				}
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				compound = new CompoundObject(nextCompoundIndex, id, null, null, null, identifier, CompoundType.Compound, InteractionType.Unary, isReverse: false);
				m_IsCompoundsListCached = false;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveCompound(ICompound compound)
		{
			DeleteCompound(compound.Id.ToString(), "CompoundIndex");
		}

		public void DeleteCompound(string compoundId, string compoundIdType)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				if (!GetCompoundIndex(compoundId, compoundIdType, out var compoundIndex))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The compound does not exist");
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				DeleteCompound(dbCommand, compoundIndex);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				m_IsCompoundsListCached = false;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetCompound(string id, IIdentifier identifier, out ICompound compound)
		{
			compound = null;
			if (identifier == null)
			{
				GetCompoundForMM(id, null, out compound);
				return;
			}
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				GetIdentifier(identifier.Name, out var identifier2);
				if (identifier2 == null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The specified identifier does not exist in database.");
				}
				IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareGetCompoundIndexCommand(connection);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = identifier.Id;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = id;
				object obj = null;
				obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != null)
				{
					int id2 = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
					compound = new CompoundObject(id2, id, null, null, null, identifier, CompoundType.Compound, InteractionType.Unary, isReverse: false);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetCompoundForMM(string id, IIdentifier compIndexIdentifier, out ICompound compound)
		{
			compound = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
			{
				return;
			}
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareGetCompoundForMMCommand(connection);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = id;
				object obj = null;
				obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != null)
				{
					int num = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
					compound = new CompoundObject(num, Convert.ToString(num), null, null, null, compIndexIdentifier, CompoundType.Compound, InteractionType.Unary, isReverse: false);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetCompoundIndex(string compoundId, string compoundIdType, out int compoundIndex)
		{
			compoundIndex = 0;
			if (compoundIdType == "CompoundIndex")
			{
				compoundIndex = Convert.ToInt32(compoundId);
				return true;
			}
			if (!Database.IdentifierDao.GetIdentifierIndex(compoundIdType, out var identifierIndex, out var _))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return GetCompoundIndexByTypeIndex(compoundId, identifierIndex, out compoundIndex);
		}

		public void GetDatabankCompoundPropertyId(IDatabank databank, int compId, out SortedList dbcIdList)
		{
			dbcIdList = new SortedList();
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (!Database.DatabankDao.GetDatabankIndex(dbCommand, databank.Name, out var databankIndex, out var _))
				{
					return;
				}
				string commandText = $"SELECT * FROM DatabankCompoundProperties WHERE databankId = {databankIndex} AND compId = {compId} ORDER BY dbcId DESC";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				if (!dataReader.Read())
				{
					return;
				}
				do
				{
					int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
					string key = dataReader.GetString(3);
					try
					{
						dbcIdList.Add(key, @int);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				while (dataReader.Read());
				dataReader.Close();
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetCompoundIndexByTypeIndex(string compoundId, int compoundIdTypeId, out int compoundIndex)
		{
			compoundIndex = 0;
			if (compoundIdTypeId == 1)
			{
				compoundIndex = Convert.ToInt32(compoundId);
				return true;
			}
			string text = compoundId.ToUpperInvariant();
			if (compoundIdTypeId == m_LastCompoundIdType && text == m_LastCompoundId)
			{
				compoundIndex = m_LastCompoundIndex;
				return true;
			}
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			bool result = false;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareGetCompoundIndexCommand(connection);
			(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = compoundIdTypeId;
			(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = text;
			dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
			try
			{
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					compoundIndex = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					m_LastCompoundId = text;
					m_LastCompoundIdType = compoundIdTypeId;
					m_LastCompoundIndex = compoundIndex;
					result = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dataReader.Close();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void GetCompoundDuoId(int compound1ID, int compound2ID, bool bAddIfMissing, out int duoId, out bool bReversed)
		{
			duoId = -1;
			int num = compound1ID;
			int num2 = compound2ID;
			bReversed = false;
			if (compound1ID > compound2ID)
			{
				num = compound2ID;
				num2 = compound1ID;
				bReversed = true;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				IDbCommand dbCommand2 = PrepareGetCompoundDuoCommand(connection);
				(dbCommand2.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = num;
				(dbCommand2.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = num2;
				object obj = dbCommand2.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != null)
				{
					duoId = (int)obj;
					return;
				}
				if (bAddIfMissing)
				{
					ICompoundDao compoundDao = Database.CompoundDao;
					dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
					dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
					duoId = compoundDao.GetNextCompoundIndex(dbCommand);
					compoundDao.GetIdentifier("CompoundIndex", out var identifier);
					AddCompound(dbCommand, Convert.ToString(duoId), identifier, out var _);
					dbCommand.CommandText = $"INSERT INTO CompoundDuos(duoId,duoCompound1Id,duoCompound2Id) VALUES ({duoId},{num},{num2})";
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					dbTransaction.Commit();
					return;
				}
				throw new GatewayException("The compound combination could not be found");
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetCompoundTrioId(int compound1Id, int compound2Id, int compound3Id, bool bAddIfMissing, out int trioId)
		{
			trioId = -1;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = PrepareGetCompoundTrioCommand(connection);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = compound1Id;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = compound2Id;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = compound3Id;
				object obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != null)
				{
					trioId = (int)obj;
					return;
				}
				if (bAddIfMissing)
				{
					ICompoundDao compoundDao = Database.CompoundDao;
					trioId = compoundDao.GetNextCompoundIndex(dbCommand);
					dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
					compoundDao.AddBaseCompound(dbCommand, trioId);
					dbCommand.CommandText = $"INSERT INTO CompoundTrios(trioId,trioCompound1Id,trioCompound2Id,trioCompound3Id) VALUES ({trioId},{compound1Id},{compound2Id},{compound3Id})";
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					dbTransaction.Commit();
					return;
				}
				throw new GatewayException("The compound combination could not be found");
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetCompoundCombo(string compound1Name, string compound2Name, string compound3Name, string compound4Name, IIdentifier identifier, CompoundType compoundType, InteractionType interactionType, bool bAddIfMissing, out ICompound compCombo)
		{
			compCombo = null;
			ICompoundDao compoundDao = Database.CompoundDao;
			ICompound compound = null;
			ICompound compound2 = null;
			ICompound compound3 = null;
			int duoId = 0;
			bool bReversed = false;
			switch (compoundType)
			{
			case CompoundType.Compound:
				if (compound1Name != null && compound1Name != "")
				{
					compoundDao.GetCompound(compound1Name, identifier, out compound);
				}
				if (compound2Name != null && compound2Name != "")
				{
					compoundDao.GetCompound(compound2Name, identifier, out compound2);
				}
				if (compound3Name != null && compound3Name != "")
				{
					compoundDao.GetCompound(compound3Name, identifier, out compound3);
				}
				switch (interactionType)
				{
				case InteractionType.Unary:
					if (compound == null)
					{
						throw new GatewayException("The compound does not exist");
					}
					duoId = compound.Id;
					break;
				case InteractionType.Binary:
					if (compound == null || compound2 == null)
					{
						throw new GatewayException("A compound does not exist");
					}
					Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundDuoId(compound.Id, compound2.Id, bAddIfMissing, out duoId, out bReversed);
					break;
				case InteractionType.Ternary:
					if (compound == null || compound2 == null || compound3 == null)
					{
						throw new GatewayException("A compound does not exist");
					}
					Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundTrioId(compound.Id, compound2.Id, compound3.Id, bAddIfMissing, out duoId);
					break;
				}
				compCombo = new CompoundObject(duoId, compound1Name, compound2Name, compound3Name, compound4Name, identifier, compoundType, interactionType, bReversed);
				break;
			case CompoundType.ElectrolytePair:
				Database.ElectrolyteDao.GetCompoundCombo(compound1Name, compound2Name, compound3Name, compound4Name, identifier, interactionType, bAddIfMissing, out compCombo);
				break;
			case CompoundType.UnifacGroup:
				Database.UnifacGroupDao.GetCompoundCombo(compound1Name, compound2Name, interactionType, bAddIfMissing, out compCombo);
				break;
			}
		}

		public int GetNextCompoundIndex(IDbCommand command)
		{
			int result = 1;
			command.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM NextCompoundId";
			object obj = command.ExecuteScalar();
			if (obj != DBNull.Value)
			{
				result = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void DeleteCompound(IDbCommand command, int compoundIndex)
		{
			string[] array = new string[4] { "DELETE FROM Duos WHERE duoCompound1Id = {0} OR duoCompound2Id = {1}", "DELETE FROM Trios WHERE trioCompound1Id = {0} OR trioCompound2Id = {1} OR trioCompound3Id = {2}", "DELETE FROM ElectrolytePairs WHERE pairCationId = {0} OR pairAnionId = {1}", "DELETE FROM Compounds WHERE compId={0}" };
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string commandText = string.Format(array[i], compoundIndex, compoundIndex, compoundIndex);
				command.CommandText = commandText;
				command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			}
		}

		public void GetCompoundIdentifier(string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string outCompoundIdType, out IIdentifierValue identVal)
		{
			identVal = null;
			GetIdentifier(compoundIdType, out var identifier);
			if (identifier == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("No Identifier exists with specified CompoundIdType");
			}
			GetIdentifier(outCompoundIdType, out var identifier2);
			if (identifier2 == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("No Identifier exists with specified out CompoundIdType");
			}
			GetCompound(compoundId, identifier, out var compound);
			if (compound != null && identifier2 != null)
			{
				GetIdentifierValue(compound, identifier2, out identVal);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCompoundIdentifiers(string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string newIdentifierName, string[] newIdentifierList, bool bReplace)
		{
			GetIdentifier(compoundIdType, out var identifier);
			GetIdentifier(newIdentifierName, out var identifier2);
			if (identifier == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("Specified Identifier does not exist in the database.");
			}
			if (identifier2 == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("Specified Identifier does not exist in the database.");
			}
			GetCompound(compoundId, identifier, out var compound);
			if (compound == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("The compound does not exist");
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < newIdentifierList.Length; i++)
			{
				arrayList.Add(newIdentifierList.GetValue(i));
			}
			ValidateIdentifierValues(compound, arrayList);
			int id = compound.Id;
			int identifierIndex;
			bool allowMultiples;
			string[] compoundIdentifierList;
			bool flag = doGetCompoundIdentifier(id, newIdentifierName, out identifierIndex, out allowMultiples, out compoundIdentifierList);
			if (!allowMultiples && newIdentifierList.Length != 0)
			{
				if ((flag && !bReplace) || newIdentifierList.Length > 1)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The identifier does not support multiple values");
				}
				if (flag && newIdentifierList.Length != 0 && compoundIdentifierList[0] != newIdentifierList[0])
				{
					doUpdateCompoundIdentifier("UPDATE CompoundIdentifiers SET ciValue = '{2}' WHERE ciCompoundId = {0} AND ciIdentifierId = {1}", id, identifierIndex, newIdentifierList[0]);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (bReplace)
			{
				doUpdateCompoundIdentifier("DELETE FROM CompoundIdentifiers WHERE ciCompoundId = {0} AND ciIdentifierId = {1}", id, identifierIndex, "");
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < newIdentifierList.Length; j++)
			{
				doUpdateCompoundIdentifier("INSERT INTO CompoundIdentifiers(ciCompoundId,ciIdentifierId,ciValue) VALUES ({0},{1},'{2}')", id, identifierIndex, newIdentifierList[j]);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool doGetCompoundIdentifier(int compoundIndex, string outCompoundIdType, out int identifierIndex, out bool allowMultiples, out string[] compoundIdentifierList)
		{
			compoundIdentifierList = null;
			identifierIndex = 0;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			try
			{
				if (!Database.IdentifierDao.GetIdentifierIndex(outCompoundIdType, out identifierIndex, out allowMultiples))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The identifier does not exist");
				}
				if (identifierIndex == 1)
				{
					compoundIdentifierList = new string[1] { compoundIndex.ToString() };
				}
				else
				{
					dbCommand = PrepareGetIdentifierValueCommand(connection);
					(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = compoundIndex;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = identifierIndex;
					if (!allowMultiples)
					{
						string text = Convert.ToString(dbCommand.ExecuteScalar());
						if (text != null)
						{
							compoundIdentifierList = new string[1] { text };
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
						dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
						while (dataReader.Read())
						{
							string value = dataReader.GetString(0);
							arrayList.Add(value);
						}
						dataReader.Close();
						compoundIdentifierList = new string[arrayList.Count];
						arrayList.CopyTo(compoundIdentifierList);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
			return compoundIdentifierList != null;
		}

		protected virtual void doUpdateCompoundIdentifier(string queryFormat, int compoundIndex, int identifierIndex, string newValue)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				dbCommand.CommandText = string.Format(queryFormat, compoundIndex, identifierIndex, newValue);
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

			command.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM NextIdentifierId";

		public void AddIdentifier(string name, string description, bool allowMultiples, out IIdentifier identifier)
		{
			identifier = null;
			name = name.ToUpperInvariant();
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				GetIdentifier(name, out var identifier2);
				if (identifier2 != null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Specified Identifier already exists in the database.");
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				int nextIdentifierId = GetNextIdentifierId(dbCommand);
				int num = (allowMultiples ? 1 : 0);
				IDbCommand dbCommand2 = PrepareAddIdentifierCommand(connection);
				(dbCommand2.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = nextIdentifierId;
				(dbCommand2.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = name;
				(dbCommand2.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = description;
				(dbCommand2.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter).Value = num;
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand2.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				dbCommand2.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				try
				{
					if (!m_IsIdentifierListCached)
					{
						GetAllIdentifiers(out m_IdentifierList);
					}
					((SortedList)m_IdentifierList).Add(name, new IdentifierObject(nextIdentifierId, name, description, allowMultiples));
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				identifier = (IIdentifier)((SortedList)m_IdentifierList)[name];
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateIdentifier(ref IIdentifier identifier, string name, string description, bool allowMultiples)
		{
			if (identifier == null)
			{
				AddIdentifier(name, description, allowMultiples, out identifier);
				return;
			}
			name = name.ToUpperInvariant();
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				GetIdentifier(identifier.Name, out var identifier2);
				if (identifier2 == null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The specified identifier does not exist");
				}
				IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareUpdateIdentifierCommand(connection);
				int num = (allowMultiples ? 1 : 0);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = identifier2.Id;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = name;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = description;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter).Value = num;
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				try
				{
					if (!m_IsIdentifierListCached)
					{
						GetAllIdentifiers(out m_IdentifierList);
					}
					((SortedList)m_IdentifierList).Remove(identifier.Name);
					((SortedList)m_IdentifierList).Add(name, new IdentifierObject(identifier.Id, name, description, allowMultiples));
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				identifier = (IIdentifier)((SortedList)m_IdentifierList)[name];
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveIdentifier(IIdentifier identifier)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				GetIdentifier(identifier.Name, out var identifier2);
				if (identifier2 == null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Specified identifier does not exist in database.");
				}
				if (identifier.Id == 1)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The CompoundIndex identifier cannot be removed");
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO removed_Identifiers SELECT * FROM Identifiers WHERE identId={identifier.Id}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				DeleteIdentifierFromTable(dbCommand, identifier.Id);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				if (!m_IsIdentifierListCached)
				{
					GetAllIdentifiers(out m_IdentifierList);
				}
				((SortedList)m_IdentifierList).Remove(identifier.Name);
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void DeleteIdentifierFromTable(IDbCommand command, int identifierIndex)
		{
			string commandText = $"DELETE FROM Identifiers WHERE identId={identifierIndex}";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		public void GetAllIdentifiers(out ICollection identifiers)
		{
			SortedList sortedList = new SortedList();
			if (m_IsIdentifierListCached)
			{
				identifiers = m_IdentifierList;
				return;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT identId, identName, identDescription, identAllowMultiples FROM Identifiers";
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
					string text = dataReader.GetString(1);
					string description = dataReader.GetString(2);
					bool boolean = dataReader.GetBoolean(3);
					IIdentifier value = new IdentifierObject(@int, text, description, boolean);
					sortedList.Add(text, value);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				m_IdentifierList = sortedList;
				m_IsIdentifierListCached = true;
				identifiers = sortedList;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetIdentifier(string name, out IIdentifier identifier)
		{
			identifier = null;
			if (!m_IsIdentifierListCached)
			{
				GetAllIdentifiers(out m_IdentifierList);
			}
			IIdentifier identifier2 = (IIdentifier)((SortedList)m_IdentifierList)[name];
			if (identifier2 != null)
			{
				identifier = identifier2;
			}
		}

		public void AddIdentifierValue(ICompound compound, IIdentifier identifier, string[] identifierList, out IIdentifierValue identifierValue)
		{
			identifierValue = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			int i = 0;
			try
			{
				if (!identifier.AllowMultiples)
				{
					if (identifierList.Length != 1)
					{
						throw new GatewayException("Specified identifier does not allow multiple values.");
					}
					GetIdentifierValue(compound, identifier, out var identifierValue2);
					if (identifierValue2 != null)
					{
						string text = "";
						foreach (string value in identifierValue2.ValueList)
						{
							text = value;
						}
						throw new GatewayException($"Can not add : {identifierList[0]} for compound : {compound.Compound1Name} since it already has a value : {text} defined for identifier : {identifier.Name}.");
					}
				}
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				for (int j = 0; j < identifierList.Length; j++)
				{
					arrayList.Add(identifierList.GetValue(j));
				}
				ValidateIdentifierValues(compound, arrayList);
				dbCommand = PrepareAddIdentifierValueCommand(connection);
				IDataParameter dataParameter = dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter;
				dataParameter.Value = compound.Id;
				dataParameter = dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter;
				dataParameter.Value = identifier.Id;
				dataParameter = dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter;
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				for (i = 0; i < identifierList.Length; i++)
				{
					dataParameter.Value = identifierList[i];
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				}
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				identifierValue = new IdentifierValueObject(compound, identifier, identifierList);
				m_IsCompoundsListCached = false;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				GetCompound(compound.Compound1Name, compound.Identifier, out var compound2);
				if (compound2 == null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Specified compound does not exist in the database.");
				}
				string text2 = identifierList[i];
				IIdentifierValue identVal = null;
				GetCompoundIdentifier(text2, identifier.Name, "ALIAS", out identVal);
				if (identVal != null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException($"Can not add {text2} for compound {compound.Compound1Name} as it conflicts with already existing compound {((string[])identVal.ValueList)[0].ToString()}");
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateIdentifierValue(ref IIdentifierValue identifierValue, string[] identifierList)
		{
			if (identifierValue == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("Identifier Value must be specified.");
			}
			if (identifierValue.Identifier.Name.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo("COMPOUNDINDEX") == 0)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("Compound Index Identifier Value can not be modified.");
			}
			if (identifierList == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("New identifer values for update must be specified.");
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < identifierList.Length; i++)
			{
				arrayList.Add(identifierList.GetValue(i));
			}
			ValidateIdentifierValues(identifierValue.Compound, arrayList);
			if (identifierValue.Identifier.AllowMultiples)
			{
				RemoveIdentifierValue(identifierValue);
				AddIdentifierValue(identifierValue.Compound, identifierValue.Identifier, identifierList, out identifierValue);
				return;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = PrepareUpdateIdentifierValueCommand(connection);

		public bool DatabankHasCompound(IDatabank databank, ICompound compound)
		{
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = string.Format("SELECT TOP 1 propertyIndex FROM AvailablePropertyValues WHERE (databankIndex = {0}) AND ( (compoundId = {1}) OR (duo1Id = {1}) OR (duo2Id = {1}) OR (trio1Id = {1}) OR (trio2Id = {1}) OR (trio3Id = {1}) OR (cation1Id = {1}) OR (anion1Id = {1}) OR (cation2Id = {1}) OR (anion2Id = {1})  )", databank.Id, compound.Id);
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

				IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = m_cmdGetDbanksByContentDataTypes.CreateParameter();

				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.Int32;
				m_cmdGetDbanksByContentDataTypes.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
				m_cmdGetDbanksByContentDataTypes.Prepare();
			}
			return m_cmdGetDbanksByContentDataTypes;
		}

		public void EnumerateDatabanks(out IDatabank[] databanks)
		{
			databanks = null;
			if (m_IsDatabankListCached)
			{
				databanks = new IDatabank[m_DatabankListByName.Count];
				m_DatabankListByName.Values.CopyTo(databanks, 0);
				return;
			}
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dataReader = PrepareEnumerateDatabanksCommand(connection).ExecuteReader();
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
					string text = dataReader.GetString(1);
					string baseDatabankName = null;
					string description = null;
					bool boolean = dataReader.GetBoolean(2);
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(3))
					{
						baseDatabankName = dataReader.GetString(3);
					}
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(4))
					{
						description = dataReader.GetString(4);
					}
					Databank value = new Databank(Database, @int, text, boolean, baseDatabankName, description);
					arrayList.Add(value);
					m_DatabankListByName.Add(text, value);
					m_DatabankListById.Add(@int, value);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				if (arrayList.Count != 0)
				{
					databanks = (IDatabank[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(IDatabank));
					m_IsDatabankListCached = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpgradeDatabaseContent(ArrayList userNameAndPwd, BackgroundWorker worker, DoWorkEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand2 = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbConnection dbConnection = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			string format = "SELECT pc.*, p.propName FROM active_DatabankCompounds dc INNER JOIN active_PropValueConst pc ON dc.dbcId = pc.pvcCompoundPropId INNER JOIN CompoundProperty cp ON pc.pvcCompoundPropId = cp.cpId INNER JOIN Properties p ON p.propId = cp.cpPropertyId WHERE (dc.dbcDatabankId = {0})";
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				int count = Databanks.Count;
				int num = -1;
				int num2 = -1;
				string text = "";
				string text2 = "";
				int num3 = 0;
				int num4 = 0;
				string text3 = "";
				string text4 = "";
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					text3 = "Databank : " + ((IDatabank)Databanks.GetByIndex(i)).Name.ToString();
					worker.ReportProgress(num4, text3);
					dbConnection = GetNewConnection(Database, userNameAndPwd[0].ToString(), userNameAndPwd[1].ToString());
					dbCommand2 = PrepapreUpgradeDatabaseContentCommand(dbConnection);
					dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
					dbCommand.CommandText = string.Format(format, ((IDatabank)Databanks.GetByIndex(i)).Id);
					dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
					while (dataReader.Read())
					{
						if (worker.CancellationPending)
						{
							eventArgs.Cancel = true;
							dbConnection?.Close();
							dbCommand2?.Dispose();
							dbCommand?.Dispose();
							if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
							{
								dataReader.Close();
							}
							if (flag)
							{
								connection.Close();
							}
							return;
						}
						num = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
						num2 = dataReader.GetInt32(1);
						text = Database.Decrypt(dataReader.GetString(2), Database.Version);
						text4 = dataReader.GetString(3);
						text2 = Database.EncryptVal(text, text4, Database.Version);
						(dbCommand2.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = text2;
						(dbCommand2.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = num;
						(dbCommand2.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = num2;
						dbCommand2.ExecuteNonQuery();
					}
					dataReader.Close();
					dbConnection?.Close();
					dbCommand2?.Dispose();
					dbCommand?.Dispose();
					if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
					{
						dataReader.Close();
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						connection.Close();
					}
					num4 = (int)((float)(i + 1) / (float)count * 100f);
					if (num3 < num4)
					{
						num3 = num4;
						worker.ReportProgress(num4, "");
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbConnection?.Close();
				dbCommand2?.Dispose();
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool SetTokens(string companyLicMgrStr, string vendorLicMgrStr, bool forViewer, bool forSimulator, string thirdPartyPwd)
		{
			string text = "";
			string arg = "";
			string text2 = "";
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			if (connection == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				text2 = ((!forViewer) ? "+" : "ATVIEWER+");
				text2 = ((!forSimulator) ? (text2 + "+") : (text2 + "ATSIMULATOR+"));
				text2 = ((!(thirdPartyPwd != "") && thirdPartyPwd == null) ? (text2 + "+") : (text2 + thirdPartyPwd));
				int dbIdentity = ((!(Database.OriginalDbId != "") || Database.OriginalDbId == null) ? Database.DatabaseIdentity : Convert.ToInt32(Database.OriginalDbId));
				if (vendorLicMgrStr == null || !(vendorLicMgrStr != ""))
				{
					text = ((companyLicMgrStr == null || !(companyLicMgrStr != "")) ? Database.CreateToken(1, dbIdentity, "", text2, Database.Version) : Database.CreateToken(1, dbIdentity, companyLicMgrStr, text2, Database.Version));
				}
				else
				{
					text = ((companyLicMgrStr == null || !(companyLicMgrStr != "")) ? Database.CreateToken(1, dbIdentity, vendorLicMgrStr, text2, Database.Version) : Database.CreateToken(1, dbIdentity, companyLicMgrStr, text2, Database.Version));
					arg = Database.CreateToken(2, dbIdentity, vendorLicMgrStr, text2, Database.Version);
				}
				string commandText = $"UPDATE Configuration SET confToken1 = '{text}', confToken2 = '{arg}'";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateDatabank(string name, string description)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				int databankIndex = 0;
				bool databankIsLocked = false;
				if (!GetDatabankIndex(dbCommand, name, out databankIndex, out databankIsLocked))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The databank does not exist");
				}
				if (databankIndex == 1)
				{
					throw new GatewayException($"The {name} databank cannot be changed");
				}
				string commandText = string.Format("UPDATE Databanks SET dbDescription={1} WHERE dbId={0}", databankIndex, Database.ToSqlStringLiteral(description));
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				if (m_IsDatabankListCached)
				{
					((Databank)DatabanksByName[name]).Description = description;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AddDatabank(string name, bool dbIsLocked, string baseDatabankName, string description, out IDatabank dbank)
		{
			dbank = null;
			string[] array = new string[0];
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				int databankIndex = 0;
				if (GetDatabankIndex(dbCommand, name, out databankIndex, out var databankIsLocked))
				{
					return false;
				}
				int databankIndex2 = 0;
				if (baseDatabankName != null && baseDatabankName != "" && !GetDatabankIndex(dbCommand, baseDatabankName, out databankIndex2, out databankIsLocked))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The base databank does not exist");
				}
				databankIndex = getNextDatabankIndex(dbCommand);
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				int num = (dbIsLocked ? 1 : 0);
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO Databanks(dbId, dbName, dbIsLocked, dbBaseDatabank, dbDescription) VALUES ({databankIndex}, {Database.ToSqlStringLiteral(name)}, {num}, {Database.ToSqlStringLiteral(baseDatabankName)}, {Database.ToSqlStringLiteral(description)})";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				if (baseDatabankName != null && baseDatabankName != "")
				{
					string[] array2 = array;
					for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
					{
						commandText = string.Format(array2[i], databankIndex, databankIndex2);
						dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
						dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					}
				}
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				Databank databank = new Databank(Database, databankIndex, name, dbIsLocked, baseDatabankName, description);
				try
				{
					if (m_IsDatabankListCached)
					{
						DatabanksByName.Add(name, databank);
						Databanks.Add(databankIndex, databank);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				dbank = databank;
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetDatabank(IDbCommand command, int databankIndex, out string databankName, out bool databankIsLocked, out string baseDatabankName, out string databankDescription)
		{
			databankName = null;
			databankIsLocked = false;
			baseDatabankName = null;
			databankDescription = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			try
			{
				string commandText = $"SELECT dbName, dbIsLocked, dbBaseDatabank, dbDescription FROM Databanks WHERE dbId={databankIndex}";
				command.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = command.ExecuteReader();
				if (!dataReader.Read())
				{
					return false;
				}
				databankName = dataReader.GetString(0);
				databankIsLocked = Convert.ToBoolean(dataReader.GetValue(1));
				if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(1))
				{
					baseDatabankName = dataReader.GetString(2);
				}
				if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(2))
				{
					databankDescription = dataReader.GetString(3);
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetDatabankIndex(IDbCommand command, string databankName, out int databankIndex, out bool databankIsLocked)
		{
			string text = databankName.ToUpperInvariant();
			databankIndex = 0;
			databankIsLocked = false;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			try
			{
				string commandText = $"SELECT dbId,dbIsLocked FROM Databanks WHERE UPPER(dbName)='{text}'";
				command.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = command.ExecuteReader();
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					databankIndex = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					databankIsLocked = Convert.ToBoolean(dataReader.GetValue(1));
					m_LastDatabankName = text;
					m_LastDatabankId = databankIndex;
					m_LastDatabankIsLocked = databankIsLocked;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		}

		private void deleteDatabank(IDbCommand command, int databankIndex)
		{
			string commandText = $"DELETE FROM active_CompoundProperty WHERE cpId IN (SELECT dbcCompoundPropId FROM DatabankCompounds WHERE dbcCompoundPropId IN (SELECT dbcCompoundPropId FROM DatabankCompounds WHERE dbcDatabankId={databankIndex}) GROUP BY dbcCompoundPropId HAVING COUNT(dbcCompoundPropId)=1)";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			commandText = $"DELETE FROM Databanks WHERE dbId={databankIndex}";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		private void getIdentifiersOfCompoundsWithData(IDbCommand command, int databankIndex, IDictionary compounds, IDictionary compoundNames, IDictionary compoundAliases)
		{
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			try
			{
				_ = Database.CompoundDao;
				string commandText = $"SELECT * FROM IdentifiersOfCompoundsWithData WHERE dbId = {databankIndex} ORDER BY compoundId";
				command.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = command.ExecuteReader();
				string text = "";
				string text2 = "";
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					int num = -1;
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(1))
					{
						num = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(1));
					}
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(2))
					{
						text = dataReader.GetString(2);
					}
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(3))
					{
						text2 = dataReader.GetString(3);
					}
					if (num != -1 && !compounds.Contains(num))
					{
						if (text != null && !compoundNames.Contains(text))
						{
							compoundNames.Add(text, num);
						}
						if (text2 != null && !compoundAliases.Contains(text2))
						{
							compoundAliases.Add(text2, num);
						}
						compounds.Add(num, Tuple.Create(text, text2));
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetContentDataTypes(IDatabank dbank, out ICollection contentDataTypes)
		{
			contentDataTypes = null;
			string format = "";
			if (dbank.Database.DatabaseVersion == 2006)
			{
				format = "SELECT propInteractionType, COUNT(propName) AS totalProperties FROM DatabankCompoundProperties WHERE (databankId = {0}) GROUP BY propInteractionType ";
			}
			else if (dbank.Database.DatabaseVersion >= 2007)
			{
				format = "SELECT propInteractionType, COUNT(propName) AS totalProperties FROM DatabankCompoundProperties WHERE (databankId = {0}) GROUP BY propInteractionType  UNION SELECT 4 AS propInteractionType, 1 AS totalProperties FROM active_Reactions WHERE (reactnDbankId = {1})";
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = string.Format(format, ((Databank)dbank).Id, ((Databank)dbank).Id);
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					switch (dataReader.GetInt32(0))
					{
					case -1:
						arrayList.Add(ContentDataType.Unknown);
						break;
					case 0:
						arrayList.Add(ContentDataType.PurePropertyData);
						break;
					case 1:
						arrayList.Add(ContentDataType.BinaryPropertyData);
						break;
					case 2:
						arrayList.Add(ContentDataType.TernaryPropertyData);
						break;
					case 3:
						arrayList.Add(ContentDataType.PairPropertyData);
						break;
					case 4:
						arrayList.Add(ContentDataType.ReactionData);
						break;
					}
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				contentDataTypes = arrayList;
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetDbanksByContentDataTypes(out ICollection pureDatabankCollection, out ICollection binaryDatabankCollection, out ICollection ternaryDatabankCollection, out ICollection pairDatabankCollection, out ICollection reactionDatabankCollection)
		{
			pureDatabankCollection = null;

				flag = true;
			}
			try

				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)

					dataParameter.Value = i;
					dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
					while (dataReader.Read())

							break;
						case 2:
							arrayList3.Add(value);
							break;
						case 3:
							arrayList4.Add(value);
							break;
						}
					}
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				if (arrayList.Count > 0)
				{
					pureDatabankCollection = arrayList;
				}
				if (arrayList2.Count > 0)
				{
					binaryDatabankCollection = arrayList2;
				}
				if (arrayList3.Count > 0)
				{
					ternaryDatabankCollection = arrayList3;
				}
				if (arrayList4.Count > 0)
				{
					pairDatabankCollection = arrayList4;
				}
				if (arrayList5.Count > 0)
				{
					reactionDatabankCollection = arrayList5;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}
