		private IDbConnection GetNewConnection(IDatabase dbase, string uname, string pwd)
		{
			string text = "Pooling=False;";
			text = text + "Data Source=" + dbase.DataSource + ";";
			text = text + "Initial Catalog='" + dbase.Alias + "';";
			if (uname == null || uname == "")
			{
				text += "Integrated Security=SSPI;";
			}
			else
			{
				text = text + "User ID=" + uname + ";";
				if (pwd != null && pwd != "")
				{
					text = text + "Password=" + pwd + ";";
				}
			}
			string error = string.Empty;
			IDbConnection newConnection = GetNewConnection(text, out error, dbase.DBProvider);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
			{
				text += "Integrated Security=true;";
				newConnection = GetNewConnection(text, out error, dbase.DBProvider);
			}
			return newConnection;
		}

		private IDbConnection GetNewConnection(string connectionstring, out string error, string dbprovider)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DbConnection dbConnection = null;
			error = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				if (dbprovider.ToLower() == "postgres")
				{
					dbConnection = (DbConnection)new NpgsqlConnection(connectionstring);
				}
				else if (!(dbprovider.ToLower() == "sqlite"))
				{
					dbConnection = (DbConnection)new SqlConnection(connectionstring);
				}
				dbConnection.Open();
			}
			catch (GatewayException ex)
			{
				error = ((ex.InnerException != null) ? ex.InnerException.Message : ex.Message);
				dbConnection = null;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				error = ((ex2.InnerException != null) ? ex2.InnerException.Message : ex2.Message);
				dbConnection = null;
			}
			return dbConnection;
		}
	}
	internal interface IElectrolyteDao
	{
		void GetCompoundCombo(string compound1Name, string compound2Name, string compound3Name, string compound4Name, IIdentifier identifier, InteractionType interactionType, bool bAddIfMissing, out ICompound compoundCombo);
	}
	internal abstract class ElectrolyteDao : IElectrolyteDao
	{
		private IDbCommand m_cmdGetElectrolytePair;

		protected abstract Database Database { get; }

		private IDbCommand prepareGetElectrolytePairCommand(IDbConnection dbc)
		{
			if (m_cmdGetElectrolytePair == null || m_cmdGetElectrolytePair.Connection != dbc)
			{
				m_cmdGetElectrolytePair = dbc.CreateCommand();
				m_cmdGetElectrolytePair.CommandText = "SELECT pairId FROM ElectrolytePairs WHERE pairCationId=@cationid AND pairAnionId=@anionid";
				IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = m_cmdGetElectrolytePair.CreateParameter();
				dbDataParameter.ParameterName = "@cationid";
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.Int32;
				m_cmdGetElectrolytePair.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
				dbDataParameter = m_cmdGetElectrolytePair.CreateParameter();
				dbDataParameter.ParameterName = "@anionid";
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.Int32;
				m_cmdGetElectrolytePair.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
				m_cmdGetElectrolytePair.Prepare();
			}
			return m_cmdGetElectrolytePair;
		}

		private bool getElectrolytePairId(int cationId, int anionId, bool bAddIfMissing, out int pairId)
		{
			pairId = -1;
			bool result = false;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand2 = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				IDbCommand dbCommand3 = prepareGetElectrolytePairCommand(connection);
				(dbCommand3.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = cationId;
				(dbCommand3.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = anionId;
				object obj = dbCommand3.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != null)
				{
					pairId = (int)obj;
					result = true;
				}
				else if (bAddIfMissing)
				{
					ICompoundDao compoundDao = Database.CompoundDao;
					compoundDao.GetIdentifier("CompoundIndex", out var identifier);
					dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
					pairId = compoundDao.GetNextCompoundIndex(dbCommand);
					dbCommand2 = connection.CreateCommand();
					dbTransaction = (dbCommand2.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
					compoundDao.AddCompound(dbCommand2, pairId.ToString(), identifier, out var _);
					dbCommand2.CommandText = $"INSERT INTO ElectrolytePairs(pairId,pairCationId,pairAnionId) VALUES ({pairId},{cationId},{anionId})";
					dbCommand2.ExecuteNonQuery();
					dbTransaction.Commit();
					result = true;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				_ = ex.Message;
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbCommand2?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void GetCompoundCombo(string compound1Name, string compound2Name, string compound3Name, string compound4Name, IIdentifier identifier, InteractionType interactionType, bool bAddIfMissing, out ICompound compoundCombo)
		{
			compoundCombo = null;
			ICompoundDao compoundDao = Database.CompoundDao;
			ICompound compound = null;
			ICompound compound2 = null;
			ICompound compound3 = null;
			ICompound compound4 = null;
			int duoId = 0;
			bool bReversed = false;
			if (compound1Name != null && compound1Name != "")
			{
				compoundDao.GetCompound(compound1Name, identifier, out compound);
			}
			if (compound2Name != null && compound2Name != "")
			{
				compoundDao.GetCompound(compound2Name, identifier, out compound2);
			}
			if (interactionType == InteractionType.Pair)
			{
				if (compound3Name != null && compound3Name != "")
				{
					compoundDao.GetCompound(compound3Name, identifier, out compound3);
				}
				if (compound4Name != null && compound4Name != "")
				{
					compoundDao.GetCompound(compound4Name, identifier, out compound4);
				}
			}
			int pairId = 0;
			int pairId2 = 0;
			if (compound != null && compound2 != null)
			{
				getElectrolytePairId(compound.Id, compound2.Id, bAddIfMissing, out pairId);
			}
			else
			{
				pairId = compound?.Id ?? 0;
			}
			if (compound3 != null && compound4 != null)
			{
				getElectrolytePairId(compound3.Id, compound4.Id, bAddIfMissing, out pairId2);
			}
			else
			{
				pairId2 = compound3?.Id ?? 0;
			}
			switch (interactionType)
			{
			case InteractionType.Unary:
				if (pairId == 0)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The compound does not exist");
				}
				duoId = pairId;
				break;
			case InteractionType.Pair:
				if (pairId == 0 || pairId2 == 0)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("A compound does not exist");
				}
				Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundDuoId(pairId, pairId2, bAddIfMissing, out duoId, out bReversed);
				break;
			}
			compoundCombo = new CompoundObject(duoId, compound1Name, compound2Name, compound3Name, compound4Name, identifier, CompoundType.ElectrolytePair, interactionType, bReversed);
		}
	}
	internal interface IIdentifierDao
	{
		void GetIdentifierList(Database database, out SortedList identifiers);

		bool AddIdentifier(Database database, string identifierId, string description, bool allowMultiples);

		void RemoveIdentifier(Database database, string identifierId);

		void DeleteIdentifier(Database database, string identifierId);

		bool GetIdentifierIndex(string identifierName, out int identifierIndex, out bool identifierAllowMultiples);

		int GetNextIdentifierId(IDbCommand command);

		bool FindIdentifier(string identifierName, out IdentifierObject ident_object);
	}
	internal abstract class IdentifierDao : IIdentifierDao
	{
		public const string COMPOUNDINDEX_IDENTIFIER_NAME = "CompoundIndex";

		public const int COMPOUNDINDEX_IDENTIFIER_INDEX = 1;

		private const string SELECT_IDENTIFIERS_SQL = "SELECT identId, identName, identDescription, identAllowMultiples FROM Identifiers";

		private const string INSERT_IDENTIFIER_SQL = "INSERT INTO Identifiers(identId, identName, identDescription, identAllowMultiples) VALUES ({0}, '{1}', '{2}', {3})";

		private const string COPY_IDENTIFIERS_SQL = "INSERT INTO removed_Identifiers SELECT * FROM Identifiers WHERE identId={0}";

		private const string COPY_COMPOUNDIDENTIFIER_SQL = "INSERT INTO removed_CompoundIdentifier SELECT * FROM CompoundIdentifier WHERE cpIdentifierId={0}";

		private const string SELECT_NEXTIDENTIFIERID_SQL = "SELECT id FROM NextIdentifierId";

		private const string DELETE_IDENTIFIER_SQL = "DELETE FROM Identifiers WHERE identId={0}";

		private bool m_IsIdentifierListCached;

		private SortedList m_IdentifierList;

		protected abstract Database Database { get; }

		public IdentifierDao()
		{
			m_IdentifierList = new SortedList();
		}

		public void GetIdentifierList(Database database, out SortedList identifiers)
		{
			identifiers = new SortedList();
			if (m_IsIdentifierListCached)
			{
				identifiers = m_IdentifierList;
				return;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT identId, identName, identDescription, identAllowMultiples FROM Identifiers";
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
					string text = dataReader.GetString(1);
					string description = dataReader.GetString(2);
					bool boolean = dataReader.GetBoolean(3);
					IdentifierObject value = new IdentifierObject(@int, text, description, boolean);
					identifiers.Add(text, value);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				m_IdentifierList = identifiers;
				m_IsIdentifierListCached = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AddIdentifier(Database database, string identifierId, string description, bool allowMultiples)
		{
			identifierId = identifierId.ToUpperInvariant();
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (GetIdentifierIndex(identifierId, out var _, out var _))
				{
					return false;
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				int nextIdentifierId = GetNextIdentifierId(dbCommand);
				int num = (allowMultiples ? 1 : 0);
				dbCommand.CommandText = $"INSERT INTO Identifiers(identId, identName, identDescription, identAllowMultiples) VALUES ({nextIdentifierId}, '{identifierId}', '{description}', {num})";
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				try
				{
					if (!m_IsIdentifierListCached)
					{
						GetIdentifierList(database, out m_IdentifierList);
					}
					m_IdentifierList.Add(identifierId, new IdentifierObject(nextIdentifierId, identifierId, description, allowMultiples));
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveIdentifier(Database database, string identifierId)
		{
			identifierId = identifierId.ToUpperInvariant();
			string[] array = new string[2] { "INSERT INTO removed_Identifiers SELECT * FROM Identifiers WHERE identId={0}", "INSERT INTO removed_CompoundIdentifier SELECT * FROM CompoundIdentifier WHERE cpIdentifierId={0}" };
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				if (!GetIdentifierIndex(identifierId, out var identifierIndex, out var _))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The identifier does not exist");
				}
				if (identifierIndex == 1)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The CompoundIndex identifier cannot be removed");
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string[] array2 = array;
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					string commandText = string.Format(array2[i], identifierIndex);
					dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				}
				DeleteIdentifierFromTable(dbCommand, identifierIndex);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				if (!m_IsIdentifierListCached)
				{
					GetIdentifierList(database, out m_IdentifierList);
				}
				m_IdentifierList.Remove(identifierId);
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void DeleteIdentifier(Database database, string identifierId)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			identifierId = identifierId.ToUpperInvariant();
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				if (!GetIdentifierIndex(identifierId, out var identifierIndex, out var _))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The identifier does not exist");
				}
				if (identifierIndex == 1)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The CompoundIndex identifier cannot be deleted");
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				DeleteIdentifierFromTable(dbCommand, identifierIndex);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				if (!m_IsIdentifierListCached)
				{
					GetIdentifierList(database, out m_IdentifierList);
				}
				m_IdentifierList.Remove(identifierId);
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetIdentifierIndex(string identifierName, out int identifierIndex, out bool identifierAllowMultiples)
		{
			identifierIndex = -1;
			identifierAllowMultiples = false;
			if (identifierName == "CompoundIndex")
			{
				identifierIndex = 1;
				return true;
			}
			string key = identifierName.ToUpperInvariant();
			if (!m_IsIdentifierListCached)
			{
				GetIdentifierList(Database, out m_IdentifierList);
			}
			IdentifierObject identifierObject = (IdentifierObject)m_IdentifierList[key];
			if (identifierObject != null)
			{
				identifierIndex = identifierObject.Id;
				identifierAllowMultiples = identifierObject.AllowMultiples;
			}
			return identifierObject != null;
		}

		public int GetNextIdentifierId(IDbCommand command)
		{
			int result = 1;
			command.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM NextIdentifierId";
			object obj = command.ExecuteScalar();
			if (obj != DBNull.Value)
			{
				result = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void DeleteIdentifierFromTable(IDbCommand command, int identifierIndex)
		{
			string commandText = $"DELETE FROM Identifiers WHERE identId={identifierIndex}";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		public bool FindIdentifier(string identifierName, out IdentifierObject identObj)
		{
			identObj = null;
			if (!m_IsIdentifierListCached)
			{
				GetIdentifierList(Database, out m_IdentifierList);
			}
			IdentifierObject identifierObject = (IdentifierObject)m_IdentifierList[identifierName];
			if (identifierObject != null)
			{
				identObj = identifierObject;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal interface IMolDataDao
	{
		bool AddStructure(int ComponentId, string MolText, int StructureType);

		bool AddStructureByName(string IdValue, string IdType, string MolText, int StructureType);

		bool RemoveStructure(int ComponentId, int StructureType);

		bool RemoveStructureByName(string IdValue, string IdType, int StructureType);

		bool GetStructure(int ComponentId, out string MolText, int StructureType);

		bool GetStructureByName(string IdValue, string IdType, out string MolText, int StructureType);

		bool DeleteStructure(int ComponentId, int StructureType);

		bool DeleteStructureByName(string IdValue, string IdType, int StructureType);
	}
	internal abstract class MolDataDao : IMolDataDao
	{
		protected abstract Database Database { get; }

		private int GetComponentIdByName(string IdValue, string IdType)
		{
			IIdentifierValue identValue = null;
			Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundIdentifier(IdValue, IdType, "CompoundIndex", out identValue);
			if (identValue == null)
			{
				Console.WriteLine("Specified CompoundIdentifier could not be retrieved for following CompoundId: {0} and IdentifierType: {1}\n", IdValue, IdType);
				return 0;
			}
			string[] array = new string[identValue.ValueList.Count];
			identValue.ValueList.CopyTo(array, 0);
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				return Convert.ToInt32(array[0]);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public bool AddStructure(int ComponentId, string MolText, int StructureType)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (GetStructure(ComponentId, out var _, StructureType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				int num = 1;
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM NextMolStructureId";
				object obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != DBNull.Value)
				{
					num = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
				}
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO MolStructure(msId, msCompoundId, msMolText, msStructureType) VALUES ({num}, {ComponentId}, '{MolText}',{StructureType})";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AddStructureByName(string IdValue, string IdType, string MolText, int StructureType)
		{
			int componentIdByName = GetComponentIdByName(IdValue, IdType);
			if (componentIdByName == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return AddStructure(componentIdByName, MolText, StructureType);
		}

		public bool RemoveStructure(int ComponentId, int StructureType)
		{
			string MolText = "";
			bool flag = false;
			if (!GetStructure(ComponentId, out MolText, StructureType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO removed_MolStructure SELECT * FROM MolStructure WHERE msCompoundId = {ComponentId} AND msStructureType = {StructureType}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool RemoveStructureByName(string IdValue, string IdType, int StructureType)
		{
			int componentIdByName = GetComponentIdByName(IdValue, IdType);
			if (componentIdByName == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return RemoveStructure(componentIdByName, StructureType);
		}

		public bool DeleteStructure(int ComponentId, int StructureType)
		{
			string MolText = "";
			bool flag = false;
			if (!GetStructure(ComponentId, out MolText, StructureType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = $"DELETE FROM MolStructure WHERE msCompoundId = {ComponentId} AND msStructureType = {StructureType}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool DeleteStructureByName(string IdValue, string IdType, int StructureType)
		{
			int componentIdByName = GetComponentIdByName(IdValue, IdType);
			if (componentIdByName == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DeleteStructure(componentIdByName, StructureType);
		}

		public bool GetStructure(int ComponentId, out string MolText, int StructureType)
		{
			MolText = "";
			bool flag = false;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = $"SELECT msMolText FROM MolStructure WHERE msCompoundId = {ComponentId} AND msStructureType = {StructureType}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					MolText = dataReader.GetString(0);
				}
				if (MolText == "" || MolText == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool GetStructureByName(string IdValue, string IdType, out string MolText, int StructureType)
		{
			MolText = "";
			int componentIdByName = GetComponentIdByName(IdValue, IdType);
			if (componentIdByName == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!GetStructure(componentIdByName, out MolText, StructureType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public SortedList Properties
		{
			get
			{
				if (m_ArePropListsCached)
				{
					return m_PropListById;
				}
				CachePropertySortedLists();
				return m_PropListById;
			}
		}

		public SortedList PropertiesByName
		{
			get
			{
				if (m_ArePropListsCached)
				{
					return m_PropListByName;

				CachePropertySortedLists();
				return m_PropListByName;
			}
		}

		public PropertyDao()
		{
			m_PropListByName = new SortedList();
			m_PropListById = new SortedList();
			m_UnitrowList = new SortedList();
		}

		private void CachePropertySortedLists()
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList4 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList5 = new ArrayList();
			bool propStatus = false;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (Database.DatabaseVersion != 2006)
				{
					dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT propId, propName, propDescription, propIsGlobal, propType, propElements, propInteractionType, propCompoundType, uomRowId, uomRowName, defaultUOM, propStatus FROM PropertyFieldsAndUOM";
				}
				else
				{
					dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT propId, propName, propDescription, propIsGlobal, propType, propElements, propInteractionType, propCompoundType, uomRowId, uomRowName, defaultUOM FROM PropertyFieldsAndUOM";
				}
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
					string text = dataReader.GetString(1);
					string description = dataReader.GetString(2);
					bool boolean = dataReader.GetBoolean(3);
					PropertyDataType int2 = (PropertyDataType)dataReader.GetInt32(4);
					InteractionType int3 = (InteractionType)dataReader.GetInt32(6);
					CompoundType int4 = (CompoundType)dataReader.GetInt32(7);
					int int5 = dataReader.GetInt32(5);
					if (Database.DatabaseVersion != 2006 && !dataReader.IsDBNull(11))
					{
						propStatus = dataReader.GetBoolean(11);
					}
					PropertyObject propertyObject = null;
					do
					{
						if (dataReader.GetInt32(0) != @int)
						{
							propertyObject = new PropertyObject(@int, text, description, boolean, int2, int3, int4, int5, null, null, null, null, (IUnitRow[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(IUnitRow)), propStatus);
							m_PropListByName.Add(text, propertyObject);
							m_PropListById.Add(@int, propertyObject);
							arrayList.Clear();
							@int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
							text = dataReader.GetString(1);
							description = dataReader.GetString(2);
							boolean = dataReader.GetBoolean(3);
							int2 = (PropertyDataType)dataReader.GetInt32(4);
							int3 = (InteractionType)dataReader.GetInt32(6);
							int4 = (CompoundType)dataReader.GetInt32(7);
							int5 = dataReader.GetInt32(5);
							if (Database.DatabaseVersion != 2006)
							{
								propStatus = false;
								if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(11))
								{
									propStatus = dataReader.GetBoolean(11);
								}
							}
						}
						if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(8))
						{
							int int6 = dataReader.GetInt32(8);
							string unit_rowname = dataReader.GetString(9);
							string default_uom = dataReader.GetString(10);
							UnitRowObject value = new UnitRowObject(int6, unit_rowname, default_uom);
							arrayList.Add(value);
						}
					}
					while (dataReader.Read());
					propertyObject = ((Database.DatabaseVersion == 2006) ? new PropertyObject(@int, text, description, boolean, int2, int3, int4, int5, null, null, null, null, (IUnitRow[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(IUnitRow))) : new PropertyObject(@int, text, description, boolean, int2, int3, int4, int5, null, null, null, null, (IUnitRow[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(IUnitRow)), propStatus));
					m_PropListByName.Add(text, propertyObject);
					m_PropListById.Add(@int, propertyObject);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT propName, propSymmetry, labelIJId, labelJIId, propLabelIJ, propLabelJI FROM PropertySymmetryAndLabels ORDER BY propName, propindex";
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					string text2 = dataReader.GetString(0);
					PropertyObject propertyObject2 = null;
					PropertyObject propertyObject3 = null;
					do
					{
						if (dataReader.GetString(0) != text2)
						{
							propertyObject2 = (PropertyObject)m_PropListByName[text2];
							propertyObject3 = (PropertyObject)m_PropListById[propertyObject2.Id];
							if (propertyObject2 != null)
							{
								propertyObject2.SymmetryList = (int[])arrayList2.ToArray(typeof(int));
								propertyObject2.LabelIJArray = (int[])arrayList3.ToArray(typeof(int));
								propertyObject2.LabelJIArray = (int[])arrayList4.ToArray(typeof(int));
								propertyObject2.LabelList = (string[])arrayList5.ToArray(typeof(string));
							}
							if (propertyObject3 != null)
							{
								propertyObject3.SymmetryList = (int[])arrayList2.ToArray(typeof(int));
								propertyObject3.LabelIJArray = (int[])arrayList3.ToArray(typeof(int));
								propertyObject3.LabelJIArray = (int[])arrayList4.ToArray(typeof(int));
								propertyObject3.LabelList = (string[])arrayList5.ToArray(typeof(string));
							}
							arrayList2.Clear();
							arrayList3.Clear();
							arrayList4.Clear();
							arrayList5.Clear();
						}
						text2 = dataReader.GetString(0);
						arrayList2.Add(dataReader.GetInt32(1));
						arrayList3.Add(dataReader.GetInt32(2));
						arrayList4.Add(dataReader.GetInt32(3));
						string text3 = dataReader.GetString(4);
						string text4 = dataReader.GetString(5);
						if (text3.CompareTo(text4) == 0)
						{
							arrayList5.Add(text3);
							continue;
						}
						arrayList5.Add(text3);
						arrayList5.Add(text4);
					}
					while (dataReader.Read());
					propertyObject2 = (PropertyObject)m_PropListByName[text2];
					propertyObject3 = (PropertyObject)m_PropListById[propertyObject2.Id];
					if (propertyObject2 != null)
					{
						propertyObject2.SymmetryList = (int[])arrayList2.ToArray(typeof(int));
						propertyObject2.LabelIJArray = (int[])arrayList3.ToArray(typeof(int));
						propertyObject2.LabelJIArray = (int[])arrayList4.ToArray(typeof(int));
						propertyObject2.LabelList = (string[])arrayList5.ToArray(typeof(string));
					}
					if (propertyObject3 != null)
					{
						propertyObject3.SymmetryList = (int[])arrayList2.ToArray(typeof(int));
						propertyObject3.LabelIJArray = (int[])arrayList3.ToArray(typeof(int));
						propertyObject3.LabelJIArray = (int[])arrayList4.ToArray(typeof(int));
						propertyObject3.LabelList = (string[])arrayList5.ToArray(typeof(string));
					}
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				if (m_PropListById.Count != 0 && m_PropListByName.Count != 0)
				{
					m_ArePropListsCached = true;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private IDbCommand PrepareAddPropertyEnumerations(IDbConnection dbc)
		{
			if (m_cmdAddPropertyEnumerations == null || m_cmdAddPropertyEnumerations.Connection != dbc)
			{
				m_cmdAddPropertyEnumerations = dbc.CreateCommand();
				m_cmdAddPropertyEnumerations.CommandText = "INSERT INTO active_EnumerationValues(evId, evPropId, evIndex, evValue) VALUES(@evId, @evPropId, @evIndex, @evValue)";
				IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = m_cmdAddPropertyEnumerations.CreateParameter();
				dbDataParameter.ParameterName = "@evId";
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.Int32;
				m_cmdAddPropertyEnumerations.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
				dbDataParameter = m_cmdAddPropertyEnumerations.CreateParameter();

		public void GetPropUnitRowList(Database database, out SortedList unitrowList)
		{
			unitrowList = new SortedList();
			if (m_IsUnitrowListCached)
			{
				unitrowList = m_UnitrowList;
				return;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT Properties.propName, UOM.defaultUOM FROM UOM INNER JOIN PropertyUnitrow ON UOM.uomRowId = PropertyUnitrow.puUnitrow INNER JOIN Properties ON Properties.propId = PropertyUnitrow.puPropertyId";
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					string text = dataReader.GetString(0);
					do
					{
						if (text != dataReader.GetString(0))
						{
							unitrowList.Add(text, arrayList.ToArray());
							arrayList.Clear();
						}
						text = dataReader.GetString(0);
						string value = dataReader.GetString(1);
						arrayList.Add(value);
					}
					while (dataReader.Read());
					unitrowList.Add(text, arrayList.ToArray());
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				m_UnitrowList = unitrowList;
				m_IsUnitrowListCached = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetAllProperties(IDatabank databank, bool bOnlyWithValues, out ICollection properties)
		{
			properties = null;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (!m_ArePropListsCached)
			{
				CachePropertySortedLists();
			}
			if (PropertiesByName.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (databank == null)
			{
				if (!bOnlyWithValues)
				{
					properties = PropertiesByName.Values;
					return;
				}
				dbCommand = PrepareGetAllProperties(connection);
			}
			else
			{
				dbCommand = PrepareGetAllPropertiesOnlyWithValues(connection);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = databank.Id;
			}
			try
			{
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					string key = dataReader.GetString(0);
					arrayList.Add((IProperty)PropertiesByName[key]);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				properties = arrayList;
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddProperty(string name, string description, bool isGlobal, PropertyDataType dataType, InteractionType interactionType, CompoundType compoundType, int elementCount, int[] symmetryList, string[] labelList, IUnitRow[] unitsTypeList, bool propStatus, out IProperty property)
		{
			property = null;
			name = name.ToUpperInvariant();
			PropertyObject propertyObject = new PropertyObject();
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				GetProperty(name, out var property2);
				if (property2 != null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Property by this name already exists in the database.");
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				if (name.CompareTo("HYSIDX") == 0)
				{
					isGlobal = true;
				}
				if (name.CompareTo("EDLIDX") == 0)
				{
					isGlobal = true;
				}
				AddPropertyInternal(dbCommand, propertyObject, name, description, isGlobal, dataType, interactionType, compoundType, elementCount, symmetryList, labelList, unitsTypeList, propStatus);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				if (m_ArePropListsCached)
				{
					Properties.Add(propertyObject.Id, propertyObject);
					PropertiesByName.Add(name, propertyObject);
				}
				property = propertyObject;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddPropertyInternal(IDbCommand c, PropertyObject pobj, string name, string description, bool isGlobal, PropertyDataType dataType, InteractionType interactionType, CompoundType compoundType, int elementCount, int[] symmetryList, string[] labelList, IUnitRow[] unitsTypeList, bool propStatus)
		{
			try
			{
				int nextPropertyId = GetNextPropertyId(c);
				int num = (isGlobal ? 1 : 0);
				int num2 = (propStatus ? 1 : 0);
				IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareAddProperty(c.Transaction, Database.Connection);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = nextPropertyId;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = name;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = description;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter).Value = num;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[4] as IDataParameter).Value = (int)dataType;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[5] as IDataParameter).Value = elementCount;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[6] as IDataParameter).Value = (int)interactionType;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[7] as IDataParameter).Value = (int)compoundType;
				if (Database.DatabaseVersion != 2006)
				{
					(dbCommand.Parameters[8] as IDataParameter).Value = num2;
				}
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				int num3 = 0;
				int[] array = new int[elementCount];
				int[] array2 = new int[elementCount];
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				for (int i = 0; i < elementCount; i++)
				{
					int num4 = -1;
					if (symmetryList != null && symmetryList.Length > i)
					{
						num4 = symmetryList[i];
					}
					int num5 = 0;
					int num6 = 0;
					if (labelList != null)
					{
						string text = labelList[num3];
						num5 = getNextLabeledValueId(c);
						dbCommand = PrepareAddLabeledValue(c.Transaction, Database.Connection);
						(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = num5;
						(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = text;
						dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
						arrayList.Add(text);
						num6 = num5;
						if (num4 != 2 && num4 != -1)
						{
							num6 = getNextLabeledValueId(c);
							string text2 = labelList[++num3];
							dbCommand = PrepareAddLabeledValue(c.Transaction, Database.Connection);
							(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = num6;
							(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = text2;
							dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
							if (text.CompareTo(text2) != 0)
							{
								arrayList.Add(text2);
							}
						}
						num3++;
						array[i] = num5;
						array2[i] = num6;
					}
					int nextPropElementsId = getNextPropElementsId(c);
					dbCommand = PrepareAddPropElements(c.Transaction, Database.Connection);
					(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = nextPropElementsId;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = nextPropertyId;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = i;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter).Value = num4;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[4] as IDataParameter).Value = num5;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[5] as IDataParameter).Value = num6;
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				}
				if (unitsTypeList != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < unitsTypeList.Length; j++)
					{
						int nextPropUnitrowId = getNextPropUnitrowId(c);
						c.CommandText = $"SELECT uomRowId from UOM WHERE uomRowName = '{((UnitRowObject)unitsTypeList[j]).UnitRowName}'";
						int num7 = (int)c.ExecuteScalar();
						dbCommand = PrepareAddPropUnitrow(c.Transaction, Database.Connection);
						(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = nextPropUnitrowId;
						(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = nextPropertyId;
						(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = num7;
						dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					}
				}
				pobj.Id = nextPropertyId;
				pobj.Name = name;
				pobj.Description = description;
				pobj.IsGlobal = isGlobal;
				pobj.DataType = dataType;
				pobj.InteractionType = interactionType;
				pobj.CompoundType = compoundType;
				pobj.ElementCount = elementCount;
				pobj.UnitsTypeList = unitsTypeList;
				pobj.SymmetryList = symmetryList;
				pobj.LabelIJArray = array;
				pobj.LabelJIArray = array2;
				pobj.LabelList = (string[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(string));
				pobj.Status = propStatus;
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateProperty(ref IProperty property, string name, string description, bool isGlobal, PropertyDataType dataType, InteractionType interactionType, CompoundType compoundType, int elementCount, int[] symmetryList, string[] labelList, IUnitRow[] unitsTypeList)
		{
			if (property == null)
			{
				AddProperty(name, description, isGlobal, dataType, interactionType, compoundType, elementCount, symmetryList, labelList, unitsTypeList, property.Status, out property);
				return;
			}
			name = name.ToUpperInvariant();
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				PropertyObject propertyObject = (PropertyObject)PropertiesByName[property.Name];
				if (propertyObject == null)
				{
					new GatewayException("Specified property doesn't exist in the database.");
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				if (property.ElementCount != elementCount || !CompareIntArrays(property.SymmetryList, symmetryList) || property.IsGlobal != isGlobal || property.DataType != dataType || property.InteractionType != interactionType || property.CompoundType != compoundType || !CompareIUnitRowArrays(property.UnitsTypeList, unitsTypeList))
				{
					deleteProperty(dbCommand, property.Id);
					AddPropertyInternal(dbCommand, propertyObject, name, description, isGlobal, dataType, interactionType, compoundType, elementCount, symmetryList, labelList, unitsTypeList, property.Status);
				}
				else if (property.Name != name || property.Description != description || property.LabelList != labelList)
				{
					UpdatePropertyAndLabeledValueTables(dbCommand, propertyObject, propertyObject.Id, name, description, labelList);
				}
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				if (m_ArePropListsCached)
				{
					PropertiesByName.Remove(property.Name);
					PropertiesByName.Add(propertyObject.Name, propertyObject);
					Properties.Remove(property.Id);
					Properties.Add(propertyObject.Id, propertyObject);
				}
				property = propertyObject;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CompareIUnitRowArrays(IUnitRow[] a, IUnitRow[] b)
		{
			if (a.Length != b.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < a.Length; i++)
			{
				if (((UnitRowObject)a[i]).UnitRowName.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo(((UnitRowObject)b[i]).UnitRowName.ToUpperInvariant()) != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CompareIntArrays(int[] a, int[] b)
		{
			if (a.Length != b.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < a.Length; i++)
			{
				if (a[i] != b[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdatePropertyAndLabeledValueTables(IDbCommand c, PropertyObject po, int propId, string name, string description, string[] labelList)
		{
			try
			{
				IDataParameter dataParameter = c.CreateParameter();
				dataParameter.ParameterName = "@name";
				dataParameter.DbType = DbType.String;
				c.Parameters.Add(dataParameter);
				dataParameter.Value = name;
				dataParameter = c.CreateParameter();
				dataParameter.ParameterName = "@description";
				dataParameter.DbType = DbType.String;
				c.Parameters.Add(dataParameter);
				dataParameter.Value = description;
				dataParameter = c.CreateParameter();
				dataParameter.ParameterName = "@id";
				dataParameter.DbType = DbType.Int32;
				c.Parameters.Add(dataParameter);
				dataParameter.Value = propId;
				c.CommandText = "UPDATE Properties SET propName = @name, propDescription = @description WHERE propId = @id";
				c.ExecuteNonQuery();
				po.Name = name;
				po.Description = description;
				if (po.LabelList == labelList)
				{
					return;
				}
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(po.LabelIJArray);
				for (int i = 0; i < po.LabelJIArray.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!arrayList.Contains(po.LabelJIArray[i]))
					{
						arrayList.Add(po.LabelJIArray[i]);
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < po.LabelList.Length; j++)
				{
					if (po.LabelList[j] != labelList[j])
					{
						c.CommandText = "UPDATE LabeledValue SET lvLabel = @lvlabel WHERE lvId = @lvid";
						dataParameter = c.CreateParameter();
						dataParameter.ParameterName = "@lvid";
						dataParameter.DbType = DbType.Int32;
						c.Parameters.Add(dataParameter);
						dataParameter.Value = arrayList[j];
						dataParameter = c.CreateParameter();
						dataParameter.ParameterName = "@lvlabel";
						dataParameter.DbType = DbType.String;
						c.Parameters.Add(dataParameter);
						dataParameter.Value = labelList[j];
						c.ExecuteNonQuery();
					}
				}
				po.LabelList = labelList;
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
		}

		public void RemoveProperty(IProperty property)
		{
			string text = property.Name.ToUpperInvariant();
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				GetProperty(text, out var property2);
				if (property2 == null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Specified property does not exist in the database.");
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				deleteProperty(dbCommand, property2.Id);
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				if (m_ArePropListsCached)
				{
					Properties.Remove(property.Id);
					PropertiesByName.Remove(text);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetProperty(string name, out IProperty property)
		{
			property = null;
			name = name.ToUpperInvariant();
			PropertyObject propertyObject = (PropertyObject)PropertiesByName[name];
			if (propertyObject != null)
			{
				property = propertyObject;
			}
		}

			if (property != null)

				propertyIndex = property.Id;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private ArrayList getNextEnumerationId(IDbCommand command, int propid)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			int num = 1;
			int num2 = 0;
			command.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM NextEnumerationId";
			object obj = command.ExecuteScalar();
			if (obj != DBNull.Value)
			{
				num = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
			}
			arrayList.Add(num);
			string format = "SELECT MAX(evIndex) FROM active_EnumerationValues WHERE evPropId = {0}";
			command.CommandText = string.Format(format, propid);
			obj = command.ExecuteScalar();
			num2 = ((obj != DBNull.Value) ? (Convert.ToInt32(obj) + 1) : 0);
			arrayList.Add(num2);
			return arrayList;
		}

		public void AddPropertyEnumerations(string propertyName, ICollection enumValues)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand2 = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				GetProperty(propertyName, out var property);
				if (property == null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Specified property does not exist in the database.");
				}
				if (property.DataType != PropertyDataType.Enumeration)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Specified property must be of Enumeration data type.");
				}
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				GetPropertyEnumerations(propertyName, out var enumValues2);
				if (enumValues2 != null)
				{
					ArrayList arrayList = (ArrayList)enumValues2;
					for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
					{
						if (!hashtable.Contains(arrayList[i]))
						{
							hashtable.Add(arrayList[i], i);
						}
					}
				}
				dbCommand = PrepareAddPropertyEnumerations(connection);
				ArrayList arrayList2 = (ArrayList)enumValues;
				dbCommand2 = connection.CreateCommand();
				for (int j = 0; j < arrayList2.Count; j++)
				{
					if (!hashtable.ContainsKey(arrayList2[j]))
					{
						ArrayList nextEnumerationId = getNextEnumerationId(dbCommand2, property.Id);
						(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = (int)nextEnumerationId[0];
						(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = property.Id;
						(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = (int)nextEnumerationId[1];
						(dbCommand.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter).Value = arrayList2[j].ToString();
						dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbCommand2?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemovePropertyEnumerations(IProperty property, ICollection enumToRemove)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (property.DataType != PropertyDataType.Enumeration)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Specified property must be of Enumeration data type.");
				}
				if (enumToRemove == null)
				{
					dbCommand = PrepareRemoveAllPropertyEnumerations(connection);
					(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = property.Id;
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					return;
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				ArrayList arrayList = (ArrayList)enumToRemove;
				string text = "(";
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					text = ((i != arrayList.Count - 1) ? (text + "'" + arrayList[i].ToString() + "',") : (text + "'" + arrayList[i].ToString() + "')"));
				}
				dbCommand.CommandText = "DELETE FROM active_EnumerationValues WHERE evPropId = " + property.Id + " AND evValue IN " + text;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetPropertyEnumerations(string name, out ICollection enumValues)
		{
			enumValues = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				GetProperty(name, out var property);
				if (property == null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Specified property does not exist in the database.");
				}
				if (property.DataType != PropertyDataType.Enumeration)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Specified property must be of Enumeration data type.");
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT evValue FROM active_EnumerationValues WHERE evPropId = " + property.Id;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				string text = "";
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					text = dataReader.GetString(0);
					arrayList.Add(text);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				enumValues = arrayList;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePropertyEnumerations(IProperty prop, ICollection newEnumValues)
		{
			RemovePropertyEnumerations(prop, null);
			AddPropertyEnumerations(prop.Name, newEnumValues);
		}
	}

		private IDbCommand PrepareAddCompoundPropertyCommand(IDbTransaction tx, IDbConnection dbc)
		{
			if (m_cmdAddCompoundProperty != null)
			{
				m_cmdAddCompoundProperty.Transaction = tx;
			}
			if (m_cmdAddCompoundProperty == null || m_cmdAddCompoundProperty.Connection != dbc)
			{
				m_cmdAddCompoundProperty = dbc.CreateCommand();
				m_cmdAddCompoundProperty.Transaction = tx;
				m_cmdAddCompoundProperty.CommandText = "INSERT INTO CompoundProperty(cpId, cpCompoundId, cpPropertyId) VALUES(@cpid, @cpcompoundid, @cppropertyid)";
				IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = m_cmdAddCompoundProperty.CreateParameter();
				dbDataParameter.ParameterName = "@cpid";
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.Int32;
				m_cmdAddCompoundProperty.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
				dbDataParameter = m_cmdAddCompoundProperty.CreateParameter();
				dbDataParameter.ParameterName = "@cpcompoundid";
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.Int32;
				m_cmdAddCompoundProperty.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
				dbDataParameter = m_cmdAddCompoundProperty.CreateParameter();
				dbDataParameter.ParameterName = "@cppropertyid";

		private void AppendCompoundFilter(ICollection compoundFilter, ref string query, string colName, ref bool endsWithWhere)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(query);
			if (compoundFilter != null && compoundFilter.Count > 0)
			{
				if (endsWithWhere)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(colName);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN (");
					endsWithWhere = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("AND ");
					stringBuilder.Append(colName);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN (");
				}
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ICompound item in compoundFilter)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(item.Id.ToString());
					flag = true;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(") ");
			}
			query = stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void AppendDatabankFilter(ICollection databankFilter, ref string query, string colName, ref bool endsWithWhere)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(query);
			if (databankFilter != null && databankFilter.Count > 0)
			{
				if (endsWithWhere)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(colName);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN (");
					endsWithWhere = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("AND ");
					stringBuilder.Append(colName);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN (");
				}
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (IDatabank item in databankFilter)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(item.Id.ToString());
					flag = true;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(") ");
			}
			query = stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void AppendPropertyFilter(ICollection propertyFilter, ref string query, string colName, ref bool endsWithWhere)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(query);
			if (propertyFilter != null && propertyFilter.Count > 0)
			{
				if (endsWithWhere)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(colName);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN (");
					endsWithWhere = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("AND ");
					stringBuilder.Append(colName);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN (");
				}
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (IProperty item in propertyFilter)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(item.Id.ToString());
					flag = true;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(") ");
			}
			query = stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void AppendCompoundFilterBinary(ICollection compound1Filter, ICollection compound2Filter, ref string query, string targetCol1, string targetCol2, ref bool endsWithWhere)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(query);
			if (compound1Filter != null && compound1Filter.Count > 0)
			{
				if (endsWithWhere)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" ( ");
					stringBuilder.Append(targetCol1);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN ( ");
					endsWithWhere = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" AND ( ");
					stringBuilder.Append(targetCol1);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN ( ");
				}
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ICompound item in compound1Filter)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(item.Id.ToString());
					flag = true;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(" )) ");
			}
			if (compound2Filter != null && compound2Filter.Count > 0)
			{
				if (endsWithWhere)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" ( ");
					stringBuilder.Append(targetCol2);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN ( ");
					endsWithWhere = false;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" AND ( ");
					stringBuilder.Append(targetCol2);
					stringBuilder.Append(" IN ( ");
				}
				bool flag2 = false;
				foreach (ICompound item2 in compound2Filter)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(item2.Id.ToString());
					flag2 = true;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(" )) ");
			}
			query = stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void BuildAvailableListUnary(IDbCommand c, SortedList allProperties, SortedList allDatabanks, SortedList workingCompounds, ICollection propertyFilter, ICollection databankFilter, ICollection compoundFilter, out ICollection propertyList, out ICollection databankList, out ICollection compoundList)
		{
			string query = "SELECT NULL AS propertyIndex, databankIndex, NULL AS compoundId FROM AvailablePropertyValues WHERE propInteractionType = 0 ";
			bool endsWithWhere = false;
			AppendCompoundFilter(compoundFilter, ref query, "compoundId", ref endsWithWhere);
			AppendPropertyFilter(propertyFilter, ref query, "propertyIndex", ref endsWithWhere);
			query += "UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS propertyIndex, NULL AS databankIndex, compoundId FROM AvailablePropertyValues WHERE propInteractionType = 0 ";
			endsWithWhere = false;
			AppendCompoundFilter(workingCompounds.Values, ref query, "compoundId", ref endsWithWhere);
			AppendDatabankFilter(databankFilter, ref query, "databankIndex", ref endsWithWhere);
			AppendPropertyFilter(propertyFilter, ref query, "propertyIndex", ref endsWithWhere);
			query += "UNION ALL SELECT propertyIndex, NULL AS databankIndex, NULL AS compoundId FROM AvailablePropertyValues WHERE propInteractionType = 0 ";
			endsWithWhere = false;

		private void GetGlobalPropertyValue(ICompound compound, IProperty property, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = null;
			int id = compound.Id;
			if (property == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int id2 = property.Id;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (property.DataType == PropertyDataType.Enumeration)
				{
					dbCommand = PrepareGetEnumerationPropertyValueCommand(connection);
				}
				else if (property.DataType == PropertyDataType.LongText)
				{
					dbCommand = PrepareGetLongTextValueCommand(connection);
				}
				else if (property.DataType == PropertyDataType.Numeric)
				{
					dbCommand = PrepareGetNumericValueCommand(connection);
				}
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = id;
				(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = id2;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					if (property.DataType == PropertyDataType.Numeric)
					{
						arrayList.Add(Database.DecryptVal(dataReader.GetString(0), property.Name, Database.Version));
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList.Add(dataReader.GetString(0));
					}
				}
				if (arrayList.Count > 0)
				{
					Array array = new string[arrayList.Count];
					arrayList.CopyTo(array);
					propertyValue = new PropertyValueObject(null, compound, property, array);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private int getCompoundPropertyIdToReuse(IDataReader dr, IProperty property, object Value)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = -1;
			try
			{
				if (property.DataType == PropertyDataType.Numeric)
				{
					if (Value.GetType().Equals(typeof(double)))
					{
						num = (double)Value;
						if (!dr.Read())
						{
							return -1;
						}
						double num3 = 0.0;
						if (!dr.IsDBNull(2))
						{
							num3 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(dr.GetString(2), property.Name, Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						}
						if (num == num3)
						{
							return Convert.ToInt32(dr.GetValue(0));
						}
						return -1;
					}
					Array array = (Array)Value;
					ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
					Array array2 = Array.CreateInstance(typeof(double), array.Length);
					while (dr.Read())
					{
						if (!dr.IsDBNull(0))
						{
							num2 = Convert.ToInt32(dr.GetValue(0));
						}
						do
						{
							if (!dr.IsDBNull(0) && num2 != Convert.ToInt32(dr.GetValue(0)))
							{
								arrayList.CopyTo(array2, 0);
								if (Equals(array, array2))
								{
									return num2;
								}
								arrayList.Clear();
								Array.Clear(array2, 0, array2.Length);
								if (!dr.IsDBNull(2))
								{
									arrayList.Add(Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(dr.GetString(2), property.Name, Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
								}
							}
							else if (!dr.IsDBNull(2))
							{
								arrayList.Add(Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(dr.GetString(2), property.Name, Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
							}
							if (!dr.IsDBNull(0))
							{
								num2 = Convert.ToInt32(dr.GetValue(0));
							}
						}
						while (dr.Read());
					}
				}
				else if (property.DataType != PropertyDataType.Enumeration && property.DataType != PropertyDataType.LongText)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("PropertyDataType specified is not supported.");
				}
				dr.Close();
				return -1;
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dr != null && !dr.IsClosed)
				{
					dr.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemovePropertyValue(IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbTransaction = connection.BeginTransaction();
				if (!propertyValue.Property.IsGlobal)
				{
					dbCommand = PrepareRemoveCompoundPropertyCommand(dbTransaction, connection);
					(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = propertyValue.Compound.Id;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = propertyValue.Property.Id;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = propertyValue.Databank.Id;
					try
					{
						if (dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery() == 1)
						{
							dbTransaction.Commit();
							return;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					dbCommand = PrepareRemoveDatabankCompounds(dbTransaction, connection);
					(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = propertyValue.Databank.Id;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = propertyValue.Compound.Id;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter).Value = propertyValue.Property.Id;
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				}
				else
				{
					dbCommand = PrepareRemoveGlobalCompoundProperty(dbTransaction, connection);
					(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = propertyValue.Compound.Id;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = propertyValue.Property.Id;
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				}
				dbTransaction.Commit();
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePropertyValue(IPropertyValue previousValue, bool bCondensedForViewing, object newValue, string uncertainty, string uncertaintySource, string dataSourceType, ICitation citation, string notes, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = null;
			try
			{
				if (previousValue.Notes != null)
				{
					Database.CitationsDao.DeleteNote((Databank)previousValue.Databank, previousValue.Compound.Id.ToString(), "CompoundIndex", previousValue.Property.Name);
				}
				if (previousValue.Uncertainty != null || previousValue.UncertaintySource != null || previousValue.DataSourceType != null)
				{
					Database.CitationsDao.DeleteDataInfo((Databank)previousValue.Databank, previousValue.Compound.Id.ToString(), "CompoundIndex", previousValue.Property.Name);
				}
				if (previousValue.Citation != null)
				{
					Database.CitationsDao.DeleteCitationAssociation((Databank)previousValue.Databank, previousValue.Compound.Id.ToString(), "CompoundIndex", previousValue.Property.Name);
				}
				RemovePropertyValue(previousValue);
				AddPropertyValue(previousValue.Databank, previousValue.Compound, previousValue.Property, newValue, uncertainty, uncertaintySource, dataSourceType, citation, notes, out propertyValue);
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
		}

		public void FindForAPlus(ICollection searchSource, string identSearchString, int dbankContentDataType, out int compid, out string compname, out string compalias)

					return;
				}

					(dbCommand3.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = identSearchString;

					break;
				}

				{

					(dbCommand2.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = array[0].Id;
					(dbCommand2.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = identSearchString;
					dataReader = dbCommand2.ExecuteReader();
					break;
				}
				case 3:
				{
					IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareFindForAPlus_PureAndBinaryCommand(connection);
					(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = array[0].Id;
					(dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter).Value = identSearchString;
					dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();

				}
				}
				int num = -1;
				int num2 = -1;

				string text2 = "";

				{
					num = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(1));
					switch (Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(2)))
					{
					case 2:
						text = Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(3));
						break;
					case 3:
						text2 = Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(3));
						break;
					}
				}

		}

		public new static bool Equals(object objA, object objB)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (objA != null && objB != null)
			{
				if (objA.GetType().IsArray && objB.GetType().IsArray)
				{
					Array array = (Array)objA;
					Array array2 = (Array)objB;
					if (array.Length == array2.Length)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
						{
							object value = array.GetValue(i);
							object value2 = array2.GetValue(i);
							if (((value == null) ^ (value2 == null)) || (value != null && !value.Equals(value2)))
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
						result = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					result = objA.Equals(objB);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = object.Equals(objA, objB);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool DoesItMatchTheConstraint(SortedList fromAndToValues, IPropertyValue[] propValues)
		{
			if (propValues == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool result = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < propValues.Length; i++)
			{
				PropertyValueObject propertyValueObject = (PropertyValueObject)propValues[i];
				double num = (double)propertyValueObject.Value;
				double[] array = (double[])fromAndToValues[propertyValueObject.Property.Name];
				_ = array[0];
				_ = array[1];
				if (array[0] != 1E+35 && array[1] != 1E+35 && (array[0] > num || num > array[1]))
				{
					result = false;
				}
				else if (array[0] == 1E+35 && array[1] != 1E+35 && num > array[1])
				{
					result = false;
				}
				else if (array[0] != 1E+35 && array[1] == 1E+35 && array[0] > num)
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string GetQueryString(int queryType, Hashtable CompIndexPositionTable, Array databankList)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("(");
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in CompIndexPositionTable)
			{
				if (num == CompIndexPositionTable.Count - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(item.Key.ToString());
					stringBuilder.Append(")");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(item.Key.ToString());
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				num++;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder();
			string value = "";
			string value2 = "";
			switch (queryType)
			{
			case 1:
				value = "CompoundsUnaryNumericScalarProperties";
				stringBuilder2.Append("SELECT databankIndex, compoundIndex, propertyName, cValue FROM (");
				stringBuilder2.Append("SELECT databankIndex, compoundIndex, propertyName, cValue FROM CompoundsUnaryNumericScalarProperties WHERE ");
				value2 = " SELECT databankIndex, compoundIndex, propertyName, cValue FROM ";
				break;
			case 2:
				value = "CompoundsUnaryNumericVectorProperties";
				stringBuilder2.Append("SELECT databankIndex, compoundIndex, propertyName, cIndex, cValue FROM (");
				stringBuilder2.Append("SELECT databankIndex, compoundIndex, propertyName, cIndex, cValue FROM CompoundsUnaryNumericVectorProperties WHERE ");
				value2 = " SELECT databankIndex, compoundIndex, propertyName, cIndex, cValue FROM ";
				break;
			case 3:
				value = "CompoundsBinaryNumericProperties";
				stringBuilder2.Append("SELECT databankIndex, compound1Index, compound2Index, propertyName, cIndex, cValue FROM (");
				stringBuilder2.Append("SELECT databankIndex, compound1Index, compound2Index, propertyName, cIndex, cValue FROM CompoundsBinaryNumericProperties WHERE ");
				value2 = " SELECT databankIndex, compound1Index, compound2Index, propertyName, cIndex, cValue FROM ";
				break;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < databankList.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i == 0)
				{
					stringBuilder2.Append("databankIndex = ");
					stringBuilder2.Append(((IDatabank)databankList.GetValue(i)).Id.ToString());
					if (databankList.Length == 1)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder2.Append(" UNION ALL ");
					stringBuilder2.Append(value2);
					stringBuilder2.Append(value);
					stringBuilder2.Append(" WHERE databankIndex = ");
					stringBuilder2.Append(((IDatabank)databankList.GetValue(i)).Id.ToString());
				}
			}
			stringBuilder2.Append(") tmp ");
			if (queryType != 3)
			{
				stringBuilder2.Append(" WHERE compoundIndex IN ");
				stringBuilder2.Append(stringBuilder.ToString());
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder2.Append(" WHERE compound1Index IN ");
				stringBuilder2.Append(stringBuilder.ToString());
				stringBuilder2.Append(" AND compound2Index IN ");
				stringBuilder2.Append(stringBuilder.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder2.ToString();
		}

		{
			Hashtable hashtable = ScalarPropertyValuesTable;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;

			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}

			{
				if (CompIndexPositionTable != null && CompIndexPositionTable.Count > 0)
				{
					dbCommand = PrepareGetAllScalarPropertyValuesCommand(connection, CompIndexPositionTable, myDatabankBlock);

						(dbCommand.Parameters[i] as DbParameter).Value = ((IDatabank)myDatabankBlock.GetValue(i)).Id;
					}
					dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();

					{
						string text = Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(2));
						if (PropertyTable[text] == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int num = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(1));

								SortedList sortedList = new SortedList();

								hashtable.Add(num4, value);
								ArrayList arrayList2 = (ArrayList)DuplicateCompTable[num2];
								if (arrayList2 == null)
								{
									continue;
								}
								for (int k = 0; k < arrayList2.Count; k++)
								{
									int num8 = (int)arrayList2[k] * PropertyTable.Count + num3;
									if (!hashtable.ContainsKey(num8))
									{

									}
								}

							else
							{
								EnginePropertyValueObject enginePropertyValueObject = (EnginePropertyValueObject)hashtable[num4];

								{
									enginePropertyValueObject.DatabankPosition = num6;

								}

								{
									double num10 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(3)), text, Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

		public void OptimizedGetAllBinaryPropertyValues(int compCount, Hashtable CompTable, Hashtable CompIndexPositionTable, Hashtable DuplicateCompTable, Hashtable PropertyTable, Hashtable DatabankTable, Array DatabankBlock, ref Hashtable BinaryPropertyValuesTable)

				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}

			{
				if (CompIndexPositionTable != null && CompIndexPositionTable.Count > 0)
				{

						{
							continue;
						}

								int num5 = (int)PropertyTable[text];

								}

											int num17 = (num15 * compCount + num16) * PropertyTable.Count + num5;
											if (!hashtable.ContainsKey(num17))
											{
												hashtable.Add(num17, value);
											}
										}
									}
									continue;
								}
								EnginePropertyValueObject enginePropertyValueObject = (EnginePropertyValueObject)hashtable[num6];
								int num18 = (int)DatabankTable[Database.DatabankDao.Databanks[Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0))]];
								if (num18 < enginePropertyValueObject.DatabankPosition)
								{
									int num19 = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(4));
									enginePropertyValueObject.DatabankPosition = num18;
									double num20 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(5)), text, Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
									((SortedList)enginePropertyValueObject.Values)[num19] = num20;
								}
								else if (enginePropertyValueObject.DatabankPosition == (int)DatabankTable[Database.DatabankDao.Databanks[Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0))]])
								{
									int num21 = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(4));
									if (!((SortedList)enginePropertyValueObject.Values).ContainsKey(num21))
									{
										double num22 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(5)), text, Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
										((SortedList)enginePropertyValueObject.Values).Add(num21, num22);
									}
									else
									{
										double num23 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(5)), text, Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
										((SortedList)enginePropertyValueObject.Values)[num21] = num23;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				BinaryPropertyValuesTable = hashtable;
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		}
