		public void AddReaction(IDatabank databank, string Name, string Type, string Basis, ICollection SynList1, ICollection CoeffList1, ICollection ExponentList1, ICollection EqConstList1, string Phase, string EquationType, ArrayList SymmetricEqConsts, string SymmetricEqConstBasis, out IReaction Reaction)
		{
			Reaction = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			ArrayList arrayList = (ArrayList)SynList1;
			ArrayList arrayList2 = (ArrayList)CoeffList1;
			ArrayList arrayList3 = (ArrayList)ExponentList1;
			ArrayList arrayList4 = (ArrayList)EqConstList1;
			ArrayList arrayList5 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				GetReactionByName(Name, out Reaction);
				if (Reaction != null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException($"Specified reaction with name {Name} already exists in the database");
				}
				Database.CompoundDao.GetIdentifier("ALIAS", out var identifier);
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					Database.CompoundDao.GetCompound(arrayList[i].ToString(), identifier, out var compound);
					if (compound != null)
					{
						arrayList5.Add(compound.Id);
					}
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				int nextReactionIndex = GetNextReactionIndex(dbCommand);
				int id = databank.Id;
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string text = "";
				Database.EncryptVal("0.0", "", Database.Version);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Phase))
				{
					Phase = "";
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(EquationType))
				{
					EquationType = "";
				}
				int num = 4 - arrayList4.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					arrayList4.Add(null);
				}
				num = 4 - SymmetricEqConsts.Count;
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					SymmetricEqConsts.Add(null);
				}
				ArrayList arrayList6 = new ArrayList();
				for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++)
				{
					if (arrayList4.Count > l && arrayList4[l] != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(arrayList4[l].ToString()))
					{
						arrayList6.Add(Database.EncryptVal(arrayList4[l].ToString(), "", Database.Version));
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList6.Add(null);
					}
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < 4; m++)
				{
					if (SymmetricEqConsts.Count > m && SymmetricEqConsts[m] != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SymmetricEqConsts[m].ToString()))
					{
						arrayList6.Add(Database.EncryptVal(SymmetricEqConsts[m].ToString(), "", Database.Version));
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList6.Add(null);
					}
				}
				text = ((Database.DatabaseVersion < 2008) ? $"INSERT INTO active_Reactions(reactnDbankId, reactnId, reactnName, reactnType, reactnEqConst1, reactnEqConst2, reactnEqConst3, reactnEqConst4, reactnBasis, reactnPhase, reactnEqType) VALUES({id}, {nextReactionIndex}, '{Name}', '{Type}', '{arrayList6[0]}', '{arrayList6[1]}', '{arrayList6[2]}', '{arrayList6[3]}', '{Basis}', '{Phase}', '{EquationType}')" : $"INSERT INTO active_Reactions(reactnDbankId, reactnId, reactnName, reactnType, reactnEqConst1, reactnEqConst2, reactnEqConst3, reactnEqConst4, reactnBasis, reactnPhase, reactnEqType, reactnSymEqConst1, reactnSymEqConst2, reactnSymEqConst3, reactnSymEqConst4, reactnSymEqConstBasis) VALUES({id}, {nextReactionIndex}, '{Name}', '{Type}', '{arrayList6[0]}', '{arrayList6[1]}', '{arrayList6[2]}', '{arrayList6[3]}', '{Basis}', '{Phase}', '{EquationType}', '{arrayList6[4]}', '{arrayList6[5]}', '{arrayList6[6]}', '{arrayList6[7]}', '{SymmetricEqConstBasis}')");
				dbCommand.CommandText = text;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbCommand = PrepareInsertReactionStoicCommand(dbTransaction, connection);
				IDataParameter dataParameter = dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter;
				dataParameter.Value = nextReactionIndex;
				for (int n = 0; n < arrayList5.Count; n++)
				{
					int num2 = (int)arrayList5[n];
					dataParameter = dbCommand.Parameters[1] as IDataParameter;
					dataParameter.Value = num2;
					dataParameter = dbCommand.Parameters[2] as IDataParameter;
					dataParameter.Value = Convert.ToDouble(arrayList2[n].ToString(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					dataParameter = dbCommand.Parameters[3] as IDataParameter;
					if (arrayList3 != null && arrayList3[n] != null)
					{
						dataParameter.Value = Convert.ToDouble(arrayList3[n].ToString(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
					else
					{
						dataParameter.Value = DBNull.Value;
					}
					dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				}
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				Reaction = new ReactionObject(databank, nextReactionIndex, Name, Type, Basis, arrayList, arrayList2, arrayList3, arrayList4, Phase, EquationType, SymmetricEqConsts, SymmetricEqConstBasis);
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetReactionByName(string Name, out IReaction Reaction)
		{
			Reaction = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			string name = "";
			string type = "";
			string basis = "";
			string phase = "";
			string eqType = "";
			string symmetricEqConstBasis = "";
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			double num6 = 0.0;
			double num7 = 0.0;
			double num8 = 0.0;
			double num9 = 0.0;
			double num10 = 0.0;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList4 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList5 = new ArrayList();
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareGetReactionInfoCommand(connection);
				(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = Name;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					num2 = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
					num = dataReader.GetInt32(1);
					name = dataReader.GetString(2);
					type = dataReader.GetString(3);
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(4) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataReader.GetString(4)))
					{
						num3 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(dataReader.GetString(4), "", Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						arrayList3.Add(num3);
					}
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(5) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataReader.GetString(5)))
					{
						num4 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(dataReader.GetString(5), "", Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						arrayList3.Add(num4);
					}
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(6) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataReader.GetString(6)))
					{
						num5 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(dataReader.GetString(6), "", Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						arrayList3.Add(num5);
					}
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(7) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataReader.GetString(7)))
					{
						num6 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(dataReader.GetString(7), "", Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						arrayList3.Add(num6);
					}
					basis = dataReader.GetString(8);
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(9))
					{
						phase = dataReader.GetString(9);
					}
					if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(10))
					{
						eqType = dataReader.GetString(10);
					}
					if (Database.DatabaseVersion >= 2008)
					{
						if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(11) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataReader.GetString(11)))
						{
							num7 = Convert.ToDouble(Database.DecryptVal(dataReader.GetString(11), "", Database.Version), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
							arrayList5.Add(num7);
						}
						if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(12) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataReader.GetString(12)))
						{

		private string GetDatabankIndexesClause(ArrayList databanks)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("(");
			int num = 0;
			foreach (string databank2 in databanks)
			{
				IDatabank databank = (IDatabank)Database.DatabankDao.DatabanksByName[databank2];
				if (num == databanks.Count - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(databank.Id.ToString());
					stringBuilder.Append(")");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(databank.Id.ToString());
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				num++;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private string GetCompoundIndexesClause(ArrayList compounds)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("(");
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ICompound compound in compounds)
			{
				if (num == compounds.Count - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(compound.Id.ToString());
					stringBuilder.Append(")");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(compound.Id.ToString());
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				num++;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void GetAllReactionsCount(IDatabank dbank, out int rxnCount)
		{
			rxnCount = 0;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (dbank == null)
				{
					dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT COUNT(reactnId) FROM active_Reactions";
				}
				else
				{
					dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT COUNT(reactnId) FROM active_Reactions WHERE reactnDbankId = " + dbank.Id;
				}
				object obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != DBNull.Value)
				{
					rxnCount = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

	{

	internal abstract class UnifacGroupDao : IUnifacGroupDao
	{
		private string m_LastFormula;

		private int m_LastMainGroupIndex;

		private int m_LastSubGroupIndex;

		private IDbCommand m_cmdGetGroupIndexes;

		protected abstract Database Database { get; }

		private IDbCommand PrepareGetGroupIndexesCommand(IDbConnection dbc)
		{
			if (m_cmdGetGroupIndexes == null || m_cmdGetGroupIndexes.Connection != dbc)
			{
				m_cmdGetGroupIndexes = dbc.CreateCommand();
				m_cmdGetGroupIndexes.CommandText = "SELECT ugId,ugMainGroupId FROM UnifacGroup WHERE UPPER(ugFormula)=@ugformula AND ugMainGroupId IS NOT NULL";
				IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = m_cmdGetGroupIndexes.CreateParameter();
				dbDataParameter.ParameterName = "@ugformula";
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.StringFixedLength;
				dbDataParameter.Size = 64;
				m_cmdGetGroupIndexes.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
				m_cmdGetGroupIndexes.Prepare();
			}
			return m_cmdGetGroupIndexes;
		}

		public bool AddMainGroup(string formula)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (getMainGroupIndex(dbCommand, formula, out var groupIndex))
				{
					return false;
				}
				ICompoundDao compoundDao = Database.CompoundDao;
				groupIndex = compoundDao.GetNextCompoundIndex(dbCommand);
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				compoundDao.AddBaseCompound(dbCommand, groupIndex);
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO UnifacGroup(ugId,ugFormula,ugMainGroupId) VALUES ({groupIndex},'{formula}',NULL)";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetMainGroups(ArrayList mainGroups)
		{
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{

			}
			try

		public bool GetSubgroupParameters(Databank databank, string subgroupFormula, out double R, out double Q)
		{
			R = 0.0;
			Q = 0.0;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (!getDatabankIndex(dbCommand, databank.Name, out var databankIndex, out var _))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The databank does not exist");
				}
				if (!getSubgroupIndex(dbCommand, subgroupFormula, out var groupIndex))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The UNIFAC subgroup does not exist");
				}
				return getSubgroupParameters(dbCommand, databankIndex, groupIndex, out R, out Q);
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool UpdateSubgroupParameters(Databank databank, string subgroupFormula, double R, double Q, out double previousR, out double previousQ)
		{
			previousR = 0.0;
			previousQ = 0.0;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				if (!getDatabankIndex(dbCommand, databank.Name, out var databankIndex, out var databankIsLocked))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The databank does not exist");
				}
				if (databankIsLocked)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The databank is locked and cannot be modified");
				}
				if (!getSubgroupIndex(dbCommand, subgroupFormula, out var groupIndex))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The UNIFAC subgroup does not exist");
				}
				if (!getSubgroupParameters(dbCommand, databankIndex, groupIndex, out previousR, out previousQ) || (!object.Equals(R, previousR) && !object.Equals(Q, previousQ)))
				{
					dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
					updateSubgroupParameters(dbCommand, databankIndex, groupIndex, R, Q, out var compoundPropIndex);
					linkSubgroupParametersToDatabank(dbCommand, databankIndex, compoundPropIndex);
					dbTransaction.Commit();
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetCompoundCombo(string group1Formula, string group2Formula, InteractionType interactionType, bool bAddIfMissing, out ICompound compoundCombo)
		{
			compoundCombo = null;
			int duoId = 0;
			bool bReversed = false;
			if (interactionType == InteractionType.Unary)
			{
				if (group1Formula != null && group1Formula != "")
				{
					getGroupIndexes(group1Formula, out var subGroupIndex, out var _);
					if (subGroupIndex == 0)
					{
						throw new GatewayException("The group does not exist");
					}
					duoId = subGroupIndex;
				}
				return;
			}
			int mainGroupIndex2 = 0;
			int mainGroupIndex3 = 0;
			int subGroupIndex2;
			if (group1Formula != null && group1Formula != "")
			{
				getGroupIndexes(group1Formula, out subGroupIndex2, out mainGroupIndex2);
			}
			if (group2Formula != null && group2Formula != "")
			{
				getGroupIndexes(group2Formula, out subGroupIndex2, out mainGroupIndex3);
			}
			if (mainGroupIndex2 == 0 || mainGroupIndex3 == 0)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("A group does not exist");
			}
			Database.CompoundDao.GetCompoundDuoId(mainGroupIndex2, mainGroupIndex3, bAddIfMissing, out duoId, out bReversed);
		}

		private bool getGroupIpValues(IDbCommand command, int databankId, int modelId, out int ipvid, object[] groupIds, out Hashtable values)
		{
			values = new Hashtable();
			ipvid = 0;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			try
			{
				string commandText = $"SELECT ipvId FROM IpValues,DatabankUnifacGroups WHERE ipvModelId={modelId} AND ipvCompound1Id={groupIds[0]} AND ipvCompound2Id={groupIds[1]} AND ipvCompound3Id IS NULL AND ipvCompound4Id IS NULL AND dbugDatabankId={databankId} AND ipvId=dbugIpValueId ORDER BY ipvId DESC";
				command.CommandText = commandText;
				object obj = command.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ipvid = Convert.ToInt32(obj);
				commandText = $"SELECT ipvdIndex,ipvdValue FROM IpValuesDetail WHERE ipvdValueId={ipvid} ORDER BY ipvdIndex ASC";
				command.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = command.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					int num = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					double num2 = Convert.ToDouble(dataReader.GetValue(1));
					try
					{
						values.Add(num, num2);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool getSubgroupParameters(IDbCommand command, int databankIndex, int groupIndex, out double R, out double Q)
		{
			R = 0.0;
			Q = 0.0;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			string commandText = $"SELECT pvcValue FROM DatabankUnifacGroups,PropertyValue,PropValueConst WHERE dbugCompoundPropId=cpId AND cpId=pvcCompoundPropId AND dbugDatabankId={databankIndex} AND cpCompoundId={groupIndex} ORDER BY cpId DESC";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			dataReader = command.ExecuteReader();
			try
			{
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					R = Convert.ToDouble(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					if (dataReader.Read())
					{
						Q = Convert.ToDouble(dataReader.GetValue(0));
						return true;
					}
					throw new GatewayException("An internal error occurred [5]");
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				dataReader.Close();
			}
		}

		private void updateSubgroupParameters(IDbCommand command, int databankIndex, int groupIndex, double R, double Q, out int compoundPropIndex)
		{
			compoundPropIndex = getNextPropertyValueIndex(command);
			string commandText = $"INSERT INTO PropValueConst(pvcCompoundPropId,pvcIndex,pvcValue) VALUES ({compoundPropIndex},{0},{R})";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			commandText = $"INSERT INTO PropValueConst(pvcCompoundPropId,pvcIndex,pvcValue) VALUES ({compoundPropIndex},{1},{Q})";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		private bool getMainGroupIndex(IDbCommand command, string formula, out int groupIndex)
		{
			groupIndex = 0;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			string commandText = $"SELECT ugId FROM UnifacGroup WHERE UPPER(ugFormula)='{formula.ToUpperInvariant()}' AND ugMainGroupId IS NULL";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			dataReader = command.ExecuteReader();
			try
			{
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					groupIndex = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				dataReader.Close();
			}
		}

		private bool getSubgroupIndex(IDbCommand command, string formula, out int groupIndex)
		{
			groupIndex = 0;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			string commandText = $"SELECT ugId FROM UnifacGroup WHERE UPPER(ugFormula)='{formula.ToUpperInvariant()}' AND ugMainGroupId IS NOT NULL";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			try
			{
				object obj = command.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != null)
				{
					groupIndex = (int)obj;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				dataReader.Close();
			}
		}

		private bool getGroupIndexes(string formula, out int subGroupIndex, out int mainGroupIndex)
		{
			string text = formula.ToUpperInvariant();
			if (text == m_LastFormula)
			{
				subGroupIndex = m_LastSubGroupIndex;
				mainGroupIndex = m_LastMainGroupIndex;
				return true;
			}
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			subGroupIndex = 0;
			mainGroupIndex = 0;
			bool result = false;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = PrepareGetGroupIndexesCommand(connection);
			(dbCommand.Parameters[0] as IDataParameter).Value = text;
			dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
			try
			{
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					subGroupIndex = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					mainGroupIndex = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(1));
					m_LastFormula = text;
					m_LastSubGroupIndex = subGroupIndex;
					m_LastMainGroupIndex = mainGroupIndex;
					result = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dataReader.Close();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool getModelIndex(IDbCommand command, string name, out int modelIndex)
		{
			modelIndex = 0;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			string commandText = $"SELECT ugiId FROM UnifacGroupIp WHERE UPPER(ugiName)='{name.ToUpperInvariant()}'";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			dataReader = command.ExecuteReader();
			try
			{
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					modelIndex = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(0));
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				dataReader.Close();
			}
		}

		private void linkIpValueToDatabank(IDbCommand command, int databankId, int ipValueId)
		{
			string commandText = $"INSERT INTO DatabankUnifacGroups(dbugDatabankId, dbugIpValueId) VALUES ({databankId},{ipValueId})";

		}

		{
			string commandText = $"INSERT INTO DatabankUnifacGroups(dbugDatabankId, dbugCompoundPropId) VALUES ({databankId},{compoundPropId})";
			command.CommandText = commandText;
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		{
			Database.CompoundDao.DeleteCompound(command, compoundIndex);
		}

		}

	internal interface IUOMDataDao
	{
		bool AddUOMData(int RowId, string RowName, string DefaultUOM);

		bool UpdateUOMData(int RowId, string RowName, string DefaultUOM);

		void RemoveUOMData(int RowId);

		void GetRowNameAndUOM(int RowId, out string RowName, out string DefaultUOM);

		int GetRowId(string RowName);

		void DeleteUOMData(int RowId);

		void GetAllUnitRows(out ICollection unitRows);
	}
	internal abstract class UOMDataDao : IUOMDataDao
	{
		private bool m_IsUnitrowListCached;

		private SortedList m_UnitRowList = new SortedList();

		protected abstract Database Database { get; }

		public bool AddUOMData(int RowId, string RowName, string DefaultUOM)
		{
			string RowName2 = "";
			string DefaultUOM2 = "";
			try
			{
				GetRowNameAndUOM(RowId, out RowName2, out DefaultUOM2);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
			}
			if (RowName2 != "" && DefaultUOM2 != "")
			{
				throw new GatewayException("There already exists a row with the same RowId.");
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = $"INSERT INTO UOM (uomRowId,uomRowName,defaultUOM) VALUES ({RowId},'{RowName}','{DefaultUOM}')";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				if (m_IsUnitrowListCached)
				{
					m_UnitRowList.Add(RowId, new UnitRowObject(RowId, RowName, DefaultUOM));
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool UpdateUOMData(int RowId, string RowName, string DefaultUOM)
		{
			string RowName2 = "";
			string DefaultUOM2 = "";
			try
			{
				GetRowNameAndUOM(RowId, out RowName2, out DefaultUOM2);
			}
			catch (GatewayException ex)
			{
				throw ex;
			}
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			IDbTransaction dbTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbTransaction = (dbCommand.Transaction = connection.BeginTransaction());
				string commandText = string.Format("UPDATE UOM SET uomRowName = ('{1}'), defaultUOM = ('{2}') WHERE uomRowId = ({0})", RowId, RowName, DefaultUOM);
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbTransaction.Commit();
				if (m_IsUnitrowListCached)
				{
					m_UnitRowList.SetByIndex(m_UnitRowList.IndexOfKey(RowId), new UnitRowObject(RowId, RowName, DefaultUOM));
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				dbTransaction?.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				dbTransaction?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetRowNameAndUOM(int RowId, out string RowName, out string DefaultUOM)
		{
			RowName = "";
			DefaultUOM = "";
			if (m_IsUnitrowListCached)
			{
				UnitRowObject unitRowObject = (UnitRowObject)m_UnitRowList[RowId];
				if (unitRowObject != null)
				{
					RowName = unitRowObject.UnitRowName;
					DefaultUOM = unitRowObject.DefaultUOM;
				}
				return;
			}
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = $"SELECT uomRowName,defaultUOM FROM UOM WHERE uomRowId = ({RowId})";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					RowName = dataReader.GetString(0);
					DefaultUOM = dataReader.GetString(1);
				}
				if (RowName == "" || RowName == null)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Record with specified RowId does not exist.");
				}
				dataReader.Close();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public int GetRowId(string RowName)
		{
			int num = -1;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = $"SELECT uomRowId FROM UOM WHERE uomRowName = ('{RowName}')";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					num = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
				}
				if (num == -1)
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Record with specified RowName does not exist.");
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				return num;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetAllUnitRows(out ICollection unitRows)
		{
			if (m_IsUnitrowListCached)
			{
				unitRows = m_UnitRowList.Values;
				return;
			}
			unitRows = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT * FROM UOM";
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					int @int = dataReader.GetInt32(0);
					string unit_rowname = dataReader.GetString(1);
					string default_uom = dataReader.GetString(2);
					UnitRowObject value = new UnitRowObject(@int, unit_rowname, default_uom);
					m_UnitRowList.Add(@int, value);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				unitRows = m_UnitRowList.Values;
				m_IsUnitrowListCached = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
				{
					dataReader.Close();
				}
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public DateTime UtcTimeOfLastSyncronization
		{
			get
			{
				GetLastSynchronizationTimeCommand getLastSynchronizationTimeCommand = new GetLastSynchronizationTimeCommand();
				Change change = new Change(this, getLastSynchronizationTimeCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
				try
				{
					change.Submit();
					getLastSynchronizationTimeCommand.GetResult(out var lastSynchronization);
					return lastSynchronization;
				}
				catch (GatewayException ex)
				{
					err = ((ex.InnerException != null) ? ex.InnerException.Message : ex.Message);
					throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving the time of the last database synchronization: " + err, ex);
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					err = ((ex2.InnerException != null) ? ex2.InnerException.Message : ex2.Message);
					throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving the time of the last database synchronization: " + err, ex2);
				}
			}
		}

		public Database()
		{
			myChangeControlState = ChangeControlState.Unknown;
			myTok1 = "";
			myTok2 = "";
			myTok3 = "";
			connectionFlag = false;
			AspenPlusConnectionFlag = false;
			applicationPwd = "sdfsdSDFSF124mSKFJSDKCN909kjMN8oijohjknb6HJBJB";
		}

		public Database(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: this()
		{
			myAlias = info.GetString("alias");
			bool bLocalDB = false;
			myDataSource = info.GetString("dataSource");
			if (GlobalControl.localDBServer && myDataSource.Contains("pipe") && myDataSource.Contains("tsql") && myDataSource.Contains("query"))
			{
				bLocalDB = true;
				if (myDataSource.CompareTo(GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname) != 0)
				{
					myDataSource = GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname;
				}
			}
			myUserName = info.GetString("userName");
			myUserPassword = info.GetString("userPassword");
			myConnectionString = info.GetString("connectionString");
			_dbProvider = info.GetString("dbProvider") ?? "mssql";
			string text = "";
			try
			{
				text = Decrypt(myConnectionString, Version);
			}
			catch (GatewayException ex)
			{
				err = ((ex.InnerException != null) ? ex.InnerException.Message : ex.Message);
				throw new GatewayException("An internal error has occurred: " + err, ex);
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				err = ((ex2.InnerException != null) ? ex2.InnerException.Message : ex2.Message);
				throw new GatewayException("An internal error has occurred: " + err, ex2);
			}
			CreateConnection(text, _dbProvider);
			readConfiguration(bLocalDB);
			connectionFlag = false;
			AspenPlusConnectionFlag = false;
			applicationPwd = "sdfsdSDFSF124mSKFJSDKCN909kjMN8oijohjknb6HJBJB";
		}

		public virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)

		private bool ComparePasswordsWithoutSettingConnectionFlags(string token, string encryptedAppPwd)
		{
			string[] array = token.Split(new char[1] { '+' });
			if (array.Length < 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = array[0];
			string text2 = array[1];
			string text3 = array[2];
			string text4 = decryptAppPwd(encryptedAppPwd);
			if (text4 == text)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (text4 == text2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (text4 == text3)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool GetDatabaseAccessSetting(string encryptedAppPwd)
		{
			if (encryptedAppPwd.CompareTo("ATVIEWER") == 0 && GlobalControl.APSecNames.Contains(myAlias))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (encryptedAppPwd.CompareTo("ATVIEWER") == 0 && GlobalControl.APSysNames.Contains(myAlias))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (encryptedAppPwd.CompareTo("ATSIMULATOR") == 0 && GlobalControl.APSysNames.Contains(myAlias))
			{
				return true;
			}
			string text = "";
			string text2 = "";
			string text3 = "";
			if (databaseVersion == 2006)
			{
				return true;
			}
			text = createSeedKey(myIdentity, "", Version);
			text2 = DecryptToken(text, myTok1, Version);
			if (ComparePasswordsWithoutSettingConnectionFlags(text2, encryptedAppPwd))
			{
				return true;
			}
			text = createSeedKey(myIdentity, GetLicMgrString(), Version);
			text2 = DecryptToken(text, myTok1, Version);
			if (ComparePasswordsWithoutSettingConnectionFlags(text2, encryptedAppPwd))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (myTok2 != "" && myTok2 != null)
			{
				text3 = DecryptToken(text, myTok2, Version);
				if (ComparePasswordsWithoutSettingConnectionFlags(text3, encryptedAppPwd))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool comparePasswords(string token, string encryptedAppPwd)
		{
			string[] array = token.Split(new char[1] { '+' });
			if (array.Length < 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = array[0];
			string text2 = array[1];
			string text3 = array[2];
			string text4 = decryptAppPwd(encryptedAppPwd);
			if (text4 == text)
			{
				connectionFlag = true;
				return true;
			}
			if (text4 == text2)
			{
				AspenPlusConnectionFlag = true;
				return true;
			}
			if (text4 == text3)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ConfirmApplicationPwd(string encryptedAppPwd)
		{
			if (encryptedAppPwd.CompareTo("ATVIEWER") == 0 && GlobalControl.APSecNames.Contains(myAlias))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (encryptedAppPwd.CompareTo("ATVIEWER") == 0 && GlobalControl.APSysNames.Contains(myAlias))
			{
				connectionFlag = true;
				return true;
			}
			if (encryptedAppPwd.CompareTo("ATSIMULATOR") == 0 && GlobalControl.APSysNames.Contains(myAlias))
			{
				AspenPlusConnectionFlag = true;
				return true;
			}
			string text = "";
			string text2 = "";
			string text3 = "";
			applicationPwd = encryptedAppPwd;
			if (databaseVersion == 2006)
			{
				connectionFlag = true;
				AspenPlusConnectionFlag = true;
				return true;
			}
			text = createSeedKey(myIdentity, "", Version);
			text2 = DecryptToken(text, myTok1, Version);
			if (comparePasswords(text2, encryptedAppPwd))
			{
				return true;
			}
			text = createSeedKey(myIdentity, GetLicMgrString(), Version);
			text2 = DecryptToken(text, myTok1, Version);
			if (comparePasswords(text2, encryptedAppPwd))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (myTok2 != "" && myTok2 != null)
			{
				text3 = DecryptToken(text, myTok2, Version);
				if (comparePasswords(text3, encryptedAppPwd))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ApplyChangesTo(IDatabaseSynchronizationTarget Target)
		{
			if (Target == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A target for applying changes must be given", "Target");
			}
			if (Target.DatabaseIdentity != DatabaseIdentity)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The identity of the target database is not the same as the identity of the source database. Changes in the source database cannot be applied to the target database.");
			}
			try
			{
				DatabaseSynchronization.ApplyChangesTo(this, Target);
			}
			catch (GatewayException ex)
			{
				err = ((ex.InnerException != null) ? ex.InnerException.Message : ex.Message);
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred applying changes to the target: " + err, ex);
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				err = ((ex2.InnerException != null) ? ex2.InnerException.Message : ex2.Message);
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred applying changes to the target: " + err, ex2);
			}
		}

		public void SynchronizeTo(IDatabaseSynchronizationSource Source, bool ResetTargetDatabaseContents)
		{
			if (Source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A synchronization source must be given", "Source");
			}
			if (Source.DatabaseIdentity != DatabaseIdentity && !ResetTargetDatabaseContents)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The identity of the source database is not the same as the identity of the target database. The target database cannot be synchronized to this source");
			}
			if (ChangeControlManager.ApprovedChanges.Count > 0)
			{
				if (!ResetTargetDatabaseContents)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("The target database has been changed since the last synchronization. The target database cannot be synchronized to the source database until changes made to the target database are applied to the source database or the database is reset");
				}
				ResetDatabaseCommand command = new ResetDatabaseCommand();
				Change change = new Change(this, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
				try
				{
					change.Submit();
				}
				catch (GatewayException ex)
				{
					err = ((ex.InnerException != null) ? ex.InnerException.Message : ex.Message);
					throw new GatewayException("An error occurred resetting the contents of the target database: " + err, ex);
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					err = ((ex2.InnerException != null) ? ex2.InnerException.Message : ex2.Message);
					throw new GatewayException("An error occurred resetting the contents of the target database: " + err, ex2);
				}
			}
			SynchronizeToCommand command2 = new SynchronizeToCommand(Source);
			Change change2 = new Change(this, command2, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change2.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException ex3)
			{
				err = ((ex3.InnerException != null) ? ex3.InnerException.Message : ex3.Message);
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred synchronizing the contents of the target database to the source data: " + err, ex3);
			}
			catch (Exception ex4)
			{
				err = ((ex4.InnerException != null) ? ex4.InnerException.Message : ex4.Message);
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred synchronizing the contents of the target database to the source data: " + err, ex4);
			}
		}

		internal void ResetDatabase()
		{
			Stream stream = null;
			StreamReader streamReader = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				stream = typeof(Database).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("AspenTech.APED.Resources.aped-clean.sql");
				streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
				string[] array = streamReader.ReadToEnd().Split(new char[1] { ';' });
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					if (ApedApplication.ValidateCleanInput(text))
					{
						dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
						dbCommand.CommandText = text;
						dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				streamReader?.Close();
				stream?.Close();
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string Encrypt(string data, int intVersion)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ICryptoTransform cryptoTransform = null;
			cryptoTransform = ((intVersion != 0 && intVersion < 35) ? new DESCryptoServiceProvider().CreateEncryptor(myKey, myIv) : new AesCryptoServiceProvider().CreateEncryptor(myAesKey, myAesIv));
			byte[] bytes = new UnicodeEncoding().GetBytes(data);
			byte[] array = new byte[(int)Math.Ceiling((double)bytes.Length / 8.0) * 8];
			bytes.CopyTo(array, 0);
			string result = Convert.ToBase64String(cryptoTransform.TransformFinalBlock(array, 0, array.Length));
			cryptoTransform.Dispose();
			array = null;
			return result;
		}

		internal static string Decrypt(string data, int intVersion)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ICryptoTransform cryptoTransform = null;
			cryptoTransform = ((intVersion != 0 && intVersion < 35) ? new DESCryptoServiceProvider().CreateDecryptor(myKey, myIv) : new AesCryptoServiceProvider().CreateDecryptor(myAesKey, myAesIv));
			UnicodeEncoding unicodeEncoding = new UnicodeEncoding();
			byte[] array = Convert.FromBase64String(data);
			byte[] bytes = cryptoTransform.TransformFinalBlock(array, 0, array.Length);
			string text = unicodeEncoding.GetString(bytes).TrimEnd(new char[1]);
			if (text.Contains("\r\r\n"))
			{
				text = text.Replace("\r\r\n", string.Empty);
			}
			if (GlobalControl.localDBServer && text.Contains("pipe") && text.Contains("tsql") && text.Contains("query"))
			{
				int num = 26;
				int num2 = 65;
				string text2 = text.Substring(0, num);
				string text3 = text.Substring(num, num2 - num);
				string text4 = text.Substring(num2, text.Length - num2);
				if (text3.CompareTo(GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname) != 0)
				{
					text = text2 + GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname + text4;
				}
			}
			cryptoTransform.Dispose();
			array = null;
			bytes = null;
			return text;
		}

		internal string EncryptVal(string data, string propName, int intVersion)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (DatabaseVersion != 2006 && (propName.CompareTo("MW") == 0 || propName.CompareTo("TB") == 0))
			{
				return data;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (intVersion >= 35)
			{
				empty = Convert.ToBase64String(EncryptStringToBytes(data));
			}
			else
			{
				byte[] bytes = unicodeEncoder.GetBytes(data);
				byte[] array = new byte[(int)Math.Ceiling((double)bytes.Length / 8.0) * 8];
				bytes.CopyTo(array, 0);
				empty = Convert.ToBase64String(desEncryptor.TransformFinalBlock(array, 0, array.Length));
				array = null;
			}
			return empty;
		}

		private byte[] EncryptStringToBytes(string data)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			memoryStream.Write(myAes.IV, 0, 16);
			using CryptoStream stream = new CryptoStream(memoryStream, desEncryptor, CryptoStreamMode.Write);
			using (StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(stream))
			{
				streamWriter.Write(data);
			}
			return memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		[StrongNameIdentityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, PublicKey = "")]
		internal string DecryptVal(string data, string propName, int intVersion)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (DatabaseVersion != 2006 && (propName.CompareTo("MW") == 0 || propName.CompareTo("TB") == 0))
			{
				return data;
			}
			_ = string.Empty;
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (intVersion >= 35)
			{
				try
				{
					byte[] input = Convert.FromBase64String(data);
					result = DecryptStringFromBytes(input);
					input = null;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (ex.InnerException == null)
					{
						_ = ex.Message;
					}
					else
					{
						_ = ex.InnerException.Message;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					byte[] array = Convert.FromBase64String(data);
					byte[] bytes = desDecryptor.TransformFinalBlock(array, 0, array.Length);
					result = unicodeEncoder.GetString(bytes).TrimEnd(new char[1]);
					array = null;
					bytes = null;
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					if (ex2.InnerException == null)
					{
						_ = ex2.Message;
					}
					else
					{
						_ = ex2.InnerException.Message;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string DecryptStringFromBytes(byte[] input)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(input);
			byte[] array = new byte[16];
			memoryStream.Read(array, 0, 16);
			ICryptoTransform transform = myAes.CreateDecryptor(myAes.Key, array);
			using CryptoStream stream = new CryptoStream(memoryStream, transform, CryptoStreamMode.Read);
			using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
			return streamReader.ReadToEnd();
		}

		internal static string ToSqlStringLiteral(string text)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				return "NULL";
			}
			return "'" + text.Replace("'", "''") + "'";
		}

				flag = true;

			try
			{
				string ConfigurationFilePath = null;
				ApedApplication.GetConfigurationFilePath(out ConfigurationFilePath);
				ConfigurationFilePath = ConfigurationFilePath.Substring(0, ConfigurationFilePath.Length - 10);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConfigurationFilePath))
				{
					string text = ConfigurationFilePath + databaseName + ".mdf";
					string text2 = ConfigurationFilePath + databaseName + "_Log.ldf";
					string text3 = databaseName + "_Log";
					dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();

			}
		}

		protected void assignTokens(string companyLicMgrStr, string vendorLicMgrStr, string creatorPwd)
		{
			string text = "";
			string arg = "";
			string arg2 = "";
			_ = string.Empty;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Connection;
			bool flag = false;

			{

				if (vendorLicMgrStr != null && vendorLicMgrStr != "")
				{
					arg = CreateToken(2, myIdentity, vendorLicMgrStr, dbSettingToEncrypt, Version);
				}
				if (creatorPwd != null && creatorPwd != "")
				{
					arg2 = CreateToken(3, myIdentity, "", creatorPwd, Version);

			}
		}

		internal static string getMd5Hash(string input, int intVersion)
		{
			byte[] array = null;
			array = ((!GlobalControl.bFIPS && intVersion != 0 && intVersion < 34) ? MD5.Create().ComputeHash(Encoding.Default.GetBytes(input)) : new SHA256CryptoServiceProvider().ComputeHash(Encoding.Default.GetBytes(input)));
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(array[i].ToString("x2"));
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static string EncryptToken(string seedkey, string toEncrypt, int intVersion)
		{
			if (toEncrypt == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string result = "";
			new MemoryStream();
			try
			{
				byte[] array = null;
				ICryptoTransform cryptoTransform = null;
				if (intVersion == 0 || intVersion >= 35)
				{
					array = createDataEncryptionKeyAes(seedkey);
					cryptoTransform = new AesCryptoServiceProvider().CreateEncryptor(array, myAesIv);
				}
				else
				{
					array = createDataEncryptionKey(seedkey);
					cryptoTransform = new DESCryptoServiceProvider().CreateEncryptor(array, myIv);
				}
				byte[] bytes = new UnicodeEncoding().GetBytes(toEncrypt);
				byte[] array2 = new byte[(int)Math.Ceiling((double)bytes.Length / 8.0) * 8];
				bytes.CopyTo(array2, 0);
				string result2 = Convert.ToBase64String(cryptoTransform.TransformFinalBlock(array2, 0, array2.Length));
				cryptoTransform.Dispose();
				array2 = null;
				array = null;
				return result2;
			}
			catch
			{
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal static string DecryptToken(string seedkey, string toDecrypt, int intVersion)
		{
			if (toDecrypt == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			toDecrypt = toDecrypt.Trim();
			string result = "";
			new MemoryStream();
			try
			{
				byte[] array = null;
				ICryptoTransform cryptoTransform = null;
				if (intVersion == 0 || intVersion >= 35)
				{
					array = createDataEncryptionKeyAes(seedkey);
					cryptoTransform = new AesCryptoServiceProvider().CreateDecryptor(array, myAesIv);
				}
				else
				{
					array = createDataEncryptionKey(seedkey);
					cryptoTransform = new DESCryptoServiceProvider().CreateDecryptor(array, myIv);
				}
				UnicodeEncoding unicodeEncoding = new UnicodeEncoding();
				byte[] array2 = Convert.FromBase64String(toDecrypt);
				byte[] bytes = cryptoTransform.TransformFinalBlock(array2, 0, array2.Length);
				string result2 = unicodeEncoding.GetString(bytes).TrimEnd(new char[1]);
				cryptoTransform.Dispose();
				array2 = null;
				bytes = null;
				array = null;
				return result2;
			}
			catch
			{
				return result;
			}
		}

		private static byte[] createDataEncryptionKey(string seedkey)
		{
			byte[] salt = new byte[13]
			{
				0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 241, 240, 238,
				33, 34, 69
			};
			int iterations = 1000;
			Rfc2898DeriveBytes rfc2898DeriveBytes = new Rfc2898DeriveBytes(seedkey, salt, iterations);
			byte[] bytes = rfc2898DeriveBytes.GetBytes(16);
			byte[] array = new byte[8];
			for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
			{
				array[i] = bytes[i];
			}
			rfc2898DeriveBytes.Reset();
			return array;
		}

		private static byte[] createDataEncryptionKeyAes(string seedkey)
		{
			byte[] salt = new byte[13]
			{
				0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 241, 240, 238,
				33, 34, 69
			};
			int iterations = 1000;
			Rfc2898DeriveBytes rfc2898DeriveBytes = new Rfc2898DeriveBytes(seedkey, salt, iterations);
			byte[] bytes = rfc2898DeriveBytes.GetBytes(32);
			byte[] array = new byte[32];
			for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
			{
				array[i] = bytes[i];
			}
			rfc2898DeriveBytes.Reset();
			return array;
		}

		private static byte[] createDataEncryptionIv(string seedkey)
		{
			TripleDES tripleDES = TripleDES.Create();
			tripleDES.Key = createDataEncryptionKey(seedkey);
			return tripleDES.IV;
		}

		internal static string createSeedKey(int dbIdentity, string licMgrStr, int intVersion)
		{
			string text = "";
			if (licMgrStr == "" || licMgrStr == null)
			{
				text = getMd5Hash(dbIdentity.ToString(), intVersion);
				return getMd5Hash(text, intVersion);
			}
			text = getMd5Hash(dbIdentity.ToString(), intVersion) + getMd5Hash(licMgrStr, intVersion);
			return getMd5Hash(text, intVersion);
		}

		internal static string CreateToken(int tokId, int dbIdentity, string licMgrStr, string dbSettingToEncrypt, int intVersion)
		{
			string result = "";
			switch (tokId)
			{
			case 1:
				result = EncryptToken(createSeedKey(dbIdentity, licMgrStr, intVersion), dbSettingToEncrypt, intVersion);
				break;
			case 2:
				result = EncryptToken(createSeedKey(dbIdentity, licMgrStr, intVersion), dbSettingToEncrypt, intVersion);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = EncryptToken(createSeedKey(dbIdentity, dbSettingToEncrypt, intVersion), dbSettingToEncrypt, intVersion);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected bool readConfiguration(bool bLocalDB)
		{
			string text = "";
			string text2 = "";
			string commandText = "";
			bool result = true;
			_ = string.Empty;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDataReader dataReader = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
				{
					connection.Open();
					flag = true;
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT confSchemaVersion, confDataVersion FROM Configuration";
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					text = dataReader.GetString(0);
					text2 = dataReader.GetString(1);
				}
				dataReader.Close();
				if (text.CompareTo("") != 0)
				{
					if (text.StartsWith("20."))
					{
						databaseVersion = 2006;
						commandText = "SELECT confChangeControlEnabled, confDatabaseIdentity FROM Configuration";
					}
					else if (text.StartsWith("21."))
					{
						databaseVersion = 2007;
						commandText = "SELECT confChangeControlEnabled, confDatabaseIdentity, confToken1, confToken2, confToken3 FROM Configuration";
					}
					else if (text.StartsWith("22."))
					{
						databaseVersion = 2008;
						commandText = "SELECT confChangeControlEnabled, confDatabaseIdentity, confToken1, confToken2, confToken3, confDatabaseDescription FROM Configuration";
					}
				}
				if (text2.CompareTo("") != 0)
				{
					myDataVersion = text2;
					char[] separator = new char[1] { '.' };
					string[] array = text2.Split(separator);
					if (array.Length >= 1)
					{
						version = Convert.ToInt32(array[0]);
					}
				}
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
				if (dataReader.Read())
				{
					if (Convert.ToBoolean(dataReader.GetValue(0)))
					{
						myChangeControlState = ChangeControlState.Enabled;
					}
					else
					{
						myChangeControlState = ChangeControlState.Disabled;
					}
					myIdentity = Convert.ToInt32(dataReader.GetValue(1));
					if (databaseVersion >= 2007)
					{
						if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(2))
						{
							myTok1 = Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(2));
						}
						if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(3))
						{
							myTok2 = Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(3));
						}
						if (!dataReader.IsDBNull(4))
						{
							myTok3 = Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(4));
						}
						if (databaseVersion >= 2008 && !dataReader.IsDBNull(5))
						{
							myDescription = Convert.ToString(dataReader.GetValue(5));
						}
						string seedkey = createSeedKey(DatabaseIdentity, "", Version);
						if (version >= 35)
						{
							myAesDataKey = createDataEncryptionKeyAes(seedkey);
						}
						else
						{
							myDataKey = createDataEncryptionKey(seedkey);
							myDataIv = myIv;
						}
					}
					else if (databaseVersion == 2006)
					{
						myDataKey = myKey;
						myDataIv = myIv;
					}
					unicodeEncoder = new UnicodeEncoding();
					if (version >= 35)
					{
						myAes = new AesCryptoServiceProvider();
						myAes.BlockSize = 128;
						myAes.KeySize = 256;
						myAes.Key = myAesDataKey;
						myAes.Padding = PaddingMode.PKCS7;
						desEncryptor = myAes.CreateEncryptor(myAes.Key, myAes.IV);
					}
					else
					{
						desEncryptor = new DESCryptoServiceProvider().CreateEncryptor(myDataKey, myDataIv);
						desDecryptor = new DESCryptoServiceProvider().CreateDecryptor(myDataKey, myDataIv);
					}
				}
				dataReader.Close();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex.InnerException == null)
				{
					_ = ex.Message;
				}
				else
				{
					_ = ex.InnerException.Message;
				}
				result = false;
			}
			if (dataReader != null && !dataReader.IsClosed)
			{
				dataReader.Close();
			}
			dbCommand?.Dispose();
			if (flag)
			{
				connection.Close();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private int generateIdentity()
		{
			return new Random().Next();
		}

		public string CheckData(string data, int intVersion)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			try
			{
				err = Decrypt(data, intVersion);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				err = "";
			}
			return err;
		}

			myDbIsLocked = dbIsLocked;
			myDatabankDescription = description;
			myBaseDatabankName = baseDatabankName;
		}

			: base(info, context)

			myDatabankName = info.GetString("databankName");

			myDatabankDescription = info.GetString("databankDescription");
			myBaseDatabankName = info.GetString("baseDatabankName");

			else

				Message = $"Added databank '{myDatabankName}', based on databank '{myBaseDatabankName}'";
			}
		}

		{
			base.Database.DatabankDao.AddDatabank(myDatabankName, myDbIsLocked, myBaseDatabankName, myDatabankDescription, out myDatabank);

			info.AddValue("dbIsLocked", myDbIsLocked);

	}
	internal class SqlServerCommandBuilder : IDatabaseCommandBuilder
	{
		private DbCommandBuilder myCommandBuilder;

		IDbDataAdapter IDatabaseCommandBuilder.DataAdapter
		{
			get
			{
				return myCommandBuilder.DataAdapter;
			}
			set
			{
				myCommandBuilder.DataAdapter = (DbDataAdapter)value;
			}
		}

		public SqlServerCommandBuilder(string dbprovider)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (dbprovider.ToLower() == "postgres")
			{
				myCommandBuilder = (DbCommandBuilder)new NpgsqlCommandBuilder();
			}
			else if (!(dbprovider.ToLower() == "sqlite"))
			{
				myCommandBuilder = (DbCommandBuilder)new SqlCommandBuilder();
			}
		}

		IDbCommand IDatabaseCommandBuilder.GetDeleteCommand()
		{
			return myCommandBuilder.GetDeleteCommand();
		}

		IDbCommand IDatabaseCommandBuilder.GetInsertCommand()
		{
			return myCommandBuilder.GetInsertCommand();
		}

		IDbCommand IDatabaseCommandBuilder.GetUpdateCommand()
		{
			return myCommandBuilder.GetUpdateCommand();
		}

		void IDatabaseCommandBuilder.RefreshSchema()
		{
			myCommandBuilder.RefreshSchema();
		}
	}

		public string ExecuteSQLLocalDBCommand(string args)
		{
			string text = "";
			Process process = new Process();
			process.StartInfo.UseShellExecute = false;
			process.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = true;
			process.StartInfo.CreateNoWindow = true;
			process.StartInfo.FileName = "SQLLocalDB.exe";
			process.StartInfo.Arguments = args;
			process.Start();
			text = process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();
			process.WaitForExit();
			return text;
		}

		public string InitializeFromConfigurationFile(string appView, string dbProvider, string port = "")
		{
			new DatabaseCollection();
			new ArrayList();
			new SortedList();
			_ = string.Empty;
			if (IsUsingDBConfigEnv())
			{
				IDBConfiguration config = CheckEnvAndLoadConfig();
				return InitializeFromNGPConfigurationFile(null, appView, config);
			}
			return InitializeFromBuiltInConfigurationFile(appView, dbProvider, port);
		}

		public string InitializeFromBuiltInConfigurationFile(string appView, string dbProvider, string port = "")
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(port))
			{
				GlobalControl.inputPort = port;
			}
			DatabaseCollection databaseCollection = new DatabaseCollection();
			new ArrayList();
			new SortedList();
			string error = string.Empty;
			string message = "";
			ApedApplication.SetupDefault(dbProvider);
			string item3;
			if (dbProvider.ToLowerInvariant() == "postgres")
			{
				ApedApplication.SetupPostgreSQLLogin().Deconstruct(out var item, out var item2, out item3);
				string text = item;
				string user = item2;
				string password = item3;
				ArrayList arrayList = ApedApplication.ParsePostgresSQLpgDatabasesDat(out port);
				if (arrayList.Count == 0)
				{
					message = "No Aspen Properties Enterprise Databases are specified in pgDatabases.dat. Check installation log for details.";
					ApedApplication.UpdateErrorReports(message);
					return message;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(port) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(GlobalControl.inputPort))
				{
					port = GlobalControl.inputPort;
				}
				if (!ApedApplication.CheckConnectionToPostgreSQL(debug: true, text, ref port, out user, out password, out message))
				{
					message = "No connection could be made. The PostgreSQL server is most likely not running and you can try to restart the server  by running pgRestart.bat as Administrator from a command prompt window.";
					ApedApplication.UpdateErrorReports(message);
					return message;
				}
				foreach (string item5 in arrayList)
				{
					SqlServerDatabase sqlServerDatabase = new SqlServerDatabase();
					sqlServerDatabase.Alias = item5;
					sqlServerDatabase.DataSource = text;
					sqlServerDatabase.UserName = user;
					sqlServerDatabase.UserPassword = password;
					sqlServerDatabase.DBProvider = dbProvider;
					sqlServerDatabase.ConnectionString = ApedApplication.BuildConnectionString(dbProvider, sqlServerDatabase.DataSource, port, item5, sqlServerDatabase.UserName, sqlServerDatabase.UserPassword);
					sqlServerDatabase.IsLegacyDB = false;
					sqlServerDatabase.InitDatabase(out error);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
					{
						databaseCollection.myDatabases.Add(sqlServerDatabase);
						continue;
					}
					if (error.Contains("No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it"))
					{
						error = "No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it. The PostgreSQL server is most likely not running and you can try to restart the server  by running pgRestart.bat as Administrator from a command prompt window.";
					}
					error = ApedApplication.UpdateErrorReports(error);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_ = string.Empty;
				string ConfigurationFilePath = "";
				ApedApplication.GetConfigurationFilePath(out ConfigurationFilePath);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConfigurationFilePath))
				{
					return "Failed to initialize Aspen Properties Enterprise Database. We could not find config.aem.";
				}
				CreateMSSQLDatabaseCollection(ConfigurationFilePath).Deconstruct(out var item4, out item3);
				databaseCollection = item4;
				string text3 = item3;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
				{
					ApedApplication.UpdateErrorReports(text3);
					return text3;
				}
			}
			return VerifyDatabaseConnection(databaseCollection, appView, dbProvider);
		}

		private IDBConfiguration CheckEnvAndLoadConfig()
		{
			IDBConfiguration iDBConfiguration = new DBServerConfiguration();
			if (IsUsingDBConfigEnv())
			{
				iDBConfiguration.LoadFromEnvironment();
				if (iDBConfiguration != null)
				{
					Console.WriteLine(iDBConfiguration.DataSource);
				}
				else
				{
					Console.WriteLine("DB Configuration is not loaded");
				}
			}
			return iDBConfiguration;
		}

		private bool IsUsingDBConfigEnv()
		{
			if (string.Compare(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DBCONFIGURATION__SQLSERVER__USEENV"), "true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public string InitializeFromNGPConfigurationFile(Stream Stream, string appPwd, IDBConfiguration config, ILogger apedLogger = null)
		{
			if (apedLogger != null)
			{
				ApedLogger = apedLogger;
			}
			if (ApedLogger == null)
			{
				ApedLogger = NullLogger.Instance;
			}
			DatabaseCollection databaseCollection = new DatabaseCollection();
			string dbProvider = "mssql";
			bool flag = IsUsingDBConfigEnv();
			if (config == null || flag)
			{
				config = CheckEnvAndLoadConfig();
			}
			if (config != null && config.SupportedDBs != null && config.DataSource != null && !IsBuiltInProvider(config.Provider))
			{
				ApedLogger.LogInformation("DBConfiguration file found.");
				databaseCollection = CreateNGPDBDatabaseCollection(config, ApedLogger);
				return VerifyDatabaseConnection(databaseCollection, appPwd, dbProvider);
			}
			try
			{
				dbProvider = ((config != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.Provider)) ? SplitDashString(config.Provider).Item2 : "mssql");
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				dbProvider = "mssql";
			}
			return InitializeFromBuiltInConfigurationFile(appPwd, dbProvider);
		}

		public static DatabaseCollection CreateNGPDBDatabaseCollection(IDBConfiguration config, ILogger apedLogger = null)
		{
			DatabaseCollection databaseCollection = new DatabaseCollection();
			_ = config.Provider;
			ApedApplication.SetupDefault(config.Provider);
			foreach (string supportedDB in config.SupportedDBs)
			{
				apedLogger.LogInformation("Creating Database: " + supportedDB);
				SqlServerDatabase sqlServerDatabase = new SqlServerDatabase();
				sqlServerDatabase.Alias = supportedDB;
				sqlServerDatabase.DataSource = config.DataSource;
				sqlServerDatabase.UserName = config.UserName;
				sqlServerDatabase.UserPassword = config.UserPassword;
				sqlServerDatabase.DBProvider = config.Provider;
				sqlServerDatabase.ConnectionString = config.BuildConnectionString(supportedDB);
				sqlServerDatabase.IsLegacyDB = false;
				sqlServerDatabase.InitDatabase(out var error);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
				{
					apedLogger.LogError(supportedDB + " initialization error: \n      " + error);
				}
				databaseCollection.myDatabases.Add(sqlServerDatabase);
			}
			return databaseCollection;
		}

		public static DatabaseCollection CreatePostgreSQLDatabaseCollection(string dbProvider, string dataSource, string userName, string userView, string port, ArrayList listOfDatabases)
		{
			DatabaseCollection databaseCollection = new DatabaseCollection();
			foreach (string listOfDatabase in listOfDatabases)
			{
				SqlServerDatabase sqlServerDatabase = new SqlServerDatabase();
				sqlServerDatabase.Alias = listOfDatabase;
				sqlServerDatabase.DataSource = dataSource;
				sqlServerDatabase.UserName = userName;
				sqlServerDatabase.UserPassword = userView;
				sqlServerDatabase.DBProvider = dbProvider;
				sqlServerDatabase.ConnectionString = ApedApplication.BuildConnectionString(dbProvider, sqlServerDatabase.DataSource, port, listOfDatabase, sqlServerDatabase.UserName, sqlServerDatabase.UserPassword);
				sqlServerDatabase.IsLegacyDB = false;
				sqlServerDatabase.InitDatabase(out var error);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
				{
					databaseCollection.myDatabases.Add(sqlServerDatabase);
				}
				else
				{
					error = ApedApplication.UpdateErrorReports(error);
				}
			}
			return databaseCollection;
		}

		public static Tuple<DatabaseCollection, string> CreateMSSQLDatabaseCollection(string configfilepath)
		{
			DatabaseCollection databaseCollection = new DatabaseCollection();
			string empty = string.Empty;
			string empty2 = string.Empty;
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			xmlDocument.Load(configfilepath);
			XmlNodeList elementsByTagName = xmlDocument.GetElementsByTagName("a4:SqlServerDatabase");
			if (elementsByTagName != null && elementsByTagName.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (XmlNode item2 in elementsByTagName)
				{
					SqlServerDatabase sqlServerDatabase = new SqlServerDatabase();
					try
					{
						foreach (XmlNode childNode in item2.ChildNodes)
						{
							XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = childNode.Attributes[0];
							empty = xmlAttribute.Name;
							empty2 = xmlAttribute.Value;
							switch (childNode.Name)
							{
							case "alias":
								sqlServerDatabase.Alias = childNode.InnerText;
								break;
							case "dataSource":
								if (empty.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo("ID") == 0)
								{
									sqlServerDatabase.DataSource = childNode.InnerText;
									empty2 = "#" + empty2;
									dictionary.Add(empty2, sqlServerDatabase.DataSource);
									if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GlobalControl.sqlInstance) && !GlobalControl.localDBServer)
									{
										GlobalControl.sqlInstance = sqlServerDatabase.DataSource;
									}
								}
								else if (empty.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo("HREF") == 0)
								{
									sqlServerDatabase.DataSource = dictionary[empty2];
								}
								break;
							case "userName":
								if (empty.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo("ID") == 0)
								{
									sqlServerDatabase.UserName = childNode.InnerText;
									empty2 = "#" + empty2;
									dictionary.Add(empty2, sqlServerDatabase.UserName);
								}
								else if (empty.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo("HREF") == 0)
								{
									sqlServerDatabase.UserName = dictionary[empty2];
								}
								break;
							case "userPassword":
								sqlServerDatabase.UserPassword = childNode.InnerText;
								break;
							case "connectionString":
								sqlServerDatabase.ConnectionString = childNode.InnerText;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						string item = "An error occurred reading the configuration data from " + configfilepath + " : " + ex.Message;
						return new Tuple<DatabaseCollection, string>(databaseCollection, item);
					}
					sqlServerDatabase.InitDatabase();
					databaseCollection.myDatabases.Add(sqlServerDatabase);
				}
			}
			return new Tuple<DatabaseCollection, string>(databaseCollection, "");
		}

		public string VerifyDatabaseConnection(DatabaseCollection dbcollection, string appPwd, string dbProvider)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (Database item in dbcollection)
			{
				arrayList.Add(item);
			}
			SortedList sortedList = new SortedList();
			string text = "";
			Clear();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(arrayList[i] is IDatabase database))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (database.ConfirmApplicationPwd(appPwd))
				{
					string key = database.DataSource + "." + database.Alias;
					if (!sortedList.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						sortedList.Add(key, "(DataVersion - " + database.DataVersion + ") OK");
					}
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					string key2 = database.DataSource + "." + database.Alias;
					if (!sortedList.ContainsKey(key2))
					{
						if (database.Version < 34)
						{
							string value2 = database.Alias + " was created with non-FIPS validated cryptographic algorithms and is not accessible when FIPS compliant is enabled.";
							sortedList.Add(key2, value2);
						}
						else
						{
							sortedList.Add(key2, "SECURED; NO PERMISSION TO ACCESS.");
						}
					}
				}
				Add(database);
			}
			string text2 = "Using configuration file from C:\\ProgramData\\AspenTech\\APED V15.0\\pgDatabases.dat <?>";
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (string key3 in sortedList.Keys)
			{
				text2 = ((num2 != sortedList.Keys.Count - 1) ? (text2 + key3 + " : " + (string)sortedList[key3] + "<?>") : (text2 + key3 + " : " + (string)sortedList[key3]));
				num2++;
			}
			text2 = text + "<?>" + text2;
			if (!GlobalControl.localDBServer && dbProvider.ToLowerInvariant() == "mssql")
			{
				ApedApplication.CheckSQLInstance();
			}
			if (dbProvider.ToLowerInvariant() == "postgres" && num > 0 && arrayList.Count > 0 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(GlobalControl.outputPort))
			{
				GlobalControl.bpgPort = true;
			}
			return text2;
		}

		public void RestartSQLInstance(string instanceName)
		{
			try
			{
				myInstance = instanceName;
				elapsedTime = 0;
				firstEventHandled = false;
				secondEventHandled = false;
				string text = "";
				string text2 = "";
				if (instanceName.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo("MSSQLSERVER") == 0)
				{
					text = " net stop MSSQLSERVER ";
					text2 = " net start MSSQLSERVER ";
				}
				else
				{
					text = " net stop MSSQL$" + instanceName;
					text2 = " net start MSSQL$" + instanceName;
				}
				ProcessStartInfo processStartInfo = new ProcessStartInfo("cmd", "/C " + text);
				processStartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = true;
				processStartInfo.UseShellExecute = false;
				processStartInfo.CreateNoWindow = true;
				Process process = new Process();
				process.EnableRaisingEvents = true;
				process.Exited += proc_Exited;
				process.StartInfo = processStartInfo;
				process.Start();
				while (!firstEventHandled)
				{
					elapsedTime += 100;
					if (elapsedTime > 30000)
					{
						break;
					}
					Thread.Sleep(100);
				}
				process.Close();
				ProcessStartInfo processStartInfo2 = new ProcessStartInfo("cmd", "/C " + text2);
				processStartInfo2.RedirectStandardOutput = true;
				processStartInfo2.UseShellExecute = false;
				processStartInfo2.CreateNoWindow = true;
				Process process2 = new Process();
				process2.EnableRaisingEvents = true;
				process2.Exited += proc1_Exited;
				process2.StartInfo = processStartInfo2;
				process2.Start();
				elapsedTime = 0;
				while (!secondEventHandled)
				{
					elapsedTime += 100;
					if (elapsedTime > 30000)
					{
						break;
					}
					Thread.Sleep(100);
				}
				process2.Close();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				throw ex;
			}
		}

		private void proc1_Exited(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			secondEventHandled = true;
		}

		private void proc_Exited(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			firstEventHandled = true;
		}

		public int Add(IDatabase Database)
		{

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (myDatabases == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IDatabase myDatabase in myDatabases)
			{
				databaseRemoved(myDatabase);
			}
			myDatabases.Clear();
			if (myDataBanks != null)
			{
				myDataBanks.Clear();
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(string DatabaseAlias)
		{

			}
			return false;
		}

			return findIndex(DatabaseAlias);

		private int findIndex(string name)
		{
			int result = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < myDatabases.Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].Alias == name)
				{
					result = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public int GetServerLoginModeX64API(string instanceName)
		{
			int result = -1;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(instanceName))
			{
				try
				{
					string inKeyName = "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft SQL Server\\Instance Names\\SQL";
					string inPropertyName = "LoginMode";
					string empty = string.Empty;
					object regKey = GetRegKey64(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, inKeyName, instanceName);
					if (regKey != null)
					{
						empty = regKey.ToString();
						if (empty.IndexOf('\0') >= 0)
						{
							empty = empty.Substring(0, empty.Length - 1);
						}
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty))
						{
							inKeyName = "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft SQL Server\\" + empty + "\\MSSQLServer";
							regKey = GetRegKey64(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, inKeyName, inPropertyName);
							if (regKey != null)
							{
								result = Convert.ToInt32(regKey.ToString());
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					_ = ex.Message;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void SetServerLoginModeX64API(string instanceName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(instanceName))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				string inKeyName = "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft SQL Server\\Instance Names\\SQL";
				string inPropertyName = "LoginMode";
				string empty = string.Empty;
				object regKey = GetRegKey64(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, inKeyName, instanceName);
				if (regKey != null)
				{
					empty = regKey.ToString();
					if (empty.IndexOf('\0') >= 0)
					{
						empty = empty.Substring(0, empty.Length - 1);
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty))
					{
						inKeyName = "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft SQL Server\\" + empty + "\\MSSQLServer";
						SetRegKey64(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, inKeyName, inPropertyName, 2);
						RestartSQLInstance(instanceName);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				_ = ex.Message;
			}
		}

			return string.Empty;
