		private string GetValue(string data)
		{
			if (data.IndexOf('\0') >= 0)
			{
				return data.Substring(0, data.Length - 1);
			}
			return data;
		}

		[DllImport("Advapi32.dll")]
		private static extern uint RegOpenKeyEx(UIntPtr hKey, string lpSubKey, uint ulOptions, int samDesired, out int phkResult);

		[DllImport("Advapi32.dll")]
		private static extern uint RegCloseKey(int hKey);

		[DllImport("Advapi32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
		private static extern int RegQueryValueEx(int hKey, [In] string lpValueName, int lpReserved, out int lpType, [Out] byte[] lpData, ref int lpcbData);

		public static object GetRegKey64(UIntPtr inHive, string inKeyName, string inPropertyName)
		{
			return GetRegKey64(inHive, inKeyName, RegSAM.WOW64_64Key, inPropertyName);
		}

		public static object GetRegKey32(UIntPtr inHive, string inKeyName, string inPropertyName)
		{
			return GetRegKey64(inHive, inKeyName, RegSAM.WOW64_32Key, inPropertyName);
		}

		public static void SetRegKey64(UIntPtr inHive, string inKeyName, string inPropertyName, int keyValue)
		{
			SetRegKey64(inHive, inKeyName, RegSAM.WOW64_64Key, inPropertyName, keyValue);
		}

		public static object GetRegKey64(UIntPtr inHive, string inKeyName, RegSAM in32or64key, string inPropertyName)
		{
			int phkResult = 0;
			try
			{
				if (RegOpenKeyEx(inHive, inKeyName, 0u, (int)(RegSAM.QueryValue | in32or64key), out phkResult) != 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int lpType = 0;
				int num = 65000;
				int lpcbData = num;
				byte[] array = new byte[num];
				while (RegQueryValueEx(phkResult, inPropertyName, 0, out lpType, array, ref lpcbData) == 234)
				{
					num *= 2;
					lpcbData = num;
					array = new byte[num];
				}
				return lpType switch
				{
					4 => array[0] | (array[1] << 8) | (array[2] << 16) | (array[3] << 24), 
					1 => Encoding.Unicode.GetString(array, 0, lpcbData), 
					_ => null, 
				};
			}
			finally
			{
				if (phkResult != 0)
				{
					RegCloseKey(phkResult);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void SetRegKey64(UIntPtr inHive, string inKeyName, RegSAM in32or64key, string inPropertyName, int keyValue)
		{
		}

		public bool IsBuiltInProvider(string provider)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(provider))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return provider.StartsWith("builtin-", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}

		public (string, string) SplitDashString(string input)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(input))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Input string cannot be null or empty.");
			}
			string[] array = input.Split(new char[1] { '-' });
			if (array.Length < 2)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Input string must contain a '-' separator.");
			}
			return (array[0], array[1]);
		}
	}
	public interface IDatabaseObjectMoniker : IDatabaseObjectIdentity
	{
		IDatabaseObject Resolve();
	}
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public delegate IDatabaseObject ResolveDatabaseObjectMonikerDelegate(IDatabaseObjectMoniker Moniker);
	[Serializable]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public class DatabaseObjectMoniker : IDatabaseObjectMoniker, IDatabaseObjectIdentity, ISerializable
	{
		[NonSerialized]
		private IDatabase myDatabase;

		private DatabaseObjectType myObjectType;

		private string myIdentity;

		private ResolveDatabaseObjectMonikerDelegate myResolveMonikerDelegate;

		public IDatabase Database
		{
			get
			{
				return myDatabase;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("A database must be provided");
				}
				myDatabase = value;
			}
		}

		public string Identity
		{
			get
			{
				return myIdentity;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == "" || value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("The Identity cannot be empty", "Identity");
				}
				myIdentity = value;
			}
		}

		public DatabaseObjectType ObjectType => myObjectType;

		public DatabaseObjectMoniker(IDatabase Database, DatabaseObjectType ObjectType, string Identity, ResolveDatabaseObjectMonikerDelegate ResolveMonikerDelegate)
		{
			if (Database == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A database must be given", "Database");
			}
			if (ObjectType == DatabaseObjectType.Unknown)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database object type cannot be Unknown", "ObjectType");
			}
			if (Identity == "" || Identity == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The object identity be empty", "Identity");
			}
			if (ResolveMonikerDelegate == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The resolve moniker delegate cannot be empty", "ResolveMonikerDelegate");
			}
			myDatabase = Database;
			myObjectType = ObjectType;
			myIdentity = Identity;
			myResolveMonikerDelegate = ResolveMonikerDelegate;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return GetHashCode() == obj.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Database.GetHashCode() ^ Identity.GetHashCode() ^ ObjectType.GetHashCode();
		}

		public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.SetType(typeof(DatabaseObjectMonikerSerializationProxy));
			new DatabaseObjectMonikerSerializationProxy(this).GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		public IDatabaseObject Resolve()
		{
			return myResolveMonikerDelegate(this);
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public class DatabaseObjectMonikerFactory
	{
		public static IDatabaseObjectMoniker CreateMoniker(IDatabase Database, DatabaseObjectType ObjectType, string Identity)
		{
			IDatabaseObject databaseObject = ObjectType switch
			{
				DatabaseObjectType.Equation => new EquationObject(), 
				DatabaseObjectType.PropertyValue => new PropertyValueObject(), 
				DatabaseObjectType.Reference => new PropertyCitationsObject(), 
				DatabaseObjectType.History => new PropertyHistoryObject(), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("The database object type is unknown", "ObjectType"), 
			};
			databaseObject.Database = Database;
			databaseObject.Identity = Identity;
			databaseObject.GetMoniker(out var Moniker);
			return Moniker;
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	internal sealed class DatabaseObjectMonikerSerializationProxy : IObjectReference, ISerializable
	{
		private IDatabase myDatabase;

		private DatabaseObjectType myObjectType;

		private string myIdentity;

		public DatabaseObjectMonikerSerializationProxy(IDatabaseObjectMoniker Moniker)
		{
			myDatabase = Moniker.Database;
			myObjectType = Moniker.ObjectType;
			myIdentity = Moniker.Identity;
		}

		private DatabaseObjectMonikerSerializationProxy(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			myDatabase = context.Context as IDatabase;
			myObjectType = (DatabaseObjectType)info.GetInt32("objectType");
			myIdentity = info.GetString("identity");
		}

		public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("objectType", myObjectType);
			info.AddValue("identity", myIdentity);
		}

		object IObjectReference.GetRealObject(StreamingContext context)
		{
			return DatabaseObjectMonikerFactory.CreateMoniker(myDatabase, myObjectType, myIdentity);
		}
	}
	internal class DatabaseSynchronization
	{
		private class TableCommands
		{
			public string SelectCommand;

			public IDbCommand InsertCommand;

			public IDbCommand DeleteCommand;

			public TableCommands(string selectCommand)
			{
				SelectCommand = selectCommand;
				InsertCommand = (DeleteCommand = null);
			}
		}

		private static ListDictionary myTableCommands;

		static DatabaseSynchronization()
		{
			myTableCommands = new ListDictionary();
			myTableCommands.Add("active_Compounds", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_Compounds"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_Properties", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_Properties"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_CompoundIdentifiers", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_CompoundIdentifiers"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_Databanks", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_Databanks"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_CompoundProperty", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_CompoundProperty"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_PropValueConst", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_PropValueConst"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_PropValueText", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_PropValueText"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_DatabankCompounds", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_DatabankCompounds"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_PropElements", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_PropElements"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_PropertyUnitrow", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_PropertyUnitrow"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_Associations", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_Associations"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_BaseIp", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_BaseIp"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_IpElement", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_IpElement"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_CompoundIp", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_CompoundIp"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_IpValues", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_IpValues"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_IpValuesDetail", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_IpValuesDetail"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_DatabankIps", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_DatabankIps"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_IpLabeledValue", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_IpLabeledValue"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_IpUnitrow", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_IpUnitrow"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_UnifacGroup", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_UnifacGroup"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_UnifacGroupIp", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_UnifacGroupIp"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_DatabankUnifacGroups", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_DatabankUnifacGroups"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_SundryData", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_SundryData"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_UOM", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_UOM"));
			myTableCommands.Add("active_MolStructure", new TableCommands("SELECT * FROM active_MolStructure"));
		}

		internal static void SynchronizeTo(Database target, IDatabaseSynchronizationSource source)
		{
			DataSet dataSet = null;
			DataSet contents = null;
			TextReader textReader = null;
			try
			{
				source.GetContents(out var Contents);
				textReader = new StringReader(Contents);
				getDatabaseContentsAndBuildTableCommands(target, out contents);
				contents.AcceptChanges();
				dataSet = contents.Clone();
				dataSet.ReadXml(textReader, XmlReadMode.IgnoreSchema);
				contents.Merge(dataSet, preserveChanges: false, MissingSchemaAction.Error);
				dataSet.Dispose();
				fixupDataSetMerge(contents);
				updateDatabaseContents(target, contents);
				updateConfiguration(target, source.DatabaseIdentity);
			}
			finally
			{
				textReader?.Close();
				dataSet?.Dispose();
				contents?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		internal static void ApplyChangesTo(Database source, IDatabaseSynchronizationTarget target)
		{
			foreach (IChange approvedChange in source.ChangeControlManager.ApprovedChanges)
			{
				target.ApplyChange(approvedChange);
			}
		}

		internal static void ApplyChange(Database target, Change sourceChange)
		{
			new Change(target, sourceChange.Command, DatabaseAccessRole.Reviewer).Submit();
		}

		internal static void GetContents(Database source, out string Contents)
		{
			Contents = null;
			TextWriter textWriter = null;
			try
			{
				getDatabaseContents(source, out var contents);
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				textWriter = new StringWriter(stringBuilder);
				contents.WriteXml(textWriter, XmlWriteMode.IgnoreSchema);
				Contents = stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			finally
			{
				textWriter?.Close();
			}
		}

		internal static void GetLastSynchronizationTime(Database database, out DateTime lastSynchronization)
		{
			lastSynchronization = DateTime.MinValue;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "SELECT confLastSyncToSource FROM Configuration";
				object obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != DBNull.Value)
				{
					lastSynchronization = Convert.ToDateTime(obj);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void getDatabaseContents(Database database, out DataSet contents)
		{
			contents = null;
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				IDbDataAdapter dbDataAdapter = database.CreateDataAdapter(database.DBProvider);
				dbDataAdapter.SelectCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				DataTableMapping dataTableMapping = new DataTableMapping();
				dataTableMapping.SourceTable = "Table";
				dbDataAdapter.TableMappings.Add(dataTableMapping);
				contents = new DataSet();
				foreach (DictionaryEntry myTableCommand in myTableCommands)
				{
					dataTableMapping.DataSetTable = (string)myTableCommand.Key;
					TableCommands tableCommands = (TableCommands)myTableCommand.Value;
					dbDataAdapter.SelectCommand.CommandText = tableCommands.SelectCommand;
					dbDataAdapter.Fill(contents);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void getDatabaseContentsAndBuildTableCommands(Database database, out DataSet contents)
		{
			contents = null;
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				IDbDataAdapter dbDataAdapter = database.CreateDataAdapter(database.DBProvider);
				dbDataAdapter.MissingSchemaAction = MissingSchemaAction.AddWithKey;
				dbDataAdapter.SelectCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				IDatabaseCommandBuilder databaseCommandBuilder = database.CreateCommandBuilder(database.DBProvider);
				databaseCommandBuilder.DataAdapter = dbDataAdapter;
				DataTableMapping dataTableMapping = new DataTableMapping();
				dataTableMapping.SourceTable = "Table";
				dbDataAdapter.TableMappings.Add(dataTableMapping);
				contents = new DataSet();
				foreach (DictionaryEntry myTableCommand in myTableCommands)
				{
					dataTableMapping.DataSetTable = (string)myTableCommand.Key;
					TableCommands tableCommands = (TableCommands)myTableCommand.Value;
					dbDataAdapter.SelectCommand.CommandText = tableCommands.SelectCommand;
					databaseCommandBuilder.RefreshSchema();
					dbDataAdapter.Fill(contents);
					tableCommands.InsertCommand = databaseCommandBuilder.GetInsertCommand();
					tableCommands.DeleteCommand = databaseCommandBuilder.GetDeleteCommand();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void updateDatabaseContents(Database database, DataSet updates)
		{
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			DataTableMapping dataTableMapping = new DataTableMapping();
			dataTableMapping.SourceTable = "Table";
			IDbDataAdapter dbDataAdapter = database.CreateDataAdapter(database.DBProvider);
			dbDataAdapter.TableMappings.Add(dataTableMapping);
			try
			{
				foreach (DictionaryEntry myTableCommand in myTableCommands)
				{
					DataTable dataTable = updates.Tables[(string)myTableCommand.Key];
					if (dataTable == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					dataTableMapping.DataSetTable = dataTable.TableName;
					TableCommands tableCommands = (TableCommands)myTableCommands[dataTable.TableName];
					if (tableCommands != null)
					{
						dbDataAdapter.InsertCommand = tableCommands.InsertCommand;
						dbDataAdapter.DeleteCommand = tableCommands.DeleteCommand;
						try
						{
							dbDataAdapter.Update(updates);
						}
						catch (DBConcurrencyException)
						{
						}
						dbDataAdapter.InsertCommand = null;
						dbDataAdapter.DeleteCommand = null;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void fixupDataSetMerge(DataSet dataset)
		{
			foreach (DataTable table in dataset.Tables)
			{
				foreach (DataRow row in table.Rows)
				{
					if (row.RowState == DataRowState.Modified)
					{
						row.AcceptChanges();
					}
					else if (row.RowState == DataRowState.Unchanged)
					{
						row.Delete();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void updateConfiguration(Database database, int databaseIdentity)
		{
			IDbConnection connection = database.Connection;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				string commandText = string.Format("UPDATE Configuration SET confLastSyncToSource='{0}'", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"));
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				commandText = $"UPDATE Configuration SET confDatabaseIdentity={databaseIdentity}";
				dbCommand.CommandText = commandText;
				dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
			}
			finally
			{
				dbCommand?.Dispose();
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IDatabaseObjectIdentity
	{
		IDatabase Database { get; set; }

		string Identity { get; set; }

		DatabaseObjectType ObjectType { get; }
	}

	public abstract class DatabaseObject : IDatabaseObjectIdentity, ISerializable
	{
		private string myIdentity;

		[NonSerialized]
		private IDatabase myDatabase;

		public IDatabase Database
		{
			get
			{
				return myDatabase;
			}
			set
			{
				myDatabase = value;
			}
		}

		public string Identity
		{
			get
			{
				return myIdentity;
			}
			set
			{
				myIdentity = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract DatabaseObjectType ObjectType { get; }

		protected DatabaseObject()
		{
		}

		protected DatabaseObject(string Identity, IDatabase Database)
		{
			myIdentity = Identity;
			myDatabase = Database;
		}

		protected DatabaseObject(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			myDatabase = context.Context as IDatabase;
			myIdentity = info.GetString("identity");
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return GetHashCode() == obj.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return myIdentity.GetHashCode();
		}

		public virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("identity", myIdentity);
		}
	}

	public interface ICitation

		string Journal { get; }

		string Date { get; }

	}
	[Serializable]
	[ClassInterface(ClassInterfaceType.None)]
	public class PropertyCitationsObject : DatabaseObject, ICitation, IDatabaseObject, IDatabaseObjectIdentity, ISerializable
	{
		private int myCitId;

		private string myName;

		private string myTitle;

		private string myPages;

		private string myJournal;

		private string myDate;

		private string myBook;

		private string myVolume;

		private string myPublisher;

		private string myNotes;

		private string myAuthors;

		public int CitationId => myCitId;

		public string Name => base.Identity;

		public string Title => myTitle;

		public string Pages => myPages;

		public string Journal => myJournal;

		public string Date => myDate;

		public string Book => myBook;

		public string Volume => myVolume;

		public string Publisher => myPublisher;

		public string Notes => myNotes;

		public string Authors => myAuthors;

		public override DatabaseObjectType ObjectType => DatabaseObjectType.Reference;

		public PropertyCitationsObject()
		{
		}

		public PropertyCitationsObject(int id, string name, string title, string pages, string journal, string date, string book, string volume, string publisher, string notes, string authors)
			: base(name, null)
		{
			myCitId = id;
			myName = name;
			myTitle = title;
			myPages = pages;
			myJournal = journal;
			myDate = date;
			myBook = book;
			myVolume = volume;
			myPublisher = publisher;
			myNotes = notes;
			myAuthors = authors;
		}

		public PropertyCitationsObject(string name, string title, string pages, string journal, string date, string book, string volume, string publisher, string notes, string authors)
			: base(name, null)
		{
			myName = name;
			myTitle = title;
			myPages = pages;
			myJournal = journal;
			myDate = date;
			myBook = book;
			myVolume = volume;
			myPublisher = publisher;
			myNotes = notes;
			myAuthors = authors;
		}

		protected PropertyCitationsObject(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			myTitle = info.GetString("title");
			myPages = info.GetString("pages");
			myJournal = info.GetString("journal");
			myDate = info.GetString("date");
			myBook = info.GetString("book");
			myVolume = info.GetString("volume");
			myPublisher = info.GetString("publisher");
			myNotes = info.GetString("notes");
			myAuthors = info.GetString("authors");
			myCitId = info.GetInt32("id");
		}

		internal static IDatabaseObject ResolveMoniker(IDatabaseObjectMoniker moniker)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			info.AddValue("title", myTitle);
			info.AddValue("pages", myPages);
			info.AddValue("journal", myJournal);
			info.AddValue("date", myDate);
			info.AddValue("book", myBook);
			info.AddValue("volume", myVolume);
			info.AddValue("publisher", myPublisher);
			info.AddValue("notes", myNotes);
			info.AddValue("authors", myAuthors);
		}

		void IDatabaseObject.GetMoniker(out IDatabaseObjectMoniker Moniker)
		{
			Moniker = new DatabaseObjectMoniker(((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).Database, ((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).ObjectType, ((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).Identity, ResolveMoniker);
		}
	}

	public interface ICompound

		CompoundType CompoundType { get; }

		InteractionType InteractionType { get; }

		bool IsReverse { get; }
	}

		public CompoundManager(Database database)
		{
			if (database == null)

				throw new ArgumentException("A database is required", "database");
			}
			myDatabase = database;
		}

		public void AddCompound(string id, IIdentifier identifier, out ICompound compound)
		{
			if (id == null || id == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound id is required", "id");
			}
			if (identifier == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier is required", "identifier");
			}
			AddCompoundCommand addCompoundCommand = new AddCompoundCommand(id, identifier);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, addCompoundCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				addCompoundCommand.GetResult(out compound);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred adding the compound to the database", inner);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveCompound(ICompound compound)

	public interface IDatabank
	{
		int Id { get; }

		IDatabase Database { get; }

		string Name { get; }

		string BaseDatabankName { get; }

		string Description { get; }

		bool IsLocked { get; }

		ICollection AllCompounds { get; set; }

		ArrayList CompoundIDs { get; set; }

		string[] AllProperties { get; set; }

		bool PureDatabank { get; set; }

		bool BinaryDatabank { get; set; }

		ArrayList BinaryParameters { get; set; }

		bool bShow { get; set; }

		void GetCompoundsWithData(out ICollection Compounds);

		void GetCompoundIDsWithData(out ArrayList Compounds);

		void GetContentDataTypes(out ICollection dataTypes);

		void UpdateDatabankDescription(string newDescription, out bool retval);

		void GetIdentifiersOfCompoundsWithData(out CompoundCollection Compounds);
	}
	public enum ContentDataType
	{
		Unknown = -1,
		PurePropertyData,
		BinaryPropertyData,
		TernaryPropertyData,
		PairPropertyData,
		ReactionData
	}
	[Serializable]
	internal class Databank : IDatabank, ISerializable
	{
		private int myId;

		private string myName;

		private string myBaseDatabankName;

		private Database myDatabase;

		private string myDescription;

		private bool myIsLocked;

		private ICollection myAllCompounds;

		private ArrayList myCompoundIDs;

		private string[] myAllProperties;

		private bool myPureDatabank;

		private bool myBinaryDatabank;

		private ArrayList myBinaryParameters;

		private bool mybShow;

		internal Database Database => myDatabase;

		IDatabase IDatabank.Database => myDatabase;

		public int Id
		{
			get
			{
				return myId;
			}
			set
			{
				myId = value;
			}
		}

		{
			get

				return myIsLocked;

				myIsLocked = value;
			}
		}

		public string Name
		{

				myName = value;
			}
		}

		public ICollection AllCompounds

		}

		public bool PureDatabank

			get

				return myPureDatabank;
			}
			set

		}

		public bool BinaryDatabank

			{

			}
		}

		public bool bShow
		{
			get
			{
				return mybShow;
			}

		public void GetCompoundsWithData(out ICollection compounds)
		{
			compounds = null;
			GetCompoundsWithDataCommand getCompoundsWithDataCommand = new GetCompoundsWithDataCommand(this);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getCompoundsWithDataCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getCompoundsWithDataCommand.GetResult(out compounds);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving the list of compounds", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetCompoundIDsWithData(out ArrayList compoundIDs)
		{
			compoundIDs = null;
			GetCompoundIDsWithDataCommand getCompoundIDsWithDataCommand = new GetCompoundIDsWithDataCommand(this);

		public void GetContentDataTypes(out ICollection contentDataTypes)
		{
			contentDataTypes = null;
			GetContentDataTypesCommand getContentDataTypesCommand = new GetContentDataTypesCommand(this);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getContentDataTypesCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getContentDataTypesCommand.GetResult(out contentDataTypes);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving the data types supported by this databank", inner);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateDatabankDescription(string description, out bool retVal)
		{
			retVal = false;
			UpdateDatabankDescriptionCommand updateDatabankDescriptionCommand = new UpdateDatabankDescriptionCommand(description);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, updateDatabankDescriptionCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				updateDatabankDescriptionCommand.GetResult(out retVal);
				if (retVal)
				{
					myDescription = description;
				}
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while updating description for this databank.", inner);
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IDatabankCollection : ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		IDatabank this[object Index] { get; set; }

		int Add(IDatabank Databank);

		void Clear();

		void Insert(int Index, IDatabank Databank);

		void Remove(IDatabank Databank);

		void RemoveAt(int Index);
	}
	[ClassInterface(ClassInterfaceType.None)]
	public class DatabankCollection : IDatabankCollection, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private ArrayList myDatabanks;

		public IDatabank this[object index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index.GetType() == typeof(int))
				{
					return (IDatabank)myDatabanks[(int)index];
				}
				if (index.GetType() == typeof(string))
				{
					int num = findIndex((string)index);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return (IDatabank)myDatabanks[num];
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("The index must be a nonnegative integer or a text string", "index");
			}
			set
			{
				if (index.GetType() != typeof(int))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("The index must be a nonnegative integer", "index");
				}
				myDatabanks[(int)index] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Count => myDatabanks.Count;

		public bool IsSynchronized => myDatabanks.IsSynchronized;

		public object SyncRoot => myDatabanks.SyncRoot;

		public DatabankCollection()
		{
			myDatabanks = new ArrayList();
		}

		public DatabankCollection(IDatabase Database)
			: this()
		{
			if (Database == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A database is required", "database");
			}
			initializeFromDatabase(Database);
		}

		public DatabankCollection(IDatabank[] Databanks)
			: this()
		{
			myDatabanks.AddRange(Databanks);
		}

		public int Add(IDatabank Databank)
		{
			return myDatabanks.Add(Databank);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			myDatabanks.Clear();
		}

		public void Insert(int Index, IDatabank Databank)
		{
			myDatabanks.Insert(Index, Databank);
		}

		public void Remove(IDatabank Databank)
		{
			myDatabanks.Remove(Databank);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int Index)
		{
			myDatabanks.RemoveAt(Index);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			myDatabanks.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return myDatabanks.GetEnumerator();
		}

		private void initializeFromDatabase(IDatabase database)
		{
			database.EnumerateDatabanks(out var Databanks);
			myDatabanks.AddRange(Databanks);
		}

		private int findIndex(string name)
		{
			int result = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < myDatabanks.Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].Name.ToLowerInvariant().CompareTo(name.ToLowerInvariant()) == 0)
				{
					result = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		string UncertaintySource { get; }

		string DataSourceType { get; }

		ICitation Citation { get; }

		ArrayList CitationList { get; set; }

		string Notes { get; }

		object History { get; }

		bool HasRegressionInfo { get; set; }
	}
	public class PropertyValueObject : DatabaseObject, IPropertyValue, IDatabaseObject, IDatabaseObjectIdentity
	{
		private IDatabank myDatabank;

		private ICompound myCompound;

		private IProperty myProperty;

		private object myValue;

		private string myNotes;

		private string myUncertainty;

		private string myUncertaintySource;

		private string myDataSourceType;

		private ICitation myCitation;

		private ArrayList myCitationList;

		private object myHistory;

		private bool myHasRegressionInfo;

		public IDatabank Databank => myDatabank;

		public ICompound Compound => myCompound;

		public IProperty Property => myProperty;

		public object Value => myValue;

		public string Uncertainty => myUncertainty;

		public string UncertaintySource => myUncertaintySource;

		public string DataSourceType => myDataSourceType;

		public ICitation Citation => myCitation;

		public ArrayList CitationList
		{
			get
			{
				return myCitationList;
			}
			set
			{
				value = myCitationList;
			}
		}

		public string Notes => myNotes;

		public object History => myHistory;

		public bool HasRegressionInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return myHasRegressionInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				myHasRegressionInfo = value;
			}
		}

		public override DatabaseObjectType ObjectType => DatabaseObjectType.PropertyValue;

		public PropertyValueObject()
		{
		}

		public PropertyValueObject(IDatabank databank, ICompound compound, IProperty property, object val)
		{
			myDatabank = databank;
			myCompound = compound;
			myProperty = property;
			myValue = val;
		}

		public PropertyValueObject(IDatabank databank, ICompound compound, IProperty property, object val, bool hasRegInfo)
		{
			myDatabank = databank;
			myCompound = compound;
			myProperty = property;
			myValue = val;
			myHasRegressionInfo = hasRegInfo;
		}

		public PropertyValueObject(int PropertyValueIndex, IDatabank databank, ICompound compound, IProperty property, object val, string notes, string uncertainty, string uncertaintySource, string dataSourceType, ICitation citation, ArrayList citationList, bool hasRegInfo)
			: base(PropertyValueIndex.ToString(), databank.Database)
		{
			myDatabank = databank;
			myCompound = compound;
			myProperty = property;
			myValue = val;
			myUncertainty = uncertainty;
			myUncertaintySource = uncertaintySource;
			myDataSourceType = dataSourceType;
			myCitation = citation;
			myCitationList = citationList;
			myNotes = notes;
			myHasRegressionInfo = hasRegInfo;
		}

		internal static IDatabaseObject ResolveMoniker(IDatabaseObjectMoniker moniker)
		{
			IPropertyValueManager propertyValueManager;
			if (!(moniker.Database is ISupportsPropertyValues) || (propertyValueManager = (moniker.Database as ISupportsPropertyValues).PropertyValueManager) == null)
			{
				throw new Exception("The database does not support sundry data or an error occurred referencing the sundry data manager");
			}
			IPropertyValue propertyValue = null;
			propertyValueManager.GetPropertyValueByIndex(Convert.ToInt32(moniker.Identity), bCondensedForViewing: false, out propertyValue);
			return (IDatabaseObject)propertyValue;
		}

		void IDatabaseObject.GetMoniker(out IDatabaseObjectMoniker Moniker)
		{
			Moniker = new DatabaseObjectMoniker(((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).Database, ((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).ObjectType, ((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).Identity, ResolveMoniker);
		}
	}

	internal class PropertyValueManager : IPropertyValueManager
	{
		private Database myDatabase;

		public IDatabase Database => myDatabase;

		public PropertyValueManager(Database database)
		{
			if (database == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A database is required", "database");
			}
			myDatabase = database;
		}

		public void AddPropertyValue(IDatabank databank, string CompoundId, string CompoundIdType, string PropertyName, object Value, string uncertainty, string uncertaintySource, string dataSourceType, ICitation citation, string notes, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = null;
			if (CompoundId == null || CompoundId == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid compound is required", "CompoundId");
			}
			if (CompoundIdType == null || CompoundIdType == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid CompoundIdType is required", "CompoundIdType");
			}
			if (PropertyName == null || PropertyName == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid PropertyName is required", "PropertyName");
			}
			myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetIdentifier(CompoundIdType, out var identifier);
			myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetCompound(CompoundId, identifier, out var compound);
			myDatabase.PropertyDao.GetProperty(PropertyName, out var property);
			if (compound == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Specified compound can not be found : {CompoundId}");
			}
			if (property == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Specified property can not be found : {PropertyName}");
			}
			if (!property.IsGlobal && databank == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A databank is required", "databank");
			}
			AddPropertyValueCommand addPropertyValueCommand = new AddPropertyValueCommand(databank, compound, property, Value, uncertainty, uncertaintySource, dataSourceType, citation, notes);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, addPropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				addPropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while adding the property value", inner);
			}
		}

		public void AddBinaryPropertyValue(IDatabank databank, string Compound1Id, string Compound2Id, string CompoundIdType, string PropertyName, object Value, string uncertainty, string uncertaintySource, string dataSourceType, ICitation citation, string notes, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = null;
			if (databank == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A databank is required", "databank");
			}
			if (Compound1Id == null || Compound1Id == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid compound is required", "Compound1Id");
			}
			if (Compound2Id == null || Compound2Id == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid compound is required", "Compound2Id");
			}
			if (CompoundIdType == null || CompoundIdType == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid CompoundIdType is required", "CompoundIdType");
			}
			if (PropertyName == null || PropertyName == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid PropertyName is required", "PropertyName");
			}
			myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetIdentifier(CompoundIdType, out var identifier);
			if (identifier == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("Specified Identifier doesn't exists in the database.");
			}
			myDatabase.PropertyDao.GetProperty(PropertyName, out var property);
			if (property == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("Specified Property doesn't exists in the database.");
			}
			myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetCompoundCombo(Compound1Id, Compound2Id, null, null, identifier, property.CompoundType, property.InteractionType, bAddIfMissing: true, out var compCombo);
			if (compCombo == null)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("Specified compounds doesn't exists in the database.");
			}
			AddPropertyValueCommand addPropertyValueCommand = new AddPropertyValueCommand(databank, compCombo, property, Value, uncertainty, uncertaintySource, dataSourceType, citation, notes);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, addPropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				addPropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while adding the property value", inner);
			}
		}

		public void AddPropertyValue(IDatabank databank, ICompound compound, IProperty property, object Value, string uncertainty, string uncertaintySource, string dataSourceType, ICitation citation, string notes, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{

			ToString();

			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid compound is required", "compound");

		public void RemovePropertyValue(IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{

			{

		public void GetPropertyValue(IDatabank databank, ICompound compound, IProperty property, bool bCondensedForViewing, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			if (databank == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A databank is required", "databank");
			}
			if (compound == null || compound.Id <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid compound is required", "compound");
			}
			if (property == null || property.Id <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid property is required", "property");
			}
			GetPropertyValueCommand getPropertyValueCommand = new GetPropertyValueCommand(databank, compound, property, bCondensedForViewing);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getPropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getPropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
				if (propertyValue != null && propertyValue.Property.InteractionType == InteractionType.Binary && RegInfoExists(propertyValue.Databank, propertyValue.Compound, propertyValue.Property))
				{
					propertyValue.HasRegressionInfo = true;
				}
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while evaluating the property value", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetUnaryPropertyValue(IDatabank databank, string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string propertyName, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = null;
			if (compoundId == null || compoundId == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier is required", "compoundId");
			}
			if (compoundIdType == null || compoundIdType == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier type is required", "compoundIdType");
			}
			if (propertyName == null || propertyName == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A property name is required", "propertyName");
			}
			myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetIdentifier(compoundIdType, out var identifier);
			myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetCompound(compoundId, identifier, out var compound);
			myDatabase.PropertyDao.GetProperty(propertyName, out var property);
			if (databank == null && property != null && !property.IsGlobal)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A databank is required", "databank");
			}
			GetPropertyValueCommand getPropertyValueCommand = new GetPropertyValueCommand(databank, compound, property, bCondensedForViewing: false);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getPropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getPropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while evaluating the property value", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetBinaryPropertyValue(IDatabank databank, string compound1Id, string compound2Id, string compoundIdType, string propertyName, bool bCondensedForViewing, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = null;
			if (databank == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A databank is required", "databank");
			}
			if (propertyName == null || propertyName == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("An interaction parameter model name is required", "propertyName");
			}
			if (compound1Id == null || compound1Id == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier is required", "compound1Id");
			}
			if (compound2Id == null || compound2Id == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier is required", "compound2Id");
			}
			if (compoundIdType == null || compoundIdType == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier type is required", "compoundIdType");
			}
			myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetIdentifier(compoundIdType, out var identifier);
			myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetCompoundCombo(compound1Id, compound2Id, null, null, identifier, CompoundType.Compound, InteractionType.Binary, bAddIfMissing: true, out var compCombo);
			myDatabase.PropertyDao.GetProperty(propertyName, out var property);
			GetPropertyValueCommand getPropertyValueCommand = new GetPropertyValueCommand(databank, compCombo, property, bCondensedForViewing);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getPropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getPropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
				if (propertyValue != null && RegInfoExists(propertyValue.Databank, propertyValue.Compound, propertyValue.Property))
				{
					propertyValue.HasRegressionInfo = true;
				}
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (ex2.Message.Contains("The query processor ran out of internal resources and could not produce a query plan"))
				{

		public void GetAllBinaryPropertyValues(ICollection databankFilter, ICollection compound1Filter, ICollection compound2Filter, ICollection propertyFilter, IIdentifier identifier, out ICollection databankList, out ICollection compound1List, out ICollection compound2List, out ICollection propertyList, bool bCondensedForViewing, out ICollection propertyValues)
		{
			propertyValues = null;
			GetAllBinaryPropertyValuesCommand getAllBinaryPropertyValuesCommand = new GetAllBinaryPropertyValuesCommand(databankFilter, compound1Filter, compound2Filter, propertyFilter, identifier, bCondensedForViewing);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getAllBinaryPropertyValuesCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getAllBinaryPropertyValuesCommand.GetResult(out databankList, out compound1List, out compound2List, out propertyList, out propertyValues);
				if (propertyValues == null || propertyValues.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (IPropertyValue propertyValue in propertyValues)
				{
					if (RegInfoExists(propertyValue.Databank, propertyValue.Compound, propertyValue.Property))
					{
						propertyValue.HasRegressionInfo = true;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (ex2.Message.Contains("The query processor ran out of internal resources and could not produce a query plan"))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The query processor ran out of internal resources and could not produce a query plan. This is a rare event and only expected for extremely complex queries or queries that reference a very large number of tables or partitions. Please simplify the query.", ex2);
				}
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving all property values", ex2);
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePropertyValue(IDatabank databank, ICompound compound, IProperty property, bool bCondensedForViewing, object newValue, string uncertainty, string uncertaintySource, string dataSourceType, ICitation citation, string notes, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = null;
			if (databank == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A databank is required", "databank");
			}
			if (compound == null || compound.Id <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid compound is required", "compound");
			}
			if (property == null || property.Id <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A valid property is required", "property");
			}
			IPropertyValue propertyValue2 = null;
			myDatabase.PropertyValueDao.GetPropertyValue(databank, compound, property, bCondensedForViewing, out propertyValue2);
			try
			{
				if (propertyValue2 != null)
				{
					UpdatePropertyValueCommand updatePropertyValueCommand = new UpdatePropertyValueCommand(propertyValue2, bCondensedForViewing, newValue, uncertainty, uncertaintySource, dataSourceType, citation, notes);
					new Change(myDatabase, updatePropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor).Submit();
					updatePropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
				}
				else
				{
					AddPropertyValueCommand addPropertyValueCommand = new AddPropertyValueCommand(databank, compound, property, newValue, uncertainty, uncertaintySource, dataSourceType, citation, notes);
					new Change(myDatabase, addPropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor).Submit();
					addPropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
				}
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred changing the value of the property", inner);
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePropertyValue(IDatabank databank, string compoundId, string compoundIdType, string propertyName, bool bCondensedForViewing, object newValue, string uncertainty, string uncertaintySource, string dataSourceType, ICitation citation, string notes, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = null;
			if (databank == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A databank is required", "databank");
			}
			if (compoundId == null || compoundId == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier is required", "compoundId");
			}
			if (compoundIdType == null || compoundIdType == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier type is required", "compoundIdType");
			}
			if (propertyName == null || propertyName == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A property name is required", "propertyName");
			}
			if (databank.Database != myDatabase)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The specified databank must be contained by the same database as this property value manager", "databank");
			}
			IIdentifier identifier = null;
			ICompound compound = null;
			IProperty property = null;
			IPropertyValue propertyValue2 = null;
			ICompoundDao compoundDao = myDatabase.CompoundDao;
			compoundDao.GetIdentifier(compoundIdType, out identifier);
			compoundDao.GetCompound(compoundId, identifier, out compound);
			myDatabase.PropertyDao.GetProperty(propertyName, out property);
			myDatabase.PropertyValueDao.GetPropertyValue(databank, compound, property, bCondensedForViewing, out propertyValue2);
			try
			{
				if (propertyValue2 != null)
				{
					UpdatePropertyValueCommand updatePropertyValueCommand = new UpdatePropertyValueCommand(propertyValue2, bCondensedForViewing, newValue, uncertainty, uncertaintySource, dataSourceType, citation, notes);
					new Change(myDatabase, updatePropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor).Submit();
					updatePropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
				}
				else
				{
					AddPropertyValueCommand addPropertyValueCommand = new AddPropertyValueCommand(databank, compound, property, newValue, uncertainty, uncertaintySource, dataSourceType, citation, notes);
					new Change(myDatabase, addPropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor).Submit();
					addPropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
				}
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred changing the value of the property", inner);
			}
		}

		}

		public void UpdatePairPropertyValue(IDatabank databank, string compound1Id, string compound2Id, string compound3Id, string compound4Id, string compoundIdType, string propertyName, bool bCondensedForViewing, object newValue, string uncertainty, string uncertaintySource, string dataSourceType, ICitation citation, string notes, out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = null;
			if (databank == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A databank is required", "databank");
			}
			if (compound1Id == null || compound1Id == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier is required", "compound1Id");
			}
			if (compound3Id == null || compound3Id == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier is required", "compound3Id");
			}
			if (compoundIdType == null || compoundIdType == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A compound identifier type is required", "compoundIdType");
			}
			if (propertyName == null || propertyName == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A property name is required", "propertyName");
			}
			if (databank.Database != myDatabase)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The specified databank must be contained by the same database as this property value manager", "databank");
			}
			IIdentifier identifier = null;
			ICompound compCombo = null;
			IProperty property = null;
			IPropertyValue propertyValue2 = null;
			ICompoundDao compoundDao = myDatabase.CompoundDao;
			compoundDao.GetIdentifier(compoundIdType, out identifier);
			compoundDao.GetCompoundCombo(compound1Id, compound2Id, compound3Id, compound4Id, identifier, CompoundType.ElectrolytePair, InteractionType.Pair, bAddIfMissing: true, out compCombo);
			myDatabase.PropertyDao.GetProperty(propertyName, out property);
			myDatabase.PropertyValueDao.GetPropertyValue(databank, compCombo, property, bCondensedForViewing, out propertyValue2);
			try
			{
				if (propertyValue2 != null)
				{
					UpdatePropertyValueCommand updatePropertyValueCommand = new UpdatePropertyValueCommand(propertyValue2, bCondensedForViewing, newValue, uncertainty, uncertaintySource, dataSourceType, citation, notes);
					new Change(myDatabase, updatePropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor).Submit();
					updatePropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
				}
				else
				{
					AddPropertyValueCommand addPropertyValueCommand = new AddPropertyValueCommand(databank, compCombo, property, newValue, uncertainty, uncertaintySource, dataSourceType, citation, notes);
					new Change(myDatabase, addPropertyValueCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor).Submit();
					addPropertyValueCommand.GetResult(out propertyValue);
				}
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred changing the value of the property", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetAllBinaryPropertyValuesForModelManager(ICollection compoundPairs, string compoundIdType, ICollection databanks, ICollection properties, bool bCondensedForViewing, out ICollection propertyValueObjects)
		{
			propertyValueObjects = null;
			if (compoundPairs == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Compound Pair collection is required", "compoundPairs");
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			Hashtable hashtable2 = new Hashtable();
			Hashtable hashtable3 = new Hashtable();
			Hashtable hashtable4 = new Hashtable();
			myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetIdentifier(compoundIdType, out var identifier);
			Array array = Array.CreateInstance(typeof(string), compoundPairs.Count);
			((Hashtable)compoundPairs).Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
			Array array2 = Array.CreateInstance(typeof(int), compoundPairs.Count);
			((Hashtable)compoundPairs).Values.CopyTo(array2, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				myDatabase.CompoundDao.GetCompound((string)array.GetValue(i), identifier, out var compound);
				if (compound != null)
				{
					hashtable.Add(compound.Id, compound);
					hashtable4.Add(compound.Id, (int)array2.GetValue(i));
				}
			}
			if (properties == null)
			{
				myDatabase.PropertyDao.GetAllProperties(null, bOnlyWithValues: true, out var properties2);
				for (int j = 0; j < properties2.Count; j++)
				{
					if (((IProperty)((ArrayList)properties2)[j]).InteractionType == InteractionType.Binary)
					{
						hashtable3.Add(((IProperty)((ArrayList)properties2)[j]).Id, (IProperty)((ArrayList)properties2)[j]);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Array array3 = Array.CreateInstance(typeof(string), properties.Count);
				((Hashtable)properties).Keys.CopyTo(array3, 0);
				for (int k = 0; k < array3.Length; k++)
				{
					myDatabase.PropertyDao.GetProperty((string)array3.GetValue(k), out var property);
					if (property != null)
					{
						hashtable3.Add(property.Id, property);
					}
				}
			}
			myDatabase.EnumerateDatabanks(out var databanks2);
			for (int l = 0; l < databanks2.Count; l++)
			{
				if (databanks == null)
				{
					hashtable2.Add(databanks2[l].Id, databanks2[l]);
				}
				else if (((ArrayList)databanks).Contains(databanks2[l]))
				{
					hashtable2.Add(databanks2[l].Id, databanks2[l]);
				}
			}
			GetAllBinaryPropertyValuesForModelManagerCommand getAllBinaryPropertyValuesForModelManagerCommand = new GetAllBinaryPropertyValuesForModelManagerCommand(hashtable, hashtable4, identifier, hashtable2, hashtable3, bCondensedForViewing);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getAllBinaryPropertyValuesForModelManagerCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getAllBinaryPropertyValuesForModelManagerCommand.GetResult(out propertyValueObjects);
				if (propertyValueObjects == null || propertyValueObjects.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (IPropertyValue propertyValueObject in propertyValueObjects)
				{
					if (RegInfoExists(propertyValueObject.Databank, propertyValueObject.Compound, propertyValueObject.Property))
					{
						propertyValueObject.HasRegressionInfo = true;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (ex2.Message.Contains("The query processor ran out of internal resources and could not produce a query plan"))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("The query processor ran out of internal resources and could not produce a query plan. This is a rare event and only expected for extremely complex queries or queries that reference a very large number of tables or partitions. Please simplify the query.", ex2);
				}
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving all binary property value objects for model manager from the database.", ex2);
			}
		}

	public interface IReaction
	{
		IDatabank Databank { get; set; }

		int Id { get; set; }

		string Name { get; set; }

		string Type { get; set; }

		string Basis { get; set; }

		string Phase { get; set; }

		string EquationType { get; set; }
	}
	public interface IReactionManager
	{
		IDatabase Database { get; }

		void AddReaction(IDatabank databank, string reactnName, string reactnType, ICollection synArrList, ICollection coeffsArrList, ICollection exponentArrList, ICollection eqConstsArrList, string reactnBasis, string reactnPhase, string eqType, ArrayList SymmetricEqConsts, string SymmetricEqConstBasis, out IReaction reaction);

		void GetReactionByName(string Name, out IReaction Reaction);

		void DeleteReaction(string reactnName);

		void GetCompoundsReactions(ICollection compids, string identifier, ICollection databanks, out ICollection reactions);

		void GetAllReactionsCount(IDatabank databank, out int rxnCount);
	}
	internal class ReactionManager : IReactionManager
	{
		private Database myDatabase;

		public IDatabase Database => myDatabase;

		public ReactionManager(Database database)
		{
			if (database == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A database is required", "database");
			}
			myDatabase = database;
		}

		public void AddReaction(IDatabank databank, string reactnName, string reactnType, ICollection synArrList, ICollection coeffsArrList, ICollection exponentArrList, ICollection eqConstsArrList, string reactnBasis, string reactnPhase, string eqType, ArrayList SymmetricEqConsts, string symmetricEqConstBasis, out IReaction reaction)
		{
			AddReactionCommand addReactionCommand = new AddReactionCommand(databank, reactnName, reactnType, synArrList, coeffsArrList, exponentArrList, eqConstsArrList, reactnBasis, reactnPhase, eqType, SymmetricEqConsts, symmetricEqConstBasis);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, addReactionCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				addReactionCommand.GetResult(out reaction);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred adding the reaction to the database", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetReactionByName(string Name, out IReaction Reaction)
		{
			GetReactionByNameCommand getReactionByNameCommand = new GetReactionByNameCommand(Name);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getReactionByNameCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getReactionByNameCommand.GetResult(out Reaction);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)

				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving the reaction from the database", inner);
			}
		}

		public void DeleteReaction(string reactnName)
		{
			DeleteReactionCommand command = new DeleteReactionCommand(reactnName);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred deleting the reaction from the database", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetCompoundsReactions(ICollection compids, string identifier, ICollection databanks, out ICollection reactions)
		{
			GetCompoundsReactionsCommand getCompoundsReactionsCommand = new GetCompoundsReactionsCommand(compids, identifier, databanks);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getCompoundsReactionsCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getCompoundsReactionsCommand.GetResult(out reactions);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving all reactions of the specified compound from the database", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetAllReactionsCount(IDatabank databank, out int rxnCount)
		{
			rxnCount = 0;
			GetAllReactionsCountCommand getAllReactionsCountCommand = new GetAllReactionsCountCommand(databank);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getAllReactionsCountCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getAllReactionsCountCommand.GetResult(out rxnCount);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}
	}

	public class MolDataManager : IMolDataManager, IMolData
	{
		private Database myDatabase;

		public IDatabase Database => myDatabase;

		public MolDataManager(Database database)
		{
			if (database == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A database is required", "database");
			}
			myDatabase = database;
		}

		public void AddStructure(int ComponentId, string MolText, int StructureType)
		{
			AddStructureCommand command = new AddStructureCommand(ComponentId, MolText, StructureType);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while adding new Molecular Structure data by ComponentId to the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void AddStructureByName(string IdName, string IdType, string MolText, int StructureType)
		{
			AddStructureByNameCommand command = new AddStructureByNameCommand(IdName, IdType, MolText, StructureType);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while adding new Molecular Structure data by name to the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveStructure(int ComponentId, int StructureType)
		{
			RemoveStructureCommand command = new RemoveStructureCommand(ComponentId, StructureType);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while removeing Molecular Structure data by ComponentId from the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveStructureByName(string IdName, string IdType, int StructureType)
		{
			RemoveStructureByNameCommand command = new RemoveStructureByNameCommand(IdName, IdType, StructureType);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while removeing Molecular Structure data by Name from the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void DeleteStructure(int ComponentId, int StructureType)
		{
			DeleteStructureCommand command = new DeleteStructureCommand(ComponentId, StructureType);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while deleteing Molecular Structure data by ComponentId from the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void DeleteStructureByName(string IdName, string IdType, int StructureType)
		{
			DeleteStructureByNameCommand command = new DeleteStructureByNameCommand(IdName, IdType, StructureType);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while deleteing Molecular Structure data by name from the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public bool GetStructure(int ComponentId, out string MolText, int StructureType)
		{
			MolText = "";
			GetStructureCommand getStructureCommand = new GetStructureCommand(ComponentId, StructureType);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getStructureCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getStructureCommand.GetResult(out MolText);
				return true;
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while getting Molecular Structure data by ComponentId from the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public bool GetStructureByName(string IdName, string IdType, out string MolText, int StructureType)
		{
			MolText = "";
			GetStructureByNameCommand getStructureByNameCommand = new GetStructureByNameCommand(IdName, IdType, StructureType);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getStructureByNameCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getStructureByNameCommand.GetResult(out MolText);
				return true;
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while getting Molecular Structure data by name from the database.", inner);
			}
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Reviewed)]
	internal class AddPropertyCommand : Command, ISerializable
	{
		private string myName;

		private string myDescription;

		private bool myIsGlobal;

		private PropertyDataType myDataType;

		private InteractionType myInteractionType;

		private CompoundType myCompoundType;

		private int myElementCount;

		private ArrayList mySymmetryList;

		private ArrayList myLabelList;

		private ArrayList myUnitsTypeList;

		private IProperty myProperty;

		private bool myPropStatus;

		public AddPropertyCommand(string name, string description, bool isGlobal, PropertyDataType dataType, InteractionType interactionType, CompoundType compoundType, int elementCount, int[] symmetryList, string[] labelList, IUnitRow[] unitsTypeList, bool propStatus)
		{
			myName = name;
			myDescription = description;
			myIsGlobal = isGlobal;
			myDataType = dataType;
			myInteractionType = interactionType;
			myCompoundType = compoundType;
			myElementCount = elementCount;
			mySymmetryList = new ArrayList(symmetryList);
			myLabelList = new ArrayList(labelList);
			myUnitsTypeList = new ArrayList(unitsTypeList);
			myPropStatus = propStatus;
		}

		protected AddPropertyCommand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			myName = info.GetString("name");
			myDescription = info.GetString("description");
			myIsGlobal = info.GetBoolean("isGlobal");
			myDataType = (PropertyDataType)info.GetValue("dataType", typeof(PropertyDataType));
			myInteractionType = (InteractionType)info.GetValue("interactionType", typeof(InteractionType));
			myCompoundType = (CompoundType)info.GetValue("compoundType", typeof(CompoundType));
			myElementCount = info.GetInt32("elementCount");
			mySymmetryList = (ArrayList)info.GetValue("symmetryList", mySymmetryList.GetType());
			myLabelList = (ArrayList)info.GetValue("labelList", myLabelList.GetType());
			myUnitsTypeList = (ArrayList)info.GetValue("unitsTypeList", myUnitsTypeList.GetType());
			myPropStatus = info.GetBoolean("propStatus");
		}

		public override void GetAuditMessage(out string Message)
		{
			Message = $"Added a property with name '{myName}' and description '{myDescription}'";
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			base.Database.PropertyDao.AddProperty(myName, myDescription, myIsGlobal, myDataType, myInteractionType, myCompoundType, myElementCount, (int[])mySymmetryList.ToArray(typeof(int)), (string[])myLabelList.ToArray(typeof(string)), (IUnitRow[])myUnitsTypeList.ToArray(typeof(IUnitRow)), myPropStatus, out myProperty);
			return true;
		}

		public void GetResult(out IProperty property)
		{
			property = myProperty;
		}

		public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("name", myName);
			info.AddValue("description", myDescription);
			info.AddValue("isGlobal", myIsGlobal);
			info.AddValue("dataType", myDataType);
			info.AddValue("interactionType", myInteractionType);
			info.AddValue("compoundType", myCompoundType);
			info.AddValue("elementCount", myElementCount);
			info.AddValue("symmetryList", mySymmetryList);
			info.AddValue("labelList", myLabelList);
			info.AddValue("unitsTypeList", myUnitsTypeList);
			info.AddValue("propStatus", myPropStatus);
		}
	}

	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Immediate)]
	internal class GetPropertyCommand : Command
	{

	public interface IPropertyHistoryObject
	{
		string Name { get; set; }

		string History { get; set; }
	}
	[Serializable]
	[ClassInterface(ClassInterfaceType.None)]
	public class PropertyHistoryObject : DatabaseObject, IPropertyHistoryObject, IDatabaseObject, IDatabaseObjectIdentity, ISerializable
	{
		private string myHistory;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Identity;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Identity = value;
			}
		}

		public string History
		{
			get
			{
				return myHistory;
			}
			set
			{
				myHistory = value;
			}
		}

		public override DatabaseObjectType ObjectType => DatabaseObjectType.History;

		public PropertyHistoryObject()
		{
		}

		public PropertyHistoryObject(string Name, string History)
			: base(Name, null)
		{
			myHistory = History;
		}

		protected PropertyHistoryObject(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			myHistory = info.GetString("History");
		}

		internal static IDatabaseObject ResolveMoniker(IDatabaseObjectMoniker moniker)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			info.AddValue("History", myHistory);
		}

		void IDatabaseObject.GetMoniker(out IDatabaseObjectMoniker Moniker)
		{
			Moniker = new DatabaseObjectMoniker(((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).Database, ((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).ObjectType, ((IDatabaseObjectIdentity)this).Identity, ResolveMoniker);
		}
	}
	internal class PropertyManager : IPropertyManager
	{
		private Database myDatabase;

		public IDatabase Database => myDatabase;

		public PropertyManager(Database database)
		{
			if (database == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A database is required", "database");
			}
			myDatabase = database;
		}

		public void AddProperty(string name, string description, bool isGlobal, PropertyDataType dataType, InteractionType interactionType, CompoundType compoundType, int elementCount, int[] symmetryList, string[] labelList, IUnitRow[] unitsTypeList, bool propStatus, out IProperty property)
		{
			if (name == null || name == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A property name is required", "name");
			}
			AddPropertyCommand addPropertyCommand = new AddPropertyCommand(name, description, isGlobal, dataType, interactionType, compoundType, elementCount, symmetryList, labelList, unitsTypeList, propStatus);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, addPropertyCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				addPropertyCommand.GetResult(out property);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred adding the property to the database", inner);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateProperty(ref IProperty property, string name, string description, bool isGlobal, PropertyDataType dataType, InteractionType interactionType, CompoundType compoundType, int elementCount, int[] symmetryList, string[] labelList, IUnitRow[] unitsTypeList)
		{
			if (name == null || name == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A property name is required", "name");
			}
			UpdatePropertyCommand updatePropertyCommand = new UpdatePropertyCommand(ref property, name, description, isGlobal, dataType, interactionType, compoundType, elementCount, symmetryList, labelList, unitsTypeList);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, updatePropertyCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				updatePropertyCommand.GetResult(ref property);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred updating the property in the database", inner);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveProperty(IProperty property)
		{
			if (property == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("IProperty is required", "property");
			}
			RemovePropertyCommand command = new RemovePropertyCommand(property);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.Contributor);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred removing the property from the database", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetProperty(string name, out IProperty property)
		{
			property = null;
			GetPropertyCommand getPropertyCommand = new GetPropertyCommand(name);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getPropertyCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getPropertyCommand.GetResult(out property);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred retrieving the property.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetAllProperties(IDatabank databank, bool bOnlyWithValues, out ICollection properties)
		{
			properties = null;
			GetAllPropertiesCommand getAllPropertiesCommand = new GetAllPropertiesCommand(databank, bOnlyWithValues);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getAllPropertiesCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getAllPropertiesCommand.GetResult(out properties);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while retrieving all the properties in the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetAllUnitRows(out ICollection unitRows)
		{
			unitRows = null;
			GetAllUnitRowsCommand getAllUnitRowsCommand = new GetAllUnitRowsCommand();
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getAllUnitRowsCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getAllUnitRowsCommand.GetResult(out unitRows);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while retrieving all the UnitRows from the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void AddPropertyEnumerations(string propertyName, ICollection enumValues)
		{
			AddPropertyEnumerationsCommand command = new AddPropertyEnumerationsCommand(propertyName, enumValues);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while adding property enumerations to the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void RemovePropertyEnumerations(IProperty property, ICollection enumToRemove)
		{
			RemovePropertyEnumerationsCommand command = new RemovePropertyEnumerationsCommand(property, enumToRemove);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while removing property enumerations from the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetPropertyEnumerations(string name, out ICollection enumValues)
		{
			GetPropertyEnumerationsCommand getPropertyEnumerationsCommand = new GetPropertyEnumerationsCommand(name);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getPropertyEnumerationsCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				getPropertyEnumerationsCommand.GetResult(out enumValues);
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while retrieving property enumerations from the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePropertyEnumerations(IProperty property, ICollection newEnumValues)
		{
			UpdatePropertyEnumerationsCommand command = new UpdatePropertyEnumerationsCommand(property, newEnumValues);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while updating property enumerations in the database.", inner);
			}
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Reviewed)]
	internal class AddPropertyValueCommand : Command, ISerializable
	{
		private IDatabank myDatabank;

		private ICompound myCompound;

		private IProperty myProperty;

		private IPropertyValue myPropertyValue;

		private string myUncertainty;

		private string myUncertaintySource;

		private string myDataSourceType;

		private string myNotes;

		private ICitation myCitation;

		private object myValue;

		private Type myTrueValueType;

		public AddPropertyValueCommand(IDatabank databank, ICompound compound, IProperty property, object Value, string uncertainty, string uncertaintySource, string dataSourceType, ICitation citation, string notes)
		{
			myDatabank = databank;
			myCompound = compound;
			myProperty = property;
			myUncertainty = uncertainty;
			myUncertaintySource = uncertaintySource;
			myDataSourceType = dataSourceType;
			myCitation = citation;
			myNotes = notes;
			myValue = Value;
			Value.GetType();
		}

		protected AddPropertyValueCommand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			myDatabank = (IDatabank)info.GetValue("databank", typeof(IDatabank));
			myCompound = (ICompound)info.GetValue("compound", typeof(ICompound));
			myProperty = (IProperty)info.GetValue("property", typeof(IProperty));
			myUncertainty = info.GetString("uncertainty");
			myUncertaintySource = info.GetString("uncertaintySource");
			myDataSourceType = info.GetString("dataSourceType");
			myCitation = (ICitation)info.GetValue("citation", typeof(ICitation));
			myNotes = info.GetString("notes");
			myTrueValueType = (Type)info.GetValue("trueValueType", typeof(Type));
			myValue = info.GetValue("Value", myTrueValueType);
		}

		public override void GetAuditMessage(out string Message)
		{
			Message = null;
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			base.Database.PropertyValueDao.AddPropertyValue(myDatabank, myCompound, myProperty, myValue, myUncertainty, myUncertaintySource, myDataSourceType, myCitation, myNotes, out myPropertyValue);
			return true;
		}

		public void GetResult(out IPropertyValue propertyValue)
		{
			propertyValue = myPropertyValue;
		}

		public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("databank", myDatabank);
			info.AddValue("compound", myCompound);
			info.AddValue("property", myProperty);
			info.AddValue("uncertainty", myUncertainty);
			info.AddValue("uncertaintySource", myUncertaintySource);
			info.AddValue("dataSourceType", myDataSourceType);
			info.AddValue("citation", myCitation);
			info.AddValue("notes", myNotes);
			info.AddValue("Value", myValue);
			info.AddValue("trueValueType", myTrueValueType);
		}
	}
