	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Immediate)]
	internal class GetAllGlobalPropertyValuesCommand : Command
	{
		private ICompound myCompound;

		private int myMolestructType;

		private string myMolestruct;

		private ICollection myIdentifierValues;

		private ICollection myGlobalPropertyValues;

		public GetAllGlobalPropertyValuesCommand(ICompound compound, int molestructType)
		{
			myCompound = compound;
			myMolestructType = molestructType;
		}

		public void GetResult(out string molestruct, out ICollection identifierValues, out ICollection propertyValues)
		{
			molestruct = myMolestruct;
			identifierValues = myIdentifierValues;
			propertyValues = myGlobalPropertyValues;
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			base.Database.CompoundDao.GetAllIdentifierValues(myCompound, out myIdentifierValues);
			base.Database.MolDataDao.GetStructure(myCompound.Id, out myMolestruct, 1);
			IPropertyDao propertyDao = base.Database.PropertyDao;
			propertyDao.GetProperty("COMPCLASS", out var property);
			propertyDao.GetProperty("FORMULA", out var property2);
			propertyDao.GetProperty("HYSIDX", out var property3);
			propertyDao.GetProperty("EDLIDX", out var property4);
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			IPropertyValue propertyValue = null;
			IPropertyValue propertyValue2 = null;
			IPropertyValue propertyValue3 = null;
			IPropertyValue propertyValue4 = null;
			IPropertyValueDao propertyValueDao = base.Database.PropertyValueDao;
			propertyValueDao.GetPropertyValue(null, myCompound, property, bCondensedForViewing: false, out propertyValue);
			if (propertyValue != null)
			{
				arrayList.Add(propertyValue);
			}
			propertyValueDao.GetPropertyValue(null, myCompound, property2, bCondensedForViewing: false, out propertyValue2);
			if (propertyValue2 != null)
			{
				arrayList.Add(propertyValue2);
			}
			propertyValueDao.GetPropertyValue(null, myCompound, property3, bCondensedForViewing: false, out propertyValue3);
			if (propertyValue3 != null)
			{
				arrayList.Add(propertyValue3);
			}
			propertyValueDao.GetPropertyValue(null, myCompound, property4, bCondensedForViewing: false, out propertyValue4);
			if (propertyValue4 != null)
			{
				arrayList.Add(propertyValue4);
			}
			myGlobalPropertyValues = arrayList;
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class ReactionObject : IReaction
	{
		private IDatabank myDatabank;

		private int reactn_Id;

		private string reactn_Name;

		private string reactn_Type;

		private string reactn_Basis;

		private ArrayList reactn_Synonyms;

		private ArrayList reactn_Coefficients;

		private ArrayList reactn_Exponents;

		private ArrayList reactn_EqConsts;

		private string reactn_Phase;

		private string reactn_EqType;

		private ArrayList reactn_SymmetricEqConsts;

		private string reactn_SymmetricEqConstBasis;

		public int Id
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_Id;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_Id = value;
			}
		}

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_Name;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_Name = value;
			}
		}

		public string Type
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_Type;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_Type = value;
			}
		}

		public string Basis
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_Basis;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_Basis = value;
			}
		}

		public ArrayList Synonyms
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_Synonyms;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_Synonyms = value;
			}
		}

		public ArrayList Coefficients
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_Coefficients;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_Coefficients = value;
			}
		}

		public ArrayList Exponents
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_Exponents;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_Exponents = value;
			}
		}

		public ArrayList EqConsts
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_EqConsts;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_EqConsts = value;
			}
		}

		public IDatabank Databank
		{
			get
			{
				return myDatabank;
			}
			set
			{
				myDatabank = value;
			}
		}

		public string Phase
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_Phase;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_Phase = value;
			}
		}

		public string EquationType
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_EqType;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_EqType = value;
			}
		}

		public ArrayList SymmetricEqConsts
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_SymmetricEqConsts;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_SymmetricEqConsts = value;
			}
		}

		public string SymmetricEqConstBasis
		{
			get
			{
				return reactn_SymmetricEqConstBasis;
			}
			set
			{
				reactn_SymmetricEqConstBasis = value;
			}
		}

		public ReactionObject(IDatabank databank, int id, string name, string type, string basis, ArrayList SynList, ArrayList CoeffList, ArrayList ExpoList, ArrayList EqConstList, string phase, string eqType, ArrayList SymmetricEqConsts, string SymmetricEqConstBasis)
		{
			myDatabank = databank;
			reactn_Id = id;
			reactn_Name = name;
			reactn_Type = type;
			reactn_Basis = basis;
			reactn_Synonyms = SynList;
			reactn_Coefficients = CoeffList;
			reactn_Exponents = ExpoList;
			reactn_EqConsts = EqConstList;
			reactn_Phase = phase;
			reactn_EqType = eqType;
			reactn_SymmetricEqConsts = SymmetricEqConsts;
			reactn_SymmetricEqConstBasis = SymmetricEqConstBasis;
		}

		public ReactionObject(IDatabank databank, string name, string type, string basis, ArrayList SynList, ArrayList CoeffList, ArrayList ExpoList, ArrayList EqConstList, string phase, string eqType, ArrayList SymmetricEqConsts, string SymmetricEqConstBasis)
		{
			myDatabank = databank;
			reactn_Name = name;
			reactn_Type = type;
			reactn_Basis = basis;
			reactn_Synonyms = SynList;
			reactn_Coefficients = CoeffList;
			reactn_Exponents = ExpoList;
			reactn_EqConsts = EqConstList;
			reactn_Phase = phase;
			reactn_EqType = eqType;
			reactn_SymmetricEqConsts = SymmetricEqConsts;
			reactn_SymmetricEqConstBasis = SymmetricEqConstBasis;
		}

		public SortedList GetReactionExponents()
		{
			ArrayList synonyms = Synonyms;
			ArrayList exponents = Exponents;
			SortedList sortedList = new SortedList();
			if (exponents != null && exponents.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < exponents.Count; i++)
				{
					if (exponents[i] != null)
					{
						sortedList.Add(synonyms[i], exponents[i]);
					}
					else
					{
						sortedList.Add(synonyms[i], 1E+35);
					}
				}
			}
			return sortedList;
		}

		public string GetReactionEquation()
		{
			ArrayList synonyms = Synonyms;
			ArrayList coefficients = Coefficients;
			_ = EqConsts;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList3 = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList4 = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < synonyms.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((double)coefficients[i] <= 0.0)
				{
					arrayList.Add(synonyms[i]);
					arrayList2.Add(coefficients[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList3.Add(synonyms[i]);
					arrayList4.Add(coefficients[i]);
				}
			}
			string text = "";
			double num = (double)arrayList2[arrayList2.Count - 1];
			for (int j = 0; j < arrayList.Count; j++)
			{
				double num2 = -1.0 * (double)arrayList2[j];
				if (j == arrayList.Count - 1)
				{
					if (num2 != 0.0)
					{
						text = ((num2 != 1.0) ? (text + num2 + " " + (string)arrayList[j]) : (text + (string)arrayList[j]));
					}
					if (Type == "SALT")
					{
						text += "(S)";
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (num2 != 0.0)
					{
						text = ((num2 != 1.0) ? (text + num2 + " " + (string)arrayList[j]) : (text + (string)arrayList[j]));
					}
					if (num2 != 0.0 && (num != 0.0 || j != arrayList.Count - 2))
					{
						text += " + ";
					}
				}
			}
			string text2 = "";
			for (int k = 0; k < arrayList3.Count; k++)
			{
				text2 = ((k != arrayList3.Count - 1) ? (((double)arrayList4[k] != 1.0) ? (text2 + arrayList4[k].ToString() + " " + (string)arrayList3[k] + "  +  ") : (text2 + (string)arrayList3[k] + "  +  ")) : (((double)arrayList4[k] != 1.0) ? (text2 + arrayList4[k].ToString() + " " + (string)arrayList3[k]) : (text2 + (string)arrayList3[k])));
			}
			string text3 = text;
			text3 = ((!(Type == "STOIC") && !(Type == "SALT") && !(Type == "WATER") && !(Type == "ICE")) ? (text3 + "  ---->  ") : (text3 + "  <---->  "));
			return text3 + text2;
		}

		public virtual bool Equals(ReactionObject obj)
		{
			if (Name == obj.Name)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void DeleteDatabaseIfNotInUse()
		{
			try
			{
				string database = Connection.Database;
				if (Connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
				{
					Connection.Open();
				}
				Connection.ChangeDatabase("master");
				dropDatabase(Connection, database);
				base.Alias = "Invalid";
			}
			catch (GatewayException ex)
			{
				err = ((ex.InnerException != null) ? ex.InnerException.Message : ex.Message);
				throw new GatewayException("Failed to drop the database: " + err, ex);
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				err = ((ex2.InnerException != null) ? ex2.InnerException.Message : ex2.Message);
				throw new GatewayException("Failed to drop the database: " + err, ex2);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (Connection != null)
				{
					Connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public void CloseConnection()
		{
			try
			{
				if (Connection != null && Connection.State == ConnectionState.Open)
				{
					Connection.Close();
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Connection.Close();
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected override void initializeSchema(string companyLicMgrStr, string vendorLicMgrStr, string creatorPwd)
		{
			Stream stream = null;
			StreamReader streamReader = null;
			IDbCommand dbCommand = null;
			IDbConnection connection = Connection;
			bool flag = false;
			if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				connection.Open();
				flag = true;
			}
			try
			{
				dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
				stream = typeof(SqlServerDatabase).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("AspenTech.APED.Resources.aped-sqlserver.sql");
				streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
				string[] array = streamReader.ReadToEnd().Split(new char[1] { '^' });
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					if (text != "" && ApedApplication.ValidateSQLInput(text))
					{
						dbCommand.CommandText = text;
						dbCommand.ExecuteNonQuery();
					}
				}
				assignIdentity(dbCommand);
				assignTokens(companyLicMgrStr, vendorLicMgrStr, creatorPwd);
			}
			finally
			{
				streamReader?.Close();
				stream?.Close();
				dbCommand?.Dispose();

					connection.Close();
				}
			}

		private void validateInput(string alias, string dataSource, string userName, string userPassword)
		{
			if (alias == null || alias == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A database alias must be given", "Alias");
			}
			if (dataSource == null || dataSource == "")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A data source must be given", "DataSource");
			}
			char[] anyOf = new char[3] { '=', ';', '\'' };
			if (dataSource.IndexOfAny(anyOf) != -1 || (userName != null && userName.IndexOfAny(anyOf) != -1) || (userPassword != null && userPassword.IndexOfAny(anyOf) != -1))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Connection arguments may not contain any of the '=', ';', or ''' characters");
			}
			if (alias.IndexOf('\\') != -1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The database alias may not contain a backslash", "Alias");
			}
		}

		protected override void CreateConnection(string connectionString, string dbprovider)
		{
			if (GlobalControl.localDBServer && connectionString.Contains("pipe") && connectionString.Contains("tsql") && connectionString.Contains("query"))
			{
				ApedApplication.SetInstanceForCurrentUser();
				int num = 26;
				int num2 = 65;
				string text = connectionString.Substring(0, num);
				string text2 = connectionString.Substring(num, num2 - num);
				string text3 = connectionString.Substring(num2, connectionString.Length - num2);
				if (text2.CompareTo(GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname) != 0)
				{
					connectionString = text + GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname + text3;
				}
			}
			string error = string.Empty;
			if (CanDBOpen(connectionString, out error, dbprovider))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!connectionString.Contains("Integrated Security=SSPI"))
			{
				connectionString += "Integrated Security=true;";
			}
			error = CreateConnection1(connectionString, dbprovider);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
			{
				if (!error.ToUpperInvariant().Contains("TIMEOUT"))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Failed to open the database: '" + myAlias + "': " + error);
				}
				connectionString += "Connection Timeout=150; Min Pool Size=20";
				error = CreateConnection1(connectionString, dbprovider);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
				{
					throw new GatewayException("Failed to open the database: '" + myAlias + "': " + error);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanDBOpen(string connectionString, out string error, string dbprovider)

		public void InitDatabase()
		{
			myAlias = base.Alias;
			bool bLocalDB = false;
			myDataSource = base.DataSource;
			if (GlobalControl.localDBServer && myDataSource.Contains("pipe") && myDataSource.Contains("tsql") && myDataSource.Contains("query"))
			{
				bLocalDB = true;
				if (myDataSource.CompareTo(GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname) != 0)
				{
					myDataSource = GlobalControl.InstancePipeNname;
				}
			}
			myUserName = base.UserName;
			myUserPassword = base.UserPassword;
			myConnectionString = base.ConnectionString;
			_dbProvider = base.DBProvider;
			string text = "";
			if (legacyDB)
			{
				try
				{
					text = Database.Decrypt(myConnectionString, base.Version);
				}
				catch (GatewayException ex)
				{
					err = ((ex.InnerException != null) ? ex.InnerException.Message : ex.Message);
					throw new GatewayException("An internal error has occurred: " + err, ex);
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					err = ((ex2.InnerException != null) ? ex2.InnerException.Message : ex2.Message);
					throw new GatewayException("An internal error has occurred: " + err, ex2);
				}
				CreateConnection(text, _dbProvider);
			}
			else
			{
				CreateConnection(myConnectionString, _dbProvider);
			}
			readConfiguration(bLocalDB);
			connectionFlag = false;
			AspenPlusConnectionFlag = false;
			applicationPwd = "sdfsdSDFSF124mSKFJSDKCN909kjMN8oijohjknb6HJBJB";
		}

	[Serializable]
	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Reviewed)]
	internal class UpdateGroupIpValuesCommand : Command, ISerializable
	{
		private Databank myDatabank;

		private string myModelName;

		private string myGroup1Formula;

		private string myGroup2Formula;

		private double[] myValues;

		private double[] myOldValues;

		private bool myIsNewValue;

		private bool mybCondensedForViewing;

		public UpdateGroupIpValuesCommand(Databank databank, string modelName, string group1Formula, string group2Formula, double[] values, bool bCondensedForViewing)
		{
			myDatabank = databank;
			myModelName = modelName;
			myGroup1Formula = group1Formula;
			myGroup2Formula = group2Formula;
			myValues = values;
			myIsNewValue = true;
			mybCondensedForViewing = bCondensedForViewing;
		}

		protected UpdateGroupIpValuesCommand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			myDatabank = (Databank)info.GetValue("databank", typeof(Databank));
			myModelName = info.GetString("modelName");
			myGroup1Formula = info.GetString("group1Formula");
			myGroup2Formula = info.GetString("group2Formula");
			myValues = (double[])info.GetValue("values", typeof(double[]));
			myIsNewValue = true;
			mybCondensedForViewing = info.GetBoolean("bCondensedForViewing");
		}

		public override void GetAuditMessage(out string Message)
		{
			string text = myValues[0].ToString();
			for (int i = 1; i < myValues.Length; i++)
			{
				double num = myValues[i];
				text = text + ", " + num;
			}
			string text2 = myGroup1Formula + ", " + myGroup2Formula;
			if (myIsNewValue)
			{
				Message = $"Added UNIFAC model '{myModelName}' group interaction parameters ( {text} ) between groups ( {text2} ) to databank '{myDatabank.Name}'";
				return;
			}
			string text3 = myOldValues[0].ToString();
			for (int j = 1; j < myOldValues.Length; j++)
			{
				double num2 = myValues[j];
				text3 = text3 + ", " + num2;
			}
			Message = $"Changed UNIFAC model '{myModelName}' group interaction parameters between groups ( {text2} ) in databank '{myDatabank.Name}' from ( {text3} ) to ( {text} )";
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			IUnifacGroupDao unifacGroupDao = base.Database.UnifacGroupDao;
			myIsNewValue = unifacGroupDao.UpdateMainGroupInteractions(myDatabank, myModelName, myGroup1Formula, myGroup2Formula, myValues, mybCondensedForViewing, out myOldValues);
			return myIsNewValue;
		}

		public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("databank", myDatabank);
			info.AddValue("modelName", myModelName);
			info.AddValue("group1Formula", myGroup1Formula);
			info.AddValue("group2Formula", myGroup2Formula);
			info.AddValue("values", myValues);
			info.AddValue("bCondensedForViewing", mybCondensedForViewing);
		}
	}

	internal class UpdateSubgroupParamsCommand : Command, ISerializable
	{
		private Databank myDatabank;

		private string mySubgroupFormula;

		private double myR;

		private double myQ;

		private double myOldR;

		private double myOldQ;

		private bool myIsNewValue;

		public UpdateSubgroupParamsCommand(Databank databank, string subgroupFormula, double r, double q)
		{
			myDatabank = databank;
			mySubgroupFormula = subgroupFormula;
			myR = r;
			myQ = q;
			myIsNewValue = true;
		}

		protected UpdateSubgroupParamsCommand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			myDatabank = (Databank)info.GetValue("databank", typeof(Databank));
			mySubgroupFormula = info.GetString("subgroupFormula");
			myR = info.GetDouble("r");
			myQ = info.GetDouble("q");
			myIsNewValue = true;
		}

		public override void GetAuditMessage(out string Message)
		{
			string text = "R = " + myR + ", Q = " + myQ;
			if (myIsNewValue)
			{
				Message = $"Added subgroup '{mySubgroupFormula}' parameters ( {text} ) to databank '{myDatabank.Name}'";
				return;
			}
			string text2 = "R = " + myOldR + ", Q = " + myOldQ;
			Message = $"Changed subgroup '{mySubgroupFormula}' parameters in databank '{myDatabank.Name}' from ( {text2} ) to ( {text} )";
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			IUnifacGroupDao unifacGroupDao = base.Database.UnifacGroupDao;
			myIsNewValue = unifacGroupDao.UpdateSubgroupParameters(myDatabank, mySubgroupFormula, myR, myQ, out myOldR, out myOldQ);
			return myIsNewValue;
		}

		public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("databank", myDatabank);
			info.AddValue("subgroupFormula", mySubgroupFormula);
			info.AddValue("r", myR);
			info.AddValue("q", myQ);
		}

	internal class UnifacGroupManager : IUnifacGroupManager, IUnifacGroups
	{
		private Database myDatabase;

		public IDatabase Database => myDatabase;

		public UnifacGroupManager(Database database)
		{
			if (database == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A database is required", "database");
			}
			myDatabase = database;
		}

	public class UnitRowObject : IUnitRow, IComparable
	{
		private int myRowId;

		private string myUnitRowName;

		private string myDefaultUOM;

		public int RowId
		{
			get
			{
				return myRowId;
			}
			set
			{
				myRowId = value;
			}
		}

		public string UnitRowName
		{
			get
			{
				return myUnitRowName;
			}
			set
			{
				myUnitRowName = value;
			}
		}

		public string DefaultUOM
		{
			get
			{
				return myDefaultUOM;
			}
			set
			{
				myDefaultUOM = value;
			}
		}

		public UnitRowObject(int row_id, string unit_rowname, string default_uom)
		{
			myRowId = row_id;
			myUnitRowName = unit_rowname;
			myDefaultUOM = default_uom;
		}

		public int CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			return UnitRowName.ToUpperInvariant().CompareTo(((UnitRowObject)obj).UnitRowName.ToUpperInvariant());
		}
	}
	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Immediate)]
	internal class GetRowIdCommand : Command
	{
		private int myRowId = -1;

		private string myRowName;

		public GetRowIdCommand(string rowname)
		{
			myRowName = rowname;
		}

		public void GetResult(out int rowid)
		{
			rowid = myRowId;
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			IUOMDataDao uOMDataDao = base.Database.UOMDataDao;
			myRowId = uOMDataDao.GetRowId(myRowName);
			if (myRowId != -1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Immediate)]
	internal class GetRowNameAndUOMCommand : Command
	{
		private int myRowId = -1;

		private string myRowName = "";

		private string myDefaultUOM = "";

		public GetRowNameAndUOMCommand(int rowid)
		{
			myRowId = rowid;
		}

		public void GetResult(out string rowname, out string defaultuom)
		{
			rowname = myRowName;
			defaultuom = myDefaultUOM;
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			base.Database.UOMDataDao.GetRowNameAndUOM(myRowId, out myRowName, out myDefaultUOM);
			if (myRowName != "")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[CommandExecutionModel(CommandExecutionModelType.Reviewed)]
	internal class AddUOMDataCommand : Command, ISerializable
	{
		private int myRowId;

		private string myRowName;

		private string myDefaultUOM;

		public AddUOMDataCommand(int rowid, string rowname, string defaultuom)
		{
			myRowId = rowid;
			myRowName = rowname;
			myDefaultUOM = defaultuom;
		}

		protected AddUOMDataCommand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			myRowId = info.GetInt32("rowid");
			myRowName = info.GetString("rowname");
			myDefaultUOM = info.GetString("defaultuom");
		}

		public override void GetAuditMessage(out string Message)
		{
			Message = "Added a UOM Data with RowId ='" + myRowId + "'RowName='" + myRowName + "'DefaultUOM ='" + myDefaultUOM + "'";
		}

		public override bool Execute()
		{
			base.Database.UOMDataDao.AddUOMData(myRowId, myRowName, myDefaultUOM);
			return true;
		}

		public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("rowid", myRowId);
			info.AddValue("rowname", myRowName);
			info.AddValue("defaultuom", myDefaultUOM);
		}
	}

		{
			Message = "Changed unit of measure data with RowId = '{0}', RowName = '{1}' and DefaultUOM ='{2}' to new RowId = '{3}' new RowName = '{4}' and new DefaultUOM ='{5}'.";

	{

			}
			myDatabase = database;
		}

		public void AddUOMData(int RowId, string RowName, string DefaultUOM)
		{
			AddUOMDataCommand command = new AddUOMDataCommand(RowId, RowName, DefaultUOM);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while adding new unit of measure data to the database.", inner);
			}
		}

		public void DeleteUOMData(int RowId)
		{
			DeleteUOMDataCommand command = new DeleteUOMDataCommand(RowId);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while deleting permanently unit of measure data from the database with RowId ='" + RowId + "'", inner);
			}
		}

		public bool UpdateUOMData(int RowId, string RowName, string DefaultUOM)
		{
			UpdateUOMDataCommand command = new UpdateUOMDataCommand(RowId, RowName, DefaultUOM);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, command, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{
				change.Submit();
				return change.Result;
			}
			catch (GatewayException)
			{
				throw;

			catch (Exception inner)

				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while updating unit of measure data with RowId ='" + RowId + "'", inner);

		public void RemoveUOMData(int RowId)
		{
			RemoveUOMDataCommand command = new RemoveUOMDataCommand(RowId);

			{
				change.Submit();
			}

			{
				throw;

			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				throw new GatewayException("An error occurred while removing unit of measure data from the database with RowId ='" + RowId + "'", inner);
			}
		}

		public void GetRowNameAndUOM(int RowId, out string RowName, out string DefaultUOM)
		{
			RowName = "";
			DefaultUOM = "";
			GetRowNameAndUOMCommand getRowNameAndUOMCommand = new GetRowNameAndUOMCommand(RowId);
			Change change = new Change(myDatabase, getRowNameAndUOMCommand, DatabaseAccessRole.User);
			try
			{

			}
			catch (GatewayException)

				throw;

			catch (Exception inner)

			}
		}

		public int GetRowId(string RowName)

			}
		}

namespace AspenTech.APED.Core.DBconfigs
{
	public interface IDBConfiguration
	{
		string Provider { get; }

		List<string> SupportedDBs { get; }

		string UserName { get; }

		string UserPassword { get; }

		string ConnectionString { get; }

		string DataSource { get; }

		ILogger DBLogger { get; set; }

		string BuildConnectionString(string dbName);

		void LoadFromEnvironment();
	}
	public class DBServerConfiguration : IDBConfiguration
	{
		public string Provider { get; set; }

		public List<string> SupportedDBs { get; set; }

		public string UserName { get; set; }

		public string UserPassword { get; set; }

		public string ConnectionString { get; set; }

		public string DataSource { get; set; }

		public ILogger DBLogger { get; set; }

		public DBServerConfiguration()
		{
		}

		public DBServerConfiguration(ILogger logger)
		{
			DBLogger = logger;
		}

		public DBServerConfiguration(bool forceDefaultForSimpleApp = false)
		{
			if (forceDefaultForSimpleApp)
			{
				Provider = "postgres";
				SupportedDBs = new List<string> { "APESV150", "APLDB", "APV150", "NISTV150", "FACTV150" };
				UserName = "postgres";
				UserPassword = "postgres";
				ConnectionString = "you shall find me in your overrides";
				DataSource = "localhost";
				DBLogger = null;
			}
		}

		public void LoadFromEnvironment()
		{
			SupportedDBs = (from db in Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DBCONFIGURATION__SQLSERVER__SUPPORTEDDBS")?.Split(new char[1] { ',' })
				select db.Trim()).ToList() ?? new List<string>();
			UserName = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DBCONFIGURATION__SQLSERVER__USERNAME");
			UserPassword = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DBCONFIGURATION__SQLSERVER__USERPASSWORD");
			ConnectionString = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DBCONFIGURATION__SQLSERVER__CONNECTIONSTRING");
			DataSource = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DBCONFIGURATION__SQLSERVER__DATASOURCE");
			Provider = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DBCONFIGURATION__SQLSERVER__PROVIDER");
		}

		public string BuildConnectionString(string dbName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserPassword) || UserPassword.Contains("you shall find me in your overrides"))
			{
				DBLogger.LogError("SQL Server UserPassword is not properly configured.");
				throw new SQLServerConfigurationMissingException("SQL Server UserPassword is not properly configured.");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserName) || UserName.Contains("you shall find me in your overrides"))
			{
				DBLogger.LogError("SQL Server UserName is not properly configured.");
				throw new SQLServerConfigurationMissingException("SQL Server UserName is not properly configured.");
			}
			if (SupportedDBs.Count == 0)
			{
				DBLogger.LogError("SQL SupportedDBs is empty.");
				throw new SQLServerConfigurationMissingException("SQL SupportedDBs is empty.");
			}
			if (Provider.ToLower() == "postgres")
			{
				if (UserName != "postgres" || UserPassword != "postgres")
				{
					DBLogger.LogWarning("DBConfiguration UserName and/or UserPassword is not equal to 'postgres', Connection will overwrite these credentials if empty.");
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserName))
				{
					UserName = "postgres";
					DBLogger.LogWarning("DBConfiguration UserName will be set to 'postgres.'");
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserPassword))
				{
					UserPassword = "postgres";
					DBLogger.LogWarning("DBConfiguration UserPassword will be set to 'postgres.'");
				}
				return "Host=" + DataSource + ";Database=" + dbName + ";Username=" + UserName + ";Password=" + UserPassword + ";Pooling=false;";
			}
			if (Provider.ToLower() == "sqlite")
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				string text2 = string.Empty;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConnectionString))
				{
					text = Path.Combine(ConnectionString, dbName + ".db");
					text2 = "Data Source=" + text + ";Version=3;";
					if (!File.Exists(text))
					{
						text = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, dbName + ".db");
						text2 = "Data Source=" + text + ";Version=3;";
					}
				}
				if (!File.Exists(text))
				{
					DBLogger.LogWarning("SQLite database file '" + text2 + "' does not exist.");
					throw new Exception("SQLite database file does not exist.");
				}
				return text2;
			}
			return "Pooling=False;Data Source=" + DataSource + ";Initial Catalog='" + dbName + "';User ID=" + UserName + ";Password=" + UserPassword + ";";
		}
	}
	public class SQLServerConfigurationMissingException : Exception
	{
		public SQLServerConfigurationMissingException(string missingSection)
			: base(missingSection)
		{
		}
	}
}
